lines.text: “Behold, my eye has seen all this. My ear has heard and understood it.
Lo, all — hath mine eye seen, Heard hath mine ear, and it attendeth to it.

13.he: כְּֽ֭דַעְתְּכֶם יָדַ֣עְתִּי גַם־אָ֑נִי לֹא־נֹפֵ֖ל אָנֹכִ֣י מִכֶּֽם׃

lines.text: What you know, I know also. I am not inferior to you.
According to your knowledge I have known — also I. I am not fallen more than you.

13.he: אוּלָ֗ם אֲ֭נִי אֶל־שַׁדַּ֣י אֲדַבֵּ֑ר וְהוֹכֵ֖חַ אֶל־אֵ֣ל אֶחְפָּֽץ׃

lines.text: “Surely I would speak to the Almighty. I desire to reason with God.
Yet I for the Mighty One do speak, And to argue for God I delight.

13.he: וְֽאוּלָ֗ם אַתֶּ֥ם טֹֽפְלֵי־שָׁ֑קֶר רֹפְאֵ֖י אֱלִ֣ל כֻּלְּכֶֽם׃

lines.text: But you are forgers of lies. You are all physicians of no value.
And yet, ye [are] forgers of falsehood, Physicians of nought — all of you,

13.he: מִֽי־יִ֭תֵּן הַחֲרֵ֣שׁ תַּחֲרִישׁ֑וּן וּתְהִ֖י לָכֶ֣ם לְחָכְמָֽה׃

lines.text: Oh that you would be completely silent! Then you would be wise.
O that ye would keep perfectly silent, And it would be to you for wisdom.

13.he: שִׁמְעוּ־נָ֥א תוֹכַחְתִּ֑י וְרִב֖וֹת שְׂפָתַ֣י הַקְשִֽׁיבוּ׃

lines.text: Hear now my reasoning. Listen to the pleadings of my lips.
Hear, I pray you, my argument, And to the pleadings of my lips attend,

13.he: הַ֭לְאֵל תְּדַבְּר֣וּ עַוְלָ֑ה וְ֝ל֗וֹ תְּֽדַבְּר֥וּ רְמִיָּֽה׃

lines.text: Will you speak unrighteously for God, and talk deceitfully for him?
For God do ye speak perverseness? And for Him do ye speak deceit?

13.he: הֲפָנָ֥יו תִּשָּׂא֑וּן אִם־לָאֵ֥ל תְּרִיבֽוּן׃

lines.text: Will you show partiality to him? Will you contend for God?
His face do ye accept, if for God ye strive?

13.he: הֲ֭טוֹב כִּֽי־יַחְקֹ֣ר אֶתְכֶ֑ם אִם־כְּהָתֵ֥ל בֶּ֝אֱנ֗וֹשׁ תְּהָתֵ֥לּוּ בֽוֹ׃

lines.text: Is it good that he should search you out? Or as one deceives a man, will you deceive him?
Is [it] good that He doth search you, If, as one mocketh at a man, ye mock at Him?

13.he: הוֹכֵ֣חַ יוֹכִ֣יחַ אֶתְכֶ֑ם אִם־בַּ֝סֵּ֗תֶר פָּנִ֥ים תִּשָּׂאֽוּן׃

lines.text: He will surely reprove you if you secretly show partiality.
He doth surely reprove you, if in secret ye accept faces.

13.he: הֲלֹ֣א שְׂ֭אֵתוֹ תְּבַעֵ֣ת אֶתְכֶ֑ם וּ֝פַחְדּ֗וֹ יִפֹּ֥ל עֲלֵיכֶֽם׃

lines.text: Shall not his majesty make you afraid, and his dread fall on you?
Doth not His excellency terrify you? And His dread fall upon you?

13.he: זִֽ֭כְרֹנֵיכֶם מִשְׁלֵי־אֵ֑פֶר לְגַבֵּי־חֹ֝֗מֶר גַּבֵּיכֶֽם׃

lines.text: Your memorable sayings are proverbs of ashes. Your defenses are defenses of clay.
Your remembrances [are] similes of ashes, For high places of clay your heights.

13.he: הַחֲרִ֣ישׁוּ מִ֭מֶּנִּי וַאֲדַבְּרָה־אָ֑נִי וְיַעֲבֹ֖ר עָלַ֣י מָֽה׃

lines.text: “Be silent! Leave me alone, that I may speak. Let come on me what will.
Keep silent from me, and I speak, And pass over me doth what?

13.he: עַל־מָ֤ה ׀ אֶשָּׂ֣א בְשָׂרִ֣י בְשִׁנָּ֑י וְ֝נַפְשִׁ֗י אָשִׂ֥ים בְּכַפִּֽי׃

lines.text: Why should I take my flesh in my teeth, and put my life in my hand?
Wherefore do I take my flesh in my teeth? And my soul put in my hand?

13.he: הֵ֣ן יִ֭קְטְלֵנִי לא אֲיַחֵ֑ל אַךְ־דְּ֝רָכַ֗י אֶל־פָּנָ֥יו אוֹכִֽיחַ׃

lines.text: Behold, he will kill me. I have no hope. Nevertheless, I will maintain my ways before him.
Lo, He doth slay me — I wait not! Only, my ways unto His face I argue.

13.he: גַּם־הוּא־לִ֥י לִֽישׁוּעָ֑ה כִּי־לֹ֥א לְ֝פָנָ֗יו חָנֵ֥ף יָבֽוֹא׃

lines.text: This also will be my salvation, that a godless man will not come before him.
Also — He [is] to me for salvation, For the profane cometh not before Him.

13.he: שִׁמְע֣וּ שָׁ֭מוֹעַ מִלָּתִ֑י וְ֝אַֽחֲוָתִ֗י בְּאָזְנֵיכֶֽם׃

lines.text: Listen carefully to my speech. Let my declaration be in your ears.
Hear ye diligently my word, And my declaration with your ears.

13.he: הִנֵּה־נָ֭א עָרַ֣כְתִּי מִשְׁפָּ֑ט יָ֝דַ֗עְתִּי כִּֽי־אֲנִ֥י אֶצְדָּֽק׃

lines.text: See now, I have set my cause in order. I know that I am righteous.
Lo, I pray you, I have set in order the cause, I have known that I am righteous.

13.he: מִי־ה֭וּא יָרִ֣יב עִמָּדִ֑י כִּֽי־עַתָּ֖ה אַחֲרִ֣ישׁ וְאֶגְוָֽע׃

lines.text: Who is he who will contend with me? For then would I hold my peace and give up the spirit.
Who [is] he that doth strive with me? For now I keep silent and gasp.

13.he: אַךְ־שְׁ֭תַּיִם אַל־תַּ֣עַשׂ עִמָּדִ֑י אָ֥ז מִ֝פָּנֶ֗יךָ לֹ֣א אֶסָּתֵֽר׃

lines.text: “Only don’t do two things to me, then I will not hide myself from your face:
Only two things, O God, do with me: Then from Thy face I am not hidden.

13.he: כַּ֭פְּךָ מֵעָלַ֣י הַרְחַ֑ק וְ֝אֵ֥מָתְךָ֗ אַֽל־תְּבַעֲתַֽנִּי׃

lines.text: withdraw your hand far from me, and don’t let your terror make me afraid.
Thy hand put far off from me, And Thy terror let not terrify me.

13.he: וּ֭קְרָא וְאָנֹכִ֣י אֶֽעֱנֶ֑ה אֽוֹ־אֲ֝דַבֵּ֗ר וַהֲשִׁיבֵֽנִי׃

lines.text: Then call, and I will answer, or let me speak, and you answer me.
And call Thou, and I — I answer, Or — I speak, and answer Thou me.

13.he: כַּמָּ֣ה לִ֭י עֲוֺנ֣וֹת וְחַטָּא֑וֹת פִּֽשְׁעִ֥י וְ֝חַטָּאתִ֗י הֹדִיעֵֽנִי׃

lines.text: How many are my iniquities and sins? Make me know my disobedience and my sin.
How many iniquities and sins have I? My transgression and my sin let me know.

13.he: לָֽמָּה־פָנֶ֥יךָ תַסְתִּ֑יר וְתַחְשְׁבֵ֖נִי לְאוֹיֵ֣ב לָֽךְ׃

lines.text: Why do you hide your face, and consider me your enemy?
Why dost Thou hide Thy face? And reckonest me for an enemy to Thee?

13.he: הֶעָלֶ֣ה נִדָּ֣ף תַּעֲר֑וֹץ וְאֶת־קַ֖שׁ יָבֵ֣שׁ תִּרְדֹּֽף׃

lines.text: Will you harass a driven leaf? Will you pursue the dry stubble?
A leaf driven away dost Thou terrify? And the dry stubble dost Thou pursue?

13.he: כִּֽי־תִכְתֹּ֣ב עָלַ֣י מְרֹר֑וֹת וְ֝תוֹרִישֵׁ֗נִי עֲוֺנ֥וֹת נְעוּרָֽי׃

lines.text: For you write bitter things against me, and make me inherit the iniquities of my youth:
For Thou writest against me bitter things, And causest me to possess iniquities of my youth:

13.he: וְתָ֘שֵׂ֤ם בַּסַּ֨ד ׀ רַגְלַ֗י וְתִשְׁמ֥וֹר כָּל־אָרְחוֹתָ֑י עַל־שָׁרְשֵׁ֥י רַ֝גְלַ֗י תִּתְחַקֶּֽה׃

lines.text: You also put my feet in the stocks, and mark all my paths. You set a bound to the soles of my feet,
And puttest in the stocks my feet, And observest all my paths, On the roots of my feet Thou settest a print,

13.he: וְ֭הוּא כְּרָקָ֣ב יִבְלֶ֑ה כְּ֝בֶ֗גֶד אֲכָ֣לוֹ עָֽשׁ׃

lines.text: though I am decaying like a rotten thing, like a garment that is moth-eaten.
And he, as a rotten thing, weareth away, As a garment hath a moth consumed him.

14.he: אָ֭דָם יְל֣וּד אִשָּׁ֑ה קְצַ֥ר יָ֝מִ֗ים וּֽשְׂבַֽע־רֹֽגֶז׃

lines.text: “Man, who is born of a woman, is of few days, and full of trouble.
Man, born of woman! Of few days, and full of trouble!

14.he: כְּצִ֣יץ יָ֭צָא וַיִּמָּ֑ל וַיִּבְרַ֥ח כַּ֝צֵּ֗ל וְלֹ֣א יַעֲמֽוֹד׃

lines.text: He grows up like a flower, and is cut down. He also flees like a shadow, and doesn’t continue.
As a flower he hath gone forth, and is cut off, And he fleeth as a shadow and standeth not.

14.he: אַף־עַל־זֶ֭ה פָּקַ֣חְתָּ עֵינֶ֑ךָ וְאֹ֘תִ֤י תָבִ֖יא בְמִשְׁפָּ֣ט עִמָּֽךְ׃

lines.text: Do you open your eyes on such a one, and bring me into judgment with you?
Also — on this Thou hast opened Thine eyes, And dost bring me into judgment with Thee.

14.he: מִֽי־יִתֵּ֣ן טָ֭הוֹר מִטָּמֵ֗א לֹ֣א אֶחָֽד׃

lines.text: Who can bring a clean thing out of an unclean? Not one.
Who giveth a clean thing out of an unclean? not one.

14.he: אִ֥ם חֲרוּצִ֨ים ׀ יָמָ֗יו מִֽסְפַּר־חֳדָשָׁ֥יו אִתָּ֑ךְ חקו עָ֝שִׂ֗יתָ וְלֹ֣א יַעֲבֽוֹר׃

lines.text: Seeing his days are determined, the number of his months is with you, and you have appointed his bounds that he can’t pass;
If determined are his days, The number of his months [are] with Thee, His limit Thou hast made, And he passeth not over;

14.he: שְׁעֵ֣ה מֵעָלָ֣יו וְיֶחְדָּ֑ל עַד־יִ֝רְצֶ֗ה כְּשָׂכִ֥יר יוֹמֽוֹ׃

lines.text: Look away from him, that he may rest, until he accomplishes, as a hireling, his day.
Look away from off him that he may cease, Till he enjoy as an hireling his day.

14.he: כִּ֤י יֵ֥שׁ לָעֵ֗ץ תִּ֫קְוָ֥ה אִֽם־יִ֭כָּרֵת וְע֣וֹד יַחֲלִ֑יף וְ֝יֹֽנַקְתּ֗וֹ לֹ֣א תֶחְדָּֽל׃

lines.text: “For there is hope for a tree if it is cut down, that it will sprout again, that the tender branch of it will not cease.
For there is of a tree hope, if it be cut down, That again it doth change, That its tender branch doth not cease.

14.he: אִם־יַזְקִ֣ין בָּאָ֣רֶץ שָׁרְשׁ֑וֹ וּ֝בֶעָפָ֗ר יָמ֥וּת גִּזְעֽוֹ׃

lines.text: Though its root grows old in the earth, and its stock dies in the ground,
If its root becometh old in the earth, And its stem doth die in the dust,

14.he: מֵרֵ֣יַּח מַ֣יִם יַפְרִ֑חַ וְעָשָׂ֖ה קָצִ֣יר כְּמוֹ־נָֽטַע׃

lines.text: yet through the scent of water it will bud, and sprout boughs like a plant.
From the fragrance of water it doth flourish, And hath made a crop as a plant.

14.he: וְגֶ֣בֶר יָ֭מוּת וַֽיֶּחֱלָ֑שׁ וַיִּגְוַ֖ע אָדָ֣ם וְאַיּֽוֹ׃

lines.text: But man dies, and is laid low. Yes, man gives up the spirit, and where is he?
And a man dieth, and becometh weak, And man expireth, and where [is] he?

14.he: אָֽזְלוּ־מַ֭יִם מִנִּי־יָ֑ם וְ֝נָהָ֗ר יֶחֱרַ֥ב וְיָבֵֽשׁ׃

lines.text: As the waters fail from the sea, and the river wastes and dries up,
Waters have gone away from a sea, And a river becometh waste and dry.

14.he: וְאִ֥ישׁ שָׁכַ֗ב וְֽלֹא־יָ֫ק֥וּם עַד־בִּלְתִּ֣י שָׁ֭מַיִם לֹ֣א יָקִ֑יצוּ וְלֹֽא־יֵ֝עֹ֗רוּ מִשְּׁנָתָֽם׃

lines.text: so man lies down and doesn’t rise. Until the heavens are no more, they will not awake, nor be roused out of their sleep.
And man hath lain down, and riseth not, Till the wearing out of the heavens they awake not, Nor are roused from their sleep.

14.he: מִ֤י יִתֵּ֨ן ׀ בִּשְׁא֬וֹל תַּצְפִּנֵ֗נִי תַּ֭סְתִּירֵנִי עַד־שׁ֣וּב אַפֶּ֑ךָ תָּ֤שִׁ֥ית לִ֖י חֹ֣ק וְתִזְכְּרֵֽנִי׃

lines.text: “Oh that you would hide me in Sheol, that you would keep me secret until your wrath is past, that you would appoint me a set time and remember me!
O that in Sheol Thou wouldest conceal me, Hide me till the turning of Thine anger, Set for me a limit, and remember me.

14.he: אִם־יָמ֥וּת גֶּ֗בֶר הֲיִ֫חְיֶ֥ה כָּל־יְמֵ֣י צְבָאִ֣י אֲיַחֵ֑ל עַד־בּ֝֗וֹא חֲלִיפָתִֽי׃

lines.text: If a man dies, will he live again? I would wait all the days of my warfare, until my release should come.
If a man dieth — doth he revive? All days of my warfare I wait, till my change come.

14.he: תִּ֭קְרָא וְאָנֹכִ֣י אֶֽעֱנֶ֑ךָּ לְֽמַעֲשֵׂ֖ה יָדֶ֣יךָ תִכְסֹֽף׃

lines.text: You would call, and I would answer you. You would have a desire for the work of your hands.
Thou dost call, and I — I answer Thee; To the work of Thy hands Thou hast desire.

14.he: כִּֽי־עַ֭תָּה צְעָדַ֣י תִּסְפּ֑וֹר לֹֽא־תִ֝שְׁמ֗וֹר עַל־חַטָּאתִֽי׃

lines.text: But now you count my steps. Don’t you watch over my sin?
But now, my steps Thou numberest, Thou dost not watch over my sin.

14.he: חָתֻ֣ם בִּצְר֣וֹר פִּשְׁעִ֑י וַ֝תִּטְפֹּ֗ל עַל־עֲוֺנִֽי׃

lines.text: My disobedience is sealed up in a bag. You fasten up my iniquity.
Sealed up in a bag [is] my transgression, And Thou sewest up mine iniquity.

14.he: וְ֭אוּלָם הַר־נוֹפֵ֣ל יִבּ֑וֹל וְ֝צ֗וּר יֶעְתַּ֥ק מִמְּקֹמֽוֹ׃

lines.text: “But the mountain falling comes to nothing. The rock is removed out of its place;
And yet, a falling mountain wasteth away, And a rock is removed from its place.

14.he: אֲבָנִ֤ים ׀ שָׁ֥חֲקוּ מַ֗יִם תִּשְׁטֹֽף־סְפִיחֶ֥יהָ עֲפַר־אָ֑רֶץ וְתִקְוַ֖ת אֱנ֣וֹשׁ הֶאֱבַֽדְתָּ׃

lines.text: The waters wear the stones. The torrents of it wash away the dust of the earth. So you destroy the hope of man.
Stones have waters worn away, Their outpourings wash away the dust of earth, And the hope of man Thou hast destroyed.

14.he: תִּתְקְפֵ֣הוּ לָ֭נֶצַח וַֽיַּהֲלֹ֑ךְ מְשַׁנֶּ֥ה פָ֝נָ֗יו וַֽתְּשַׁלְּחֵֽהוּ׃

lines.text: You forever prevail against him, and he departs. You change his face, and send him away.
Thou prevailest [over] him for ever, and he goeth, He is changing his countenance, And Thou sendest him away.

14.he: יִכְבְּד֣וּ בָ֭נָיו וְלֹ֣א יֵדָ֑ע וְ֝יִצְעֲר֗וּ וְֽלֹא־יָבִ֥ין לָֽמוֹ׃

lines.text: His sons come to honor, and he doesn’t know it. They are brought low, but he doesn’t perceive it of them.
Honoured are his sons, and he knoweth not; And they are little, and he attendeth not to them.

14.he: אַךְ־בְּ֭שָׂרוֹ עָלָ֣יו יִכְאָ֑ב וְ֝נַפְשׁ֗וֹ עָלָ֥יו תֶּאֱבָֽל׃

lines.text: But his flesh on him has pain, and his soul within him mourns.”
Only — his flesh for him is pained, And his soul for him doth mourn.'

15.he: וַ֭יַּעַן אֱלִיפַ֥ז הַֽתֵּימָנִ֗י וַיֹּאמַֽר׃

lines.text: Then Eliphaz the Temanite answered,
And Eliphaz the Temanite answereth and saith: —

15.he: הֶֽחָכָ֗ם יַעֲנֶ֥ה דַֽעַת־ר֑וּחַ וִֽימַלֵּ֖א קָדִ֣ים בִּטְנֽוֹ׃

lines.text: “Should a wise man answer with vain knowledge, and fill himself with the east wind?
Doth a wise man answer [with] vain knowledge? And fill [with] an east wind his belly?

15.he: הוֹכֵ֣חַ בְּ֭דָבָר לֹ֣א יִסְכּ֑וֹן וּ֝מִלִּ֗ים לֹא־יוֹעִ֥יל בָּֽם׃

lines.text: Should he reason with unprofitable talk, or with speeches with which he can do no good?
To reason with a word not useful? And speeches — no profit in them?

15.he: אַף־אַ֭תָּה תָּפֵ֣ר יִרְאָ֑ה וְתִגְרַ֥ע שִׂ֝יחָ֗ה לִפְנֵי־אֵֽל׃

lines.text: Yes, you do away with fear, and hinder devotion before God.
Yea, thou dost make reverence void, And dost diminish meditation before God.

15.he: כִּ֤י יְאַלֵּ֣ף עֲוֺנְךָ֣ פִ֑יךָ וְ֝תִבְחַ֗ר לְשׁ֣וֹן עֲרוּמִֽים׃

lines.text: For your iniquity teaches your mouth, and you choose the language of the crafty.
For thy mouth teacheth thine iniquity, And thou chooseth the tongue of the subtile.

15.he: יַרְשִֽׁיעֲךָ֣ פִ֣יךָ וְלֹא־אָ֑נִי וּ֝שְׂפָתֶ֗יךָ יַעֲנוּ־בָֽךְ׃

lines.text: Your own mouth condemns you, and not I. Yes, your own lips testify against you.
Thy mouth declareth thee wicked, and not I, And thy lips testify against thee.

15.he: הֲרִאישׁ֣וֹן אָ֭דָם תִּוָּלֵ֑ד וְלִפְנֵ֖י גְבָע֣וֹת חוֹלָֽלְתָּ׃

lines.text: “Are you the first man who was born? Or were you brought out before the hills?
The first man art thou born? And before the heights wast thou formed?

15.he: הַבְס֣וֹד אֱל֣וֹהַ תִּשְׁמָ֑ע וְתִגְרַ֖ע אֵלֶ֣יךָ חָכְמָֽה׃

lines.text: Have you heard the secret counsel of God? Do you limit wisdom to yourself?
Of the secret counsel of God dost thou hear? And withdrawest thou unto thee wisdom?

15.he: מַה־יָּ֭דַעְתָּ וְלֹ֣א נֵדָ֑ע תָּ֝בִ֗ין וְֽלֹא־עִמָּ֥נוּ הֽוּא׃

lines.text: What do you know that we don’t know? What do you understand which is not in us?
What hast thou known, and we know not? Understandest thou — and it is not with us?

15.he: גַּם־שָׂ֣ב גַּם־יָשִׁ֣ישׁ בָּ֑נוּ כַּבִּ֖יר מֵאָבִ֣יךָ יָמִֽים׃

lines.text: With us are both the gray-headed and the very aged men, much elder than your father.
Both the gray-headed And the very aged [are] among us — Greater than thy father [in] days.

15.he: הַמְעַ֣ט מִ֭מְּךָ תַּנְחֻמ֣וֹת אֵ֑ל וְ֝דָבָ֗ר לָאַ֥ט עִמָּֽךְ׃

lines.text: Are the consolations of God too small for you, even the word that is gentle toward you?
Too few for thee are the comforts of God? And a gentle word [is] with thee,

15.he: מַה־יִּקָּחֲךָ֥ לִבֶּ֑ךָ וּֽמַה־יִּרְזְמ֥וּן עֵינֶֽיךָ׃

lines.text: Why does your heart carry you away? Why do your eyes flash,
What — doth thine heart take thee away? And what — are thine eyes high?

15.he: כִּֽי־תָשִׁ֣יב אֶל־אֵ֣ל רוּחֶ֑ךָ וְהֹצֵ֖אתָ מִפִּ֣יךָ מִלִּֽין׃

lines.text: That you turn your spirit against God, and let such words go out of your mouth?
For thou turnest against God thy spirit? And hast brought out words from thy mouth:

15.he: מָֽה־אֱנ֥וֹשׁ כִּֽי־יִזְכֶּ֑ה וְכִֽי־יִ֝צְדַּ֗ק יְל֣וּד אִשָּֽׁה׃

lines.text: What is man, that he should be clean? What is he who is born of a woman, that he should be righteous?
What [is] man that he is pure, And that he is righteous, one born of woman?

15.he: הֵ֣ן בקדשו לֹ֣א יַאֲמִ֑ין וְ֝שָׁמַ֗יִם לֹא־זַכּ֥וּ בְעֵינָֽיו׃

lines.text: Behold, he puts no trust in his holy ones. Yes, the heavens are not clean in his sight;
Lo, in His holy ones He putteth no credence, And the heavens have not been pure in His eyes.

15.he: אַ֭ף כִּֽי־נִתְעָ֥ב וְֽנֶאֱלָ֑ח אִישׁ־שֹׁתֶ֖ה כַמַּ֣יִם עַוְלָֽה׃

lines.text: how much less one who is abominable and corrupt, a man who drinks iniquity like water!
Also — surely abominable and filthy Is man drinking as water perverseness.

15.he: אֲחַוְךָ֥ שְֽׁמַֽע־לִ֑י וְזֶֽה־חָ֝זִ֗יתִי וַאֲסַפֵּֽרָה׃

lines.text: “I will show you, listen to me; that which I have seen I will declare
I shew thee — hearken to me — And this I have seen and declare:

15.he: אֲשֶׁר־חֲכָמִ֥ים יַגִּ֑ידוּ וְלֹ֥א כִֽ֝חֲד֗וּ מֵאֲבוֹתָֽם׃

lines.text: (which wise men have told by their fathers, and have not hidden it;
Which the wise declare — And have not hid — from their fathers.

15.he: לָהֶ֣ם לְ֭בַדָּם נִתְּנָ֣ה הָאָ֑רֶץ וְלֹא־עָ֖בַר זָ֣ר בְּתוֹכָֽם׃

lines.text: to whom alone the land was given, and no stranger passed among them):
To them alone was the land given, And a stranger passed not over into their midst:

15.he: כָּל־יְמֵ֣י רָ֭שָׁע ה֣וּא מִתְחוֹלֵ֑ל וּמִסְפַּ֥ר שָׁ֝נִ֗ים נִצְפְּנ֥וּ לֶעָרִֽיץ׃

lines.text: the wicked man writhes in pain all his days, even the number of years that are laid up for the oppressor.
'All days of the wicked he is paining himself, And few years have been laid up for the terrible one.

15.he: קוֹל־פְּחָדִ֥ים בְּאָזְנָ֑יו בַּ֝שָּׁל֗וֹם שׁוֹדֵ֥ד יְבוֹאֶֽנּוּ׃

lines.text: A sound of terrors is in his ears. In prosperity the destroyer will come on him.
A fearful voice [is] in his ears, In peace doth a destroyer come to him.

15.he: לֹא־יַאֲמִ֣ין שׁ֭וּב מִנִּי־חֹ֑שֶׁךְ וצפו ה֣וּא אֱלֵי־חָֽרֶב׃

lines.text: He doesn’t believe that he will return out of darkness. He is waited for by the sword.
He believeth not to return from darkness, And watched [is] he for the sword.

15.he: נֹ֘דֵ֤ד ה֣וּא לַלֶּ֣חֶם אַיֵּ֑ה יָדַ֓ע ׀ כִּֽי־נָכ֖וֹן בְּיָד֣וֹ יֽוֹם־חֹֽשֶׁךְ׃

lines.text: He wanders abroad for bread, saying, ‘Where is it?’ He knows that the day of darkness is ready at his hand.
He is wandering for bread — 'Where [is] it?' He hath known that ready at his hand Is a day of darkness.

15.he: יְֽ֭בַעֲתֻהוּ צַ֣ר וּמְצוּקָ֑ה תִּ֝תְקְפֵ֗הוּ כְּמֶ֤לֶךְ ׀ עָתִ֬יד לַכִּידֽוֹר׃

lines.text: Distress and anguish make him afraid. They prevail against him, as a king ready to the battle.
Terrify him do adversity and distress, They prevail over him As a king ready for a boaster.

15.he: כִּֽי־נָטָ֣ה אֶל־אֵ֣ל יָד֑וֹ וְאֶל־שַׁ֝דַּ֗י יִתְגַּבָּֽר׃

lines.text: Because he has stretched out his hand against God, and behaves himself proudly against the Almighty,
For he stretched out against God his hand, And against the Mighty he maketh himself mighty.

15.he: יָר֣וּץ אֵלָ֣יו בְּצַוָּ֑אר בַּ֝עֲבִ֗י גַּבֵּ֥י מָֽגִנָּֽיו׃

lines.text: he runs at him with a stiff neck, with the thick shields of his bucklers,
He runneth unto Him with a neck, With thick bosses of his shields.

15.he: כִּֽי־כִסָּ֣ה פָנָ֣יו בְּחֶלְבּ֑וֹ וַיַּ֖עַשׂ פִּימָ֣ה עֲלֵי־כָֽסֶל׃

lines.text: because he has covered his face with his fatness, and gathered fat on his thighs.
For he hath covered his face with his fat, And maketh vigour over [his] confidence.

15.he: וַיִּשְׁכּ֤וֹן ׀ עָ֘רִ֤ים נִכְחָד֗וֹת בָּ֭תִּים לֹא־יֵ֣שְׁבוּ לָ֑מוֹ אֲשֶׁ֖ר הִתְעַתְּד֣וּ לְגַלִּֽים׃

lines.text: He has lived in desolate cities, in houses which no one inhabited, which were ready to become heaps.
And he inhabiteth cities cut off, houses not dwelt in, That have been ready to become heaps.

15.he: לֹֽא־יֶ֭עְשַׁר וְלֹא־יָק֣וּם חֵיל֑וֹ וְלֹֽא־יִטֶּ֖ה לָאָ֣רֶץ מִנְלָֽם׃

lines.text: He will not be rich, neither will his substance continue, neither will their possessions be extended on the earth.
He is not rich, nor doth his wealth rise, Nor doth he stretch out on earth their continuance.

15.he: לֹֽא־יָס֨וּר ׀ מִנִּי־חֹ֗שֶׁךְ יֹֽ֭נַקְתּוֹ תְּיַבֵּ֣שׁ שַׁלְהָ֑בֶת וְ֝יָס֗וּר בְּר֣וּחַ פִּֽיו׃

lines.text: He will not depart out of darkness. The flame will dry up his branches. He will go away by the breath of God’s mouth.
He turneth not aside from darkness, His tender branch doth a flame dry up, And he turneth aside at the breath of His mouth!

15.he: אַל־יַאֲמֵ֣ן בשו נִתְעָ֑ה כִּי־שָׁ֝֗וְא תִּהְיֶ֥ה תְמוּרָתֽוֹ׃

lines.text: Let him not trust in emptiness, deceiving himself; for emptiness will be his reward.
Let him not put credence in vanity, He hath been deceived, For vanity is his recompence.

15.he: בְּֽלֹא־י֭וֹמוֹ תִּמָּלֵ֑א וְ֝כִפָּת֗וֹ לֹ֣א רַעֲנָֽנָה׃

lines.text: It will be accomplished before his time. His branch will not be green.
Not in his day is it completed, And his bending branch is not green.

15.he: יַחְמֹ֣ס כַּגֶּ֣פֶן בִּסְר֑וֹ וְיַשְׁלֵ֥ךְ כַּ֝זַּ֗יִת נִצָּתֽוֹ׃

lines.text: He will shake off his unripe grape as the vine, and will cast off his flower as the olive tree.
He shaketh off as a vine his unripe fruit, And casteth off as an olive his blossom.

15.he: כִּֽי־עֲדַ֣ת חָנֵ֣ף גַּלְמ֑וּד וְ֝אֵ֗שׁ אָכְלָ֥ה אָֽהֳלֵי־שֹֽׁ֥חַד׃

lines.text: For the company of the godless will be barren, and fire will consume the tents of bribery.
For the company of the profane [is] gloomy, And fire hath consumed tents of bribery.

15.he: הָרֹ֣ה עָ֭מָל וְיָ֣לֹד אָ֑וֶן וּ֝בִטְנָ֗ם תָּכִ֥ין מִרְמָֽה׃

lines.text: They conceive mischief, and produce iniquity. Their heart prepares deceit.”
To conceive misery, and to bear iniquity, Even their heart doth prepare deceit.

16.he: וַיַּ֥עַן אִיּ֗וֹב וַיֹּאמַֽר׃

lines.text: Then Job answered,
And Job answereth and saith: —

16.he: שָׁמַ֣עְתִּי כְאֵ֣לֶּה רַבּ֑וֹת מְנַחֲמֵ֖י עָמָ֣ל כֻּלְּכֶֽם׃

lines.text: “I have heard many such things. You are all miserable comforters!
I have heard many such things, Miserable comforters [are] ye all.

16.he: הֲקֵ֥ץ לְדִבְרֵי־ר֑וּחַ א֥וֹ מַה־יַּ֝מְרִֽיצְךָ֗ כִּ֣י תַעֲנֶֽה׃

lines.text: Shall vain words have an end? Or what provokes you that you answer?
Is there an end to words of wind? Or what doth embolden thee that thou answerest?

16.he: גַּ֤ם ׀ אָנֹכִי֮ כָּכֶ֪ם אֲדַ֫בֵּ֥רָה ל֤וּ־יֵ֪שׁ נַפְשְׁכֶ֡ם תַּ֤חַת נַפְשִׁ֗י אַחְבִּ֣ירָה עֲלֵיכֶ֣ם בְּמִלִּ֑ים וְאָנִ֥יעָה עֲ֝לֵיכֶ֗ם בְּמ֣וֹ רֹאשִֽׁי׃

lines.text: I also could speak as you do. If your soul were in my soul’s place, I could join words together against you, and shake my head at you,
I also, like you, might speak, If your soul were in my soul's stead. I might join against you with words, And nod at you with my head.

16.he: אֲאַמִּצְכֶ֥ם בְּמוֹ־פִ֑י וְנִ֖יד שְׂפָתַ֣י יַחְשֹֽׂךְ׃

lines.text: but I would strengthen you with my mouth. The solace of my lips would relieve you.
I might harden you with my mouth, And the moving of my lips might be sparing.

16.he: אִֽם־אֲ֭דַבְּרָה לֹא־יֵחָשֵׂ֣ךְ כְּאֵבִ֑י וְ֝אַחְדְּלָ֗ה מַה־מִנִּ֥י יַהֲלֹֽךְ׃

lines.text: “Though I speak, my grief is not subsided. Though I forbear, what am I eased?
If I speak, my pain is not restrained, And I cease — what goeth from me?

16.he: אַךְ־עַתָּ֥ה הֶלְאָ֑נִי הֲ֝שִׁמּ֗וֹתָ כָּל־עֲדָתִֽי׃

lines.text: But now, God, you have surely worn me out. You have made all my company desolate.
Only, now, it hath wearied me; Thou hast desolated all my company,

16.he: וַֽ֭תִּקְמְטֵנִי לְעֵ֣ד הָיָ֑ה וַיָּ֥קָם בִּ֥י כַ֝חֲשִׁ֗י בְּפָנַ֥י יַעֲנֶֽה׃

lines.text: You have shriveled me up. This is a witness against me. My leanness rises up against me. It testifies to my face.
And Thou dost loathe me, For a witness it hath been, And rise up against me doth my failure, In my face it testifieth.

16.he: אַפּ֤וֹ טָרַ֨ף ׀ וַֽיִּשְׂטְמֵ֗נִי חָרַ֣ק עָלַ֣י בְּשִׁנָּ֑יו צָרִ֓י ׀ יִלְט֖וֹשׁ עֵינָ֣יו לִֽי׃

lines.text: He has torn me in his wrath and persecuted me. He has gnashed on me with his teeth. My adversary sharpens his eyes on me.
His anger hath torn, and he hateth me, He hath gnashed at me with his teeth, My adversary sharpeneth his eyes for me.

16.he: פָּעֲר֬וּ עָלַ֨י ׀ בְּפִיהֶ֗ם בְּ֭חֶרְפָּה הִכּ֣וּ לְחָיָ֑י יַ֝֗חַד עָלַ֥י יִתְמַלָּאֽוּן׃

lines.text: They have gaped on me with their mouth. They have struck me on the cheek reproachfully. They gather themselves together against me.
They have gaped on me with their mouth, In reproach they have smitten my cheeks, Together against me they set themselves.

16.he: יַסְגִּירֵ֣נִי אֵ֭ל אֶ֣ל עֲוִ֑יל וְעַל־יְדֵ֖י רְשָׁעִ֣ים יִרְטֵֽנִי׃

lines.text: God delivers me to the ungodly, and casts me into the hands of the wicked.
God shutteth me up unto the perverse, And to the hands of the wicked turneth me over.

16.he: שָׁ֘לֵ֤ו הָיִ֨יתִי ׀ וַֽיְפַרְפְּרֵ֗נִי וְאָחַ֣ז בְּ֭עָרְפִּי וַֽיְפַצְפְּצֵ֑נִי וַיְקִימֵ֥נִי ל֝֗וֹ לְמַטָּרָֽה׃

lines.text: I was at ease, and he broke me apart. Yes, he has taken me by the neck, and dashed me to pieces. He has also set me up for his target.
At ease I have been, and he breaketh me, And he hath laid hold on my neck, And he breaketh me in pieces, And he raiseth me to him for a mark.

16.he: יָ֘סֹ֤בּוּ עָלַ֨י ׀ רַבָּ֗יו יְפַלַּ֣ח כִּ֭לְיוֹתַי וְלֹ֣א יַחְמ֑וֹל יִשְׁפֹּ֥ךְ לָ֝אָ֗רֶץ מְרֵרָֽתִי׃

lines.text: His archers surround me. He splits my kidneys apart, and does not spare. He pours out my bile on the ground.
Go round against me do his archers. He splitteth my reins, and spareth not, He poureth out to the earth my gall.

16.he: יִפְרְצֵ֣נִי פֶ֭רֶץ עַל־פְּנֵי־פָ֑רֶץ יָרֻ֖ץ עָלַ֣י כְּגִבּֽוֹר׃

lines.text: He breaks me with breach on breach. He runs at me like a giant.
He breaketh me — breach upon breach, He runneth upon me as a mighty one.

16.he: שַׂ֣ק תָּ֭פַרְתִּי עֲלֵ֣י גִלְדִּ֑י וְעֹלַ֖לְתִּי בֶעָפָ֣ר קַרְנִֽי׃

lines.text: I have sewed sackcloth on my skin, and have thrust my horn in the dust.
Sackcloth I have sewed on my skin, And have rolled in the dust my horn.

16.he: פָּנַ֣י חמרמרה מִנִּי־בֶ֑כִי וְעַ֖ל עַפְעַפַּ֣י צַלְמָֽוֶת׃

lines.text: My face is red with weeping. Deep darkness is on my eyelids.
My face is foul with weeping, And on mine eyelids [is] death-shade.

16.he: עַ֭ל לֹא־חָמָ֣ס בְּכַפָּ֑י וּֽתְפִלָּתִ֥י זַכָּֽה׃

lines.text: Although there is no violence in my hands, and my prayer is pure.
Not for violence in my hands, And my prayer [is] pure.

16.he: אֶ֭רֶץ אַל־תְּכַסִּ֣י דָמִ֑י וְֽאַל־יְהִ֥י מָ֝ק֗וֹם לְזַעֲקָתִֽי׃

lines.text: “Earth, don’t cover my blood. Let my cry have no place to rest.
O earth, do not thou cover my blood! And let there not be a place for my cry.

16.he: גַּם־עַ֭תָּה הִנֵּה־בַשָּׁמַ֣יִם עֵדִ֑י וְ֝שָׂהֲדִ֗י בַּמְּרוֹמִֽים׃

lines.text: Even now, behold, my witness is in heaven. He who vouches for me is on high.
Also, now, lo, in the heavens [is] my witness, And my testifier in the high places.

16.he: מְלִיצַ֥י רֵעָ֑י אֶל־אֱ֝ל֗וֹהַ דָּלְפָ֥ה עֵינִֽי׃

lines.text: My friends scoff at me. My eyes pour out tears to God,
My interpreter [is] my friend, Unto God hath mine eye dropped:

16.he: וְיוֹכַ֣ח לְגֶ֣בֶר עִם־אֱל֑וֹהַּ וּֽבֶן־אָדָ֥ם לְרֵעֵֽהוּ׃

lines.text: that he would maintain the right of a man with God, of a son of man with his neighbor!
And he reasoneth for a man with God, And a son of man for his friend.

16.he: כִּֽי־שְׁנ֣וֹת מִסְפָּ֣ר יֶאֱתָ֑יוּ וְאֹ֖רַח לֹא־אָשׁ֣וּב אֶהֱלֹֽךְ׃

lines.text: For when a few years have come, I will go the way of no return.
When a few years do come, Then a path I return not do I go.

17.he: רוּחִ֣י חֻ֭בָּלָה יָמַ֥י נִזְעָ֗כוּ קְבָרִ֥ים לִֽי׃

lines.text: “My spirit is consumed. My days are extinct, and the grave is ready for me.
My spirit hath been destroyed, My days extinguished — graves [are] for me.

17.he: אִם־לֹ֣א הֲ֭תֻלִים עִמָּדִ֑י וּ֝בְהַמְּרוֹתָ֗ם תָּלַ֥ן עֵינִֽי׃

lines.text: Surely there are mockers with me. My eye dwells on their provocation.
If not — mockeries [are] with me. And in their provocations mine eye lodgeth.

17.he: שִֽׂימָה־נָּ֭א עָרְבֵ֣נִי עִמָּ֑ךְ מִֽי ה֝֗וּא לְיָדִ֥י יִתָּקֵֽעַ׃

lines.text: “Now give a pledge. Be collateral for me with yourself. Who is there who will strike hands with me?
Place, I pray Thee, my pledge with Thee; Who is he that striketh hand with me?

17.he: כִּֽי־לִ֭בָּם צָפַ֣נְתָּ מִּשָּׂ֑כֶל עַל־כֵּ֝֗ן לֹ֣א תְרֹמֵֽם׃

lines.text: For you have hidden their heart from understanding, Therefore you will not exalt them.
For their heart Thou hast hidden From understanding, Therefore Thou dost not exalt them.

17.he: לְ֭חֵלֶק יַגִּ֣יד רֵעִ֑ים וְעֵינֵ֖י בָנָ֣יו תִּכְלֶֽנָה׃

lines.text: He who denounces his friends for plunder, Even the eyes of his children will fail.
For a portion he sheweth friendship, And the eyes of his sons are consumed.

17.he: וְֽ֭הִצִּגַנִי לִמְשֹׁ֣ל עַמִּ֑ים וְתֹ֖פֶת לְפָנִ֣ים אֶֽהְיֶֽה׃

lines.text: “But he has made me a byword of the people. They spit in my face.
And he set me up for a proverb of the peoples, And a wonder before them I am.

17.he: וַתֵּ֣כַהּ מִכַּ֣עַשׂ עֵינִ֑י וִֽיצֻרַ֖י כַּצֵּ֣ל כֻּלָּֽם׃

lines.text: My eye also is dim by reason of sorrow. All my members are as a shadow.
And dim from sorrow is mine eye, And my members as a shadow all of them.

17.he: יָשֹׁ֣מּוּ יְשָׁרִ֣ים עַל־זֹ֑את וְ֝נָקִ֗י עַל־חָנֵ֥ף יִתְעֹרָֽר׃

lines.text: Upright men will be astonished at this. The innocent will stir himself up against the godless.
Astonished are the upright at this, And the innocent against the profane Stirreth himself up.

17.he: וְיֹאחֵ֣ז צַדִּ֣יק דַּרְכּ֑וֹ וּֽטֳהָר־יָ֝דַ֗יִם יֹסִ֥יף אֹֽמֶץ׃

lines.text: Yet the righteous will hold to his way. He who has clean hands will grow stronger and stronger.
And the righteous layeth hold [on] his way, And the clean of hands addeth strength, And — dumb are they all.

17.he: וְֽאוּלָ֗ם כֻּלָּ֣ם תָּ֭שֻׁבוּ וּבֹ֣אוּ נָ֑א וְלֹֽא־אֶמְצָ֖א בָכֶ֣ם חָכָֽם׃

lines.text: But as for you all, come back. I will not find a wise man among you.
Return, and come in, I pray you, And I find not among you a wise man.

17.he: יָמַ֣י עָ֭בְרוּ זִמֹּתַ֣י נִתְּק֑וּ מ֖וֹרָשֵׁ֣י לְבָבִֽי׃

lines.text: My days are past. My plans are broken off, as are the thoughts of my heart.
My days have passed by, My devices have been broken off, The possessions of my heart!

17.he: לַ֭יְלָה לְי֣וֹם יָשִׂ֑ימוּ א֝֗וֹר קָר֥וֹב מִפְּנֵי־חֹֽשֶׁךְ׃

lines.text: They change the night into day, saying ‘The light is near’ in the presence of darkness.
Night for day they appoint, Light [is] near because of darkness.

17.he: אִם־אֲ֭קַוֶּה שְׁא֣וֹל בֵּיתִ֑י בַּ֝חֹ֗שֶׁךְ רִפַּ֥דְתִּי יְצוּעָֽי׃

lines.text: If I look for Sheol as my house, if I have spread my couch in the darkness,
If I wait — Sheol [is] my house, In darkness I have spread out my couch.

17.he: לַשַּׁ֣חַת קָ֭רָאתִי אָ֣בִי אָ֑תָּה אִמִּ֥י וַ֝אֲחֹתִ֗י לָֽרִמָּֽה׃

lines.text: if I have said to corruption, ‘You are my father;’ to the worm, ‘My mother,’ and ‘My sister,’
To corruption I have called: — 'Thou [art] my father.' 'My mother' and 'my sister' — to the worm.

17.he: וְ֭אַיֵּה אֵפ֣וֹ תִקְוָתִ֑י וְ֝תִקְוָתִ֗י מִ֣י יְשׁוּרֶֽנָּה׃

lines.text: where then is my hope? as for my hope, who will see it?
And where [is] now my hope? Yea, my hope, who doth behold it?

17.he: בַּדֵּ֣י שְׁאֹ֣ל תֵּרַ֑דְנָה אִם־יַ֖חַד עַל־עָפָ֣ר נָֽחַת׃

lines.text: Shall it go down with me to the gates of Sheol, or descend together into the dust?”
[To] the parts of Sheol ye go down, If together on the dust we may rest.

18.he: וַ֭יַּעַן בִּלְדַּ֥ד הַשֻּׁחִ֗י וַיֹּאמַֽר׃

lines.text: Then Bildad the Shuhite answered,
And Bildad the Shuhite answereth and saith: —

18.he: עַד־אָ֤נָה ׀ תְּשִׂימ֣וּן קִנְצֵ֣י לְמִלִּ֑ין תָּ֝בִ֗ינוּ וְאַחַ֥ר נְדַבֵּֽר׃

lines.text: “How long will you hunt for words? Consider, and afterwards we will speak.
When do ye set an end to words? Consider ye, and afterwards do we speak.

18.he: מַ֭דּוּעַ נֶחְשַׁ֣בְנוּ כַבְּהֵמָ֑ה נִ֝טְמִ֗ינוּ בְּעֵינֵיכֶֽם׃

lines.text: Why are we counted as animals, which have become unclean in your sight?
Wherefore have we been reckoned as cattle? We have been defiled in your eyes!

18.he: טֹֽרֵ֥ף נַפְשׁ֗וֹ בְּאַ֫פּ֥וֹ הֲ֭לְמַּעַנְךָ תֵּעָ֣זַב אָ֑רֶץ וְיֶעְתַּק־צ֝֗וּר מִמְּקֹמֽוֹ׃

lines.text: You who tear yourself in your anger, will the earth be forsaken for you? Or will the rock be removed out of its place?
(He is tearing himself in his anger.) For thy sake is earth forsaken? And removed is a rock from its place?

18.he: גַּ֤ם א֣וֹר רְשָׁעִ֣ים יִדְעָ֑ךְ וְלֹֽא־יִ֝גַּ֗הּ שְׁבִ֣יב אִשּֽׁוֹ׃

lines.text: “Yes, the light of the wicked will be put out. The spark of his fire won’t shine.
Also, the light of the wicked is extinguished. And there doth not shine a spark of his fire.

18.he: א֭וֹר חָשַׁ֣ךְ בְּאָהֳל֑וֹ וְ֝נֵר֗וֹ עָלָ֥יו יִדְעָֽךְ׃

lines.text: The light will be dark in his tent. His lamp above him will be put out.
The light hath been dark in his tent, And his lamp over him is extinguished.

18.he: יֵֽ֭צְרוּ צַעֲדֵ֣י אוֹנ֑וֹ וְֽתַשְׁלִיכֵ֥הוּ עֲצָתֽוֹ׃

lines.text: The steps of his strength will be shortened. His own counsel will cast him down.
Straitened are the steps of his strength, And cast him down doth his own counsel.

18.he: כִּֽי־שֻׁלַּ֣ח בְּרֶ֣שֶׁת בְּרַגְלָ֑יו וְעַל־שְׂ֝בָכָ֗ה יִתְהַלָּֽךְ׃

lines.text: For he is cast into a net by his own feet, and he wanders into its mesh.
For he is sent into a net by his own feet, And on a snare he doth walk habitually.

18.he: יֹאחֵ֣ז בְּעָקֵ֣ב פָּ֑ח יַחֲזֵ֖ק עָלָ֣יו צַמִּֽים׃

lines.text: A snare will take him by the heel. A trap will catch him.
Seize on the heel doth a gin, Prevail over him do the designing.

18.he: טָמ֣וּן בָּאָ֣רֶץ חַבְל֑וֹ וּ֝מַלְכֻּדְתּ֗וֹ עֲלֵ֣י נָתִֽיב׃

lines.text: A noose is hidden for him in the ground, a trap for him on the path.
Hidden in the earth is his cord, And his trap on the path.

18.he: סָ֭בִיב בִּֽעֲתֻ֣הוּ בַלָּה֑וֹת וֶהֱפִיצֻ֥הוּ לְרַגְלָֽיו׃

lines.text: Terrors will make him afraid on every side, and will chase him at his heels.
Round about terrified him have terrors, And they have scattered him — at his feet.

18.he: יְהִי־רָעֵ֥ב אֹנ֑וֹ וְ֝אֵ֗יד נָכ֥וֹן לְצַלְעֽוֹ׃

lines.text: His strength will be famished. Calamity will be ready at his side.
Hungry is his sorrow, And calamity is ready at his side.

18.he: יֹ֭אכַל בַּדֵּ֣י עוֹר֑וֹ יֹאכַ֥ל בַּ֝דָּ֗יו בְּכ֣וֹר מָֽוֶת׃

lines.text: The members of his body will be devoured. The firstborn of death will devour his members.
It consumeth the parts of his skin, Consume his parts doth death's first-born.

18.he: יִנָּתֵ֣ק מֵ֭אָהֳלוֹ מִבְטַח֑וֹ וְ֝תַצְעִדֵ֗הוּ לְמֶ֣לֶךְ בַּלָּהֽוֹת׃

lines.text: He will be rooted out of the security of his tent. He will be brought to the king of terrors.
Drawn from his tent is his confidence, And it causeth him to step to the king of terrors.

18.he: תִּשְׁכּ֣וֹן בְּ֭אָהֳלוֹ מִבְּלִי־ל֑וֹ יְזֹרֶ֖ה עַל־נָוֵ֣הוּ גָפְרִֽית׃

lines.text: There will dwell in his tent that which is none of his. Sulfur will be scattered on his habitation.
It dwelleth in his tent — out of his provender, Scattered over his habitation is sulphur.

18.he: מִ֭תַּחַת שָֽׁרָשָׁ֣יו יִבָ֑שׁוּ וּ֝מִמַּ֗עַל יִמַּ֥ל קְצִירֽוֹ׃

lines.text: His roots will be dried up beneath. His branch will be cut off above.
From beneath his roots are dried up, And from above cut off is his crop.

18.he: זִֽכְרוֹ־אָ֭בַד מִנִּי־אָ֑רֶץ וְלֹא־שֵׁ֥ם ל֝֗וֹ עַל־פְּנֵי־חֽוּץ׃

lines.text: His memory will perish from the earth. He will have no name in the street.
His memorial hath perished from the land, And he hath no name on the street.

18.he: יֶ֭הְדְּפֻהוּ מֵא֣וֹר אֶל־חֹ֑שֶׁךְ וּֽמִתֵּבֵ֥ל יְנִדֻּֽהוּ׃

lines.text: He will be driven from light into darkness, and chased out of the world.
They thrust him from light unto darkness, And from the habitable earth cast him out.

18.he: לֹ֘א נִ֤ין ל֣וֹ וְלֹא־נֶ֣כֶד בְּעַמּ֑וֹ וְאֵ֥ין שָׂ֝רִ֗יד בִּמְגוּרָֽיו׃

lines.text: He will have neither son nor grandson among his people, nor any remaining where he lived.
He hath no continuator, Nor successor among his people, And none is remaining in his dwellings.

18.he: עַל־י֭וֹמוֹ נָשַׁ֣מּוּ אַחֲרֹנִ֑ים וְ֝קַדְמֹנִ֗ים אָ֣חֲזוּ שָֽׂעַר׃

lines.text: Those who come after will be astonished at his day, as those who went before were frightened.
At this day westerns have been astonished And easterns have taken fright.

18.he: אַךְ־אֵ֭לֶּה מִשְׁכְּנ֣וֹת עַוָּ֑ל וְ֝זֶ֗ה מְק֣וֹם לֹא־יָדַֽע־אֵֽל׃

lines.text: Surely such are the dwellings of the unrighteous. This is the place of him who doesn’t know God.”
Only these [are] tabernacles of the perverse, And this the place God hath not known.

19.he: וַיַּ֥עַן אִיּ֗וֹב וַיֹּאמַֽר׃

lines.text: Then Job answered,
And Job answereth and saith: —

19.he: עַד־אָ֭נָה תּוֹגְי֣וּן נַפְשִׁ֑י וּֽתְדַכּאוּנַ֥נִי בְמִלִּֽים׃

lines.text: “How long will you torment me, and crush me with words?
Till when do ye afflict my soul, And bruise me with words?

19.he: זֶ֤ה עֶ֣שֶׂר פְּ֭עָמִים תַּכְלִימ֑וּנִי לֹֽא־תֵ֝בֹ֗שׁוּ תַּהְכְּרוּ־לִֽי׃

lines.text: You have reproached me ten times. You aren’t ashamed that you attack me.
These ten times ye put me to shame, ye blush not. Ye make yourselves strange to me —

19.he: וְאַף־אָמְנָ֥ם שָׁגִ֑יתִי אִ֝תִּ֗י תָּלִ֥ין מְשׁוּגָתִֽי׃

lines.text: If it is true that I have erred, my error remains with myself.
And also — truly, I have erred, With me doth my error remain.

19.he: אִם־אָ֭מְנָם עָלַ֣י תַּגְדִּ֑ילוּ וְתוֹכִ֥יחוּ עָ֝לַ֗י חֶרְפָּתִּֽי׃

lines.text: If indeed you will magnify yourselves against me, and plead against me my reproach,
If, truly, over me ye magnify yourselves, And decide against me my reproach;

19.he: דְּֽעוּ־אֵ֭פוֹ כִּי־אֱל֣וֹהַּ עִוְּתָ֑נִי וּ֝מְצוּד֗וֹ עָלַ֥י הִקִּֽיף׃

lines.text: know now that God has subverted me, and has surrounded me with his net.
Know now, that God turned me upside down, And His net against me hath set round,

19.he: הֵ֤ן אֶצְעַ֣ק חָ֭מָס וְלֹ֣א אֵעָנֶ֑ה אֲ֝שַׁוַּ֗ע וְאֵ֣ין מִשְׁפָּֽט׃

lines.text: “Behold, I cry out of wrong, but I am not heard. I cry for help, but there is no justice.
Lo, I cry out — violence, and am not answered, I cry aloud, and there is no judgment.

19.he: אָרְחִ֣י גָ֭דַר וְלֹ֣א אֶעֱב֑וֹר וְעַ֥ל נְ֝תִיבוֹתַ֗י חֹ֣שֶׁךְ יָשִֽׂים׃

lines.text: He has walled up my way so that I can’t pass, and has set darkness in my paths.
My way He hedged up, and I pass not over, And on my paths darkness He placeth.

19.he: כְּ֭בוֹדִי מֵעָלַ֣י הִפְשִׁ֑יט וַ֝יָּ֗סַר עֲטֶ֣רֶת רֹאשִֽׁי׃

lines.text: He has stripped me of my glory, and taken the crown from my head.
Mine honour from off me He hath stripped, And He turneth the crown from my head.

19.he: יִתְּצֵ֣נִי סָ֭בִיב וָאֵלַ֑ךְ וַיַּסַּ֥ע כָּ֝עֵ֗ץ תִּקְוָתִֽי׃

lines.text: He has broken me down on every side, and I am gone. He has plucked my hope up like a tree.
He breaketh me down round about, and I go, And removeth like a tree my hope.

19.he: וַיַּ֣חַר עָלַ֣י אַפּ֑וֹ וַיַּחְשְׁבֵ֖נִי ל֣וֹ כְצָרָֽיו׃

lines.text: He has also kindled his wrath against me. He counts me among his adversaries.
And He kindleth against me His anger, And reckoneth me to Him as His adversaries.

19.he: יַ֤חַד ׀ יָ֘בֹ֤אוּ גְדוּדָ֗יו וַיָּסֹ֣לּוּ עָלַ֣י דַּרְכָּ֑ם וַיַּחֲנ֖וּ סָבִ֣יב לְאָהֳלִֽי׃

lines.text: His troops come on together, build a siege ramp against me, and encamp around my tent.
Come in do His troops together, And they raise up against me their way, And encamp round about my tent.

19.he: אַ֭חַי מֵעָלַ֣י הִרְחִ֑יק וְ֝יֹדְעַ֗י אַךְ־זָ֥רוּ מִמֶּֽנִּי׃

lines.text: “He has put my brothers far from me. My acquaintances are wholly estranged from me.
My brethren from me He hath put far off, And mine acquaintances surely Have been estranged from me.

19.he: חָדְל֥וּ קְרוֹבָ֑י וּֽמְיֻדָּעַ֥י שְׁכֵחֽוּנִי׃

lines.text: My relatives have gone away. My familiar friends have forgotten me.
Ceased have my neighbours And my familiar friends have forgotten me,

19.he: גָּ֘רֵ֤י בֵיתִ֣י וְ֭אַמְהֹתַי לְזָ֣ר תַּחְשְׁבֻ֑נִי נָ֝כְרִ֗י הָיִ֥יתִי בְעֵינֵיהֶֽם׃

lines.text: Those who dwell in my house and my maids consider me a stranger. I am an alien in their sight.
Sojourners of my house and my maids, For a stranger reckon me: An alien I have been in their eyes.

19.he: לְעַבְדִּ֣י קָּ֭רָאתִי וְלֹ֣א יַעֲנֶ֑ה בְּמוֹ־פִ֝֗י אֶתְחַנֶּן־לֽוֹ׃

lines.text: I call to my servant, and he gives me no answer. I beg him with my mouth.
To my servant I have called, And he doth not answer, With my mouth I make supplication to him.

19.he: ר֭וּחִֽי זָ֣רָה לְאִשְׁתִּ֑י וְ֝חַנֹּתִ֗י לִבְנֵ֥י בִטְנִֽי׃

lines.text: My breath is offensive to my wife. I am loathsome to the children of my own mother.
My spirit is strange to my wife, And my favours to the sons of my [mother's] womb.

19.he: גַּם־עֲ֭וִילִים מָ֣אֲסוּ בִ֑י אָ֝ק֗וּמָה וַיְדַבְּרוּ־בִֽי׃

lines.text: Even young children despise me. If I arise, they speak against me.
Also sucklings have despised me, I rise, and they speak against me.

19.he: תִּֽ֭עֲבוּנִי כָּל־מְתֵ֣י סוֹדִ֑י וְזֶֽה־אָ֝הַ֗בְתִּי נֶהְפְּכוּ־בִֽי׃

lines.text: All my familiar friends abhor me. They whom I loved have turned against me.
Abominate me do all the men of my counsel, And those I have loved, Have been turned against me.

19.he: בְּעוֹרִ֣י וּ֭בִבְשָׂרִי דָּבְקָ֣ה עַצְמִ֑י וָ֝אֶתְמַלְּטָ֗ה בְּע֣וֹר שִׁנָּֽי׃

lines.text: My bones stick to my skin and to my flesh. I have escaped by the skin of my teeth.
To my skin and to my flesh Cleaved hath my bone, And I deliver myself with the skin of my teeth.

19.he: חָנֻּ֬נִי חָנֻּ֣נִי אַתֶּ֣ם רֵעָ֑י כִּ֥י יַד־אֱ֝ל֗וֹהַּ נָ֣גְעָה בִּֽי׃

lines.text: “Have pity on me. Have pity on me, you my friends; for the hand of God has touched me.
Pity me, pity me, ye my friends, For the hand of God hath stricken against me.

19.he: לָ֭מָּה תִּרְדְּפֻ֣נִי כְמוֹ־אֵ֑ל וּ֝מִבְּשָׂרִ֗י לֹ֣א תִשְׂבָּֽעוּ׃

lines.text: Why do you persecute me as God, and are not satisfied with my flesh?
Why do you pursue me as God? And with my flesh are not satisfied?

19.he: מִֽי־יִתֵּ֣ן אֵ֭פוֹ וְיִכָּתְב֣וּן מִלָּ֑י מִֽי־יִתֵּ֖ן בַּסֵּ֣פֶר וְיֻחָֽקוּ׃

lines.text: “Oh that my words were now written! Oh that they were inscribed in a book!
Who doth grant now, That my words may be written? Who doth grant that in a book they may be graven?

19.he: בְּעֵט־בַּרְזֶ֥ל וְעֹפָ֑רֶת לָ֝עַ֗ד בַּצּ֥וּר יֵחָצְבֽוּן׃

lines.text: That with an iron pen and lead they were engraved in the rock forever!
With a pen of iron and lead — For ever in a rock they may be hewn.

19.he: וַאֲנִ֣י יָ֭דַעְתִּי גֹּ֣אֲלִי חָ֑י וְ֝אַחֲר֗וֹן עַל־עָפָ֥ר יָקֽוּם׃

lines.text: But as for me, I know that my Redeemer lives. In the end, he will stand upon the earth.
That — I have known my Redeemer, The Living and the Last, For the dust he doth rise.

19.he: וְאַחַ֣ר ע֭וֹרִֽי נִקְּפוּ־זֹ֑את וּ֝מִבְּשָׂרִ֗י אֶֽחֱזֶ֥ה אֱלֽוֹהַּ׃

lines.text: After my skin is destroyed, then I will see God in my flesh,
And after my skin hath compassed this [body], Then from my flesh I see God:

19.he: אֲשֶׁ֤ר אֲנִ֨י ׀ אֶֽחֱזֶה־לִּ֗י וְעֵינַ֣י רָא֣וּ וְלֹא־זָ֑ר כָּל֖וּ כִלְיֹתַ֣י בְּחֵקִֽי׃

lines.text: whom I, even I, will see on my side. My eyes will see, and not as a stranger. “My heart is consumed within me.
Whom I — I see on my side, And mine eyes have beheld, and not a stranger, Consumed have been my reins in my bosom.

19.he: כִּ֣י תֹ֭אמְרוּ מַה־נִּרְדָּף־ל֑וֹ וְשֹׁ֥רֶשׁ דָּ֝בָ֗ר נִמְצָא־בִֽי׃

lines.text: If you say, ‘How we will persecute him!’ because the root of the matter is found in me,
But ye say, 'Why do we pursue after him?' And the root of the matter hath been found in me.

19.he: גּ֤וּרוּ לָכֶ֨ם ׀ מִפְּנֵי־חֶ֗רֶב כִּֽי־חֵ֭מָה עֲוֺנ֣וֹת חָ֑רֶב לְמַ֖עַן תֵּדְע֣וּן שדין׃

lines.text: be afraid of the sword, for wrath brings the punishments of the sword, that you may know there is a judgment.”
Be ye afraid because of the sword, For furious [are] the punishments of the sword, That ye may know that [there is] a judgment.

20.he: וַ֭יַּעַן צֹפַ֥ר הַנַּֽעֲמָתִ֗י וַיֹּאמַֽר׃

lines.text: Then Zophar the Naamathite answered,
And Zophar the Naamathite answereth and saith: —

20.he: לָ֭כֵן שְׂעִפַּ֣י יְשִׁיב֑וּנִי וּ֝בַעֲב֗וּר ח֣וּשִׁי בִֽי׃

lines.text: “Therefore my thoughts answer me, even by reason of my haste that is in me.
Therefore my thoughts cause me to answer, And because of my sensations in me.

20.he: מוּסַ֣ר כְּלִמָּתִ֣י אֶשְׁמָ֑ע וְ֝ר֗וּחַ מִֽבִּינָתִ֥י יַעֲנֵֽנִי׃

lines.text: I have heard the reproof which puts me to shame. The spirit of my understanding answers me.
The chastisement of my shame I hear, And the spirit of mine understanding Doth cause me to answer:

20.he: הֲזֹ֣את יָ֭דַעְתָּ מִנִּי־עַ֑ד מִנִּ֤י שִׂ֖ים אָדָ֣ם עֲלֵי־אָֽרֶץ׃

lines.text: Don’t you know this from old time, since man was placed on earth,
This hast thou known from antiquity? Since the placing of man on earth?

20.he: כִּ֤י רִנְנַ֣ת רְ֭שָׁעִים מִקָּר֑וֹב וְשִׂמְחַ֖ת חָנֵ֣ף עֲדֵי־רָֽגַע׃

lines.text: that the triumphing of the wicked is short, the joy of the godless but for a moment?
That the singing of the wicked [is] short, And the joy of the profane for a moment,

20.he: אִם־יַעֲלֶ֣ה לַשָּׁמַ֣יִם שִׂיא֑וֹ וְ֝רֹאשׁ֗וֹ לָעָ֥ב יַגִּֽיעַ׃

lines.text: Though his height mount up to the heavens, and his head reach to the clouds,
Though his excellency go up to the heavens, And his head against a cloud he strike —

20.he: כְּֽ֭גֶלֲלוֹ לָנֶ֣צַח יֹאבֵ֑ד רֹ֝אָ֗יו יֹאמְר֥וּ אַיּֽוֹ׃

lines.text: yet he will perish forever like his own dung. Those who have seen him will say, ‘Where is he?’
As his own dung for ever he doth perish, His beholders say: 'Where [is] he?'

20.he: כַּחֲל֣וֹם יָ֭עוּף וְלֹ֣א יִמְצָא֑וּהוּ וְ֝יֻדַּ֗ד כְּחֶזְי֥וֹן לָֽיְלָה׃

lines.text: He will fly away as a dream, and will not be found. Yes, he will be chased away like a vision of the night.
As a dream he fleeth, and they find him not, And he is driven away as a vision of the night,

20.he: עַ֣יִן שְׁ֭זָפַתּוּ וְלֹ֣א תוֹסִ֑יף וְלֹא־ע֝֗וֹד תְּשׁוּרֶ֥נּוּ מְקוֹמֽוֹ׃

lines.text: The eye which saw him will see him no more, neither will his place see him any more.
The eye hath not seen him, and addeth not. And not again doth his place behold him.

20.he: בָּ֭נָיו יְרַצּ֣וּ דַלִּ֑ים וְ֝יָדָ֗יו תָּשֵׁ֥בְנָה אוֹנֽוֹ׃

lines.text: His children will seek the favor of the poor. His hands will give back his wealth.
His sons do the poor oppress, And his hands give back his wealth.

20.he: עַ֭צְמוֹתָיו מָלְא֣וּ עלומו וְ֝עִמּ֗וֹ עַל־עָפָ֥ר תִּשְׁכָּֽב׃

lines.text: His bones are full of his youth, but youth will lie down with him in the dust.
His bones have been full of his youth, And with him on the dust it lieth down.

20.he: אִם־תַּמְתִּ֣יק בְּפִ֣יו רָעָ֑ה יַ֝כְחִידֶ֗נָּה תַּ֣חַת לְשׁוֹנֽוֹ׃

lines.text: “Though wickedness is sweet in his mouth, though he hide it under his tongue,
Though he doth sweeten evil in his mouth, Doth hide it under his tongue,

20.he: יַחְמֹ֣ל עָ֭לֶיהָ וְלֹ֣א יַֽעַזְבֶ֑נָּה וְ֝יִמְנָעֶ֗נָּה בְּת֣וֹךְ חִכּֽוֹ׃

lines.text: though he spare it, and will not let it go, but keep it still within his mouth;
Hath pity on it, and doth not forsake it, And keep it back in the midst of his palate,

20.he: לַ֭חְמוֹ בְּמֵעָ֣יו נֶהְפָּ֑ךְ מְרוֹרַ֖ת פְּתָנִ֣ים בְּקִרְבּֽוֹ׃

lines.text: yet his food in his bowels is turned. It is cobra venom within him.
His food in his bowels is turned, The bitterness of asps [is] in his heart.

20.he: חַ֣יִל בָּ֭לַע וַיְקִאֶ֑נּוּ מִ֝בִּטְנ֗וֹ יוֹרִשֶׁ֥נּוּ אֵֽל׃

lines.text: He has swallowed down riches, and he will vomit them up again. God will cast them out of his belly.
Wealth he hath swallowed, and doth vomit it. From his belly God driveth it out.

20.he: רֹאשׁ־פְּתָנִ֥ים יִינָ֑ק תַּֽ֝הַרְגֵ֗הוּ לְשׁ֣וֹן אֶפְעֶֽה׃

lines.text: He will suck cobra venom. The viper’s tongue will kill him.
Gall of asps he sucketh, Slay him doth the tongue of a viper.

20.he: אַל־יֵ֥רֶא בִפְלַגּ֑וֹת נַהֲרֵ֥י נַ֝חֲלֵ֗י דְּבַ֣שׁ וְחֶמְאָֽה׃

lines.text: He will not look at the rivers, the flowing streams of honey and butter.
He looketh not on rivulets, Flowing of brooks of honey and butter.

20.he: מֵשִׁ֣יב יָ֭גָע וְלֹ֣א יִבְלָ֑ע כְּחֵ֥יל תְּ֝מוּרָת֗וֹ וְלֹ֣א יַעֲלֹֽס׃

lines.text: He will restore that for which he labored, and will not swallow it down. He will not rejoice according to the substance that he has gotten.
He is giving back [what] he laboured for, And doth not consume [it]; As a bulwark [is] his exchange, and he exults not.

20.he: כִּֽי־רִ֭צַּץ עָזַ֣ב דַּלִּ֑ים בַּ֥יִת גָּ֝זַ֗ל וְלֹ֣א יִבֶנֵֽהוּ׃

lines.text: For he has oppressed and forsaken the poor. He has violently taken away a house, and he will not build it up.
For he oppressed — he forsook the poor, A house he hath taken violently away, And he doth not build it.

20.he: כִּ֤י ׀ לֹא־יָדַ֣ע שָׁלֵ֣ו בְּבִטְנ֑וֹ בַּ֝חֲמוּד֗וֹ לֹ֣א יְמַלֵּֽט׃

lines.text: “Because he knew no quietness within him, he will not save anything of that in which he delights.
For he hath not known ease in his belly. With his desirable thing he delivereth not himself.

20.he: אֵין־שָׂרִ֥יד לְאָכְל֑וֹ עַל־כֵּ֝֗ן לֹא־יָחִ֥יל טוּבֽוֹ׃

lines.text: There was nothing left that he didn’t devour, therefore his prosperity will not endure.
There is not a remnant to his food, Therefore his good doth not stay.

20.he: בִּמְלֹ֣אות שִׂ֭פְקוֹ יֵ֣צֶר ל֑וֹ כָּל־יַ֖ד עָמֵ֣ל תְּבוֹאֶֽנּוּ׃

lines.text: In the fullness of his sufficiency, distress will overtake him. The hand of everyone who is in misery will come on him.
In the fulness of his sufficiency he is straitened. Every perverse hand doth meet him.

20.he: יְהִ֤י ׀ לְמַלֵּ֬א בִטְנ֗וֹ יְֽשַׁלַּח־בּ֭וֹ חֲר֣וֹן אַפּ֑וֹ וְיַמְטֵ֥ר עָ֝לֵ֗ימוֹ בִּלְחוּמֽוֹ׃

lines.text: When he is about to fill his belly, God will cast the fierceness of his wrath on him. It will rain on him while he is eating.
It cometh to pass, at the filling of his belly, He sendeth forth against him The fierceness of His anger, Yea, He raineth on him in his eating.

20.he: יִ֭בְרַח מִנֵּ֣שֶׁק בַּרְזֶ֑ל תַּ֝חְלְפֵ֗הוּ קֶ֣שֶׁת נְחוּשָֽׁה׃

lines.text: He will flee from the iron weapon. The bronze arrow will strike him through.
He fleeth from an iron weapon, Pass through him doth a bow of brass.

20.he: שָׁלַף֮ וַיֵּצֵ֪א מִגֵּ֫וָ֥ה וּ֭בָרָק מִֽמְּרֹרָת֥וֹ יַהֲלֹ֗ךְ עָלָ֥יו אֵמִֽים׃

lines.text: He draws it out, and it comes out of his body. Yes, the glittering point comes out of his liver. Terrors are on him.
One hath drawn, And it cometh out from the body, And a glittering weapon from his gall proceedeth. On him [are] terrors.

20.he: כָּל־חֹשֶׁךְ֮ טָמ֪וּן לִצְפּ֫וּנָ֥יו תְּ֭אָכְלֵהוּ אֵ֣שׁ לֹֽא־נֻפָּ֑ח יֵ֖רַע שָׂרִ֣יד בְּאָהֳלֽוֹ׃

lines.text: All darkness is laid up for his treasures. An unfanned fire will devour him. It will consume that which is left in his tent.
All darkness is hid for his treasures, Consume him doth a fire not blown, Broken is the remnant in his tent.

20.he: יְגַלּ֣וּ שָׁמַ֣יִם עֲוֺנ֑וֹ וְ֝אֶ֗רֶץ מִתְקוֹמָ֘מָ֥ה לֽוֹ׃

lines.text: The heavens will reveal his iniquity. The earth will rise up against him.
Reveal do the heavens his iniquity, And earth is raising itself against him.

20.he: יִ֭גֶל יְב֣וּל בֵּית֑וֹ נִ֝גָּר֗וֹת בְּי֣וֹם אַפּֽוֹ׃

lines.text: The increase of his house will depart. They will rush away in the day of his wrath.
Remove doth the increase of his house, Poured forth in a day of His anger.

20.he: זֶ֤ה ׀ חֵֽלֶק־אָדָ֣ם רָ֭שָׁע מֵאֱלֹהִ֑ים וְנַחֲלַ֖ת אִמְר֣וֹ מֵאֵֽל׃

lines.text: This is the portion of a wicked man from God, the heritage appointed to him by God.”
This [is] the portion of a wicked man from God. And an inheritance appointed him by God.

21.he: וַיַּ֥עַן אִיּ֗וֹב וַיֹּאמַֽר׃

lines.text: Then Job answered,
And Job answereth and saith: —

21.he: שִׁמְע֣וּ שָׁ֭מוֹעַ מִלָּתִ֑י וּתְהִי־זֹ֝֗את תַּנְח֥וּמֹֽתֵיכֶֽם׃

lines.text: “Listen diligently to my speech. Let this be your consolation.
Hear ye diligently my word, And this is your consolation.

21.he: שָׂ֭אוּנִי וְאָנֹכִ֣י אֲדַבֵּ֑ר וְאַחַ֖ר דַּבְּרִ֣י תַלְעִֽיג׃

lines.text: Allow me, and I also will speak; After I have spoken, mock on.
Bear with me, and I speak, And after my speaking — ye may deride.

21.he: הֶ֭אָנֹכִי לְאָדָ֣ם שִׂיחִ֑י וְאִם־מַ֝דּ֗וּעַ לֹא־תִקְצַ֥ר רוּחִֽי׃

lines.text: As for me, is my complaint to man? Why shouldn’t I be impatient?
I — to man [is] my complaint? and if [so], wherefore May not my temper become short?

21.he: פְּנוּ־אֵלַ֥י וְהָשַׁ֑מּוּ וְשִׂ֖ימוּ יָ֣ד עַל־פֶּֽה׃

lines.text: Look at me, and be astonished. Lay your hand on your mouth.
Turn unto me, and be astonished, And put hand to mouth.

21.he: וְאִם־זָכַ֥רְתִּי וְנִבְהָ֑לְתִּי וְאָחַ֥ז בְּ֝שָׂרִ֗י פַּלָּצֽוּת׃

lines.text: When I remember, I am troubled. Horror takes hold of my flesh.
Yea, if I have remembered, then I have been troubled. And my flesh hath taken fright.

21.he: מַדּ֣וּעַ רְשָׁעִ֣ים יִחְי֑וּ עָ֝תְק֗וּ גַּם־גָּ֥בְרוּ חָֽיִל׃

lines.text: “Why do the wicked live, become old, yes, and grow mighty in power?
Wherefore do the wicked live? They have become old, Yea, they have been mighty in wealth.

21.he: זַרְעָ֤ם נָכ֣וֹן לִפְנֵיהֶ֣ם עִמָּ֑ם וְ֝צֶאֱצָאֵיהֶ֗ם לְעֵינֵיהֶֽם׃

lines.text: Their child is established with them in their sight, their offspring before their eyes.
Their seed is established, Before their face with them, And their offspring before their eyes.

21.he: בָּתֵּיהֶ֣ם שָׁל֣וֹם מִפָּ֑חַד וְלֹ֤א שֵׁ֖בֶט אֱל֣וֹהַּ עֲלֵיהֶֽם׃

lines.text: Their houses are safe from fear, neither is the rod of God upon them.
Their houses [are] peace without fear, Nor [is] a rod of God upon them.

21.he: שׁוֹר֣וֹ עִ֭בַּר וְלֹ֣א יַגְעִ֑ל תְּפַלֵּ֥ט פָּ֝רָת֗וֹ וְלֹ֣א תְשַׁכֵּֽל׃

lines.text: Their bulls breed without fail. Their cows calve, and don’t miscarry.
His bullock hath eaten corn, and doth not loath. His cow bringeth forth safely, And doth not miscarry.

21.he: יְשַׁלְּח֣וּ כַ֭צֹּאן עֲוִילֵיהֶ֑ם וְ֝יַלְדֵיהֶ֗ם יְרַקֵּדֽוּן׃

lines.text: They send out their little ones like a flock. Their children dance.
They send forth as a flock their sucklings, And their children skip,

21.he: יִ֭שְׂאוּ כְּתֹ֣ף וְכִנּ֑וֹר וְ֝יִשְׂמְח֗וּ לְק֣וֹל עוּגָֽב׃

lines.text: They sing to the tambourine and harp, and rejoice at the sound of the pipe.
They lift [themselves] up at timbrel and harp, And rejoice at the sound of an organ.

21.he: יבלו בַטּ֣וֹב יְמֵיהֶ֑ם וּ֝בְרֶ֗גַע שְׁא֣וֹל יֵחָֽתּוּ׃

lines.text: They spend their days in prosperity. In an instant they go down to Sheol.
They wear out in good their days, And in a moment [to] Sheol go down.

21.he: וַיֹּאמְר֣וּ לָ֭אֵל ס֣וּר מִמֶּ֑נּוּ וְדַ֥עַת דְּ֝רָכֶ֗יךָ לֹ֣א חָפָֽצְנוּ׃

lines.text: They tell God, ‘Depart from us, for we don’t want to know about your ways.
And they say to God, 'Turn aside from us, And the knowledge of Thy ways We have not desired.

21.he: מַה־שַׁדַּ֥י כִּֽי־נַֽעַבְדֶ֑נּוּ וּמַה־נּ֝וֹעִ֗יל כִּ֣י נִפְגַּע־בּֽוֹ׃

lines.text: What is the Almighty, that we should serve him? What profit should we have, if we pray to him?’
What [is] the Mighty One that we serve Him? And what do we profit when we meet with Him?'

21.he: הֵ֤ן לֹ֣א בְיָדָ֣ם טוּבָ֑ם עֲצַ֥ת רְ֝שָׁעִ֗ים רָ֣חֲקָה מֶֽנִּי׃

lines.text: Behold, their prosperity is not in their hand. The counsel of the wicked is far from me.
Lo, not in their hand [is] their good, (The counsel of the wicked Hath been far from me.)

21.he: כַּמָּ֤ה ׀ נֵר־רְשָׁ֘עִ֤ים יִדְעָ֗ךְ וְיָבֹ֣א עָלֵ֣ימוֹ אֵידָ֑ם חֲ֝בָלִ֗ים יְחַלֵּ֥ק בְּאַפּֽוֹ׃

lines.text: “How often is it that the lamp of the wicked is put out, that their calamity comes on them, that God distributes sorrows in his anger?
How oft is the lamp of the wicked extinguished, And come on them doth their calamity? Pangs He apportioneth in His anger.

21.he: יִהְי֗וּ כְּתֶ֥בֶן לִפְנֵי־ר֑וּחַ וּ֝כְמֹ֗ץ גְּנָבַ֥תּוּ סוּפָֽה׃

lines.text: How often is it that they are as stubble before the wind, as chaff that the storm carries away?
They are as straw before wind, And as chaff a hurricane hath stolen away,

21.he: אֱל֗וֹהַּ יִצְפֹּן־לְבָנָ֥יו אוֹנ֑וֹ יְשַׁלֵּ֖ם אֵלָ֣יו וְיֵדָֽע׃

lines.text: You say, ‘God lays up his iniquity for his children.’ Let him recompense it to himself, that he may know it.
God layeth up for his sons his sorrow, He giveth recompense unto him — and he knoweth.

21.he: יִרְא֣וּ עינו כִּיד֑וֹ וּמֵחֲמַ֖ת שַׁדַּ֣י יִשְׁתֶּֽה׃

lines.text: Let his own eyes see his destruction. Let him drink of the wrath of the Almighty.
His own eyes see his destruction, And of the wrath of the Mighty he drinketh.

21.he: כִּ֤י מַה־חֶפְצ֣וֹ בְּבֵית֣וֹ אַחֲרָ֑יו וּמִסְפַּ֖ר חֳדָשָׁ֣יו חֻצָּֽצוּ׃

lines.text: For what does he care for his house after him, when the number of his months is cut off?
For what [is] his delight in his house after him, And the number of his months cut off?

21.he: הַלְאֵ֥ל יְלַמֶּד־דָּ֑עַת וְ֝ה֗וּא רָמִ֥ים יִשְׁפּֽוֹט׃

lines.text: “Shall any teach God knowledge, since he judges those who are high?
To God doth [one] teach knowledge, And He the high doth judge?

21.he: זֶ֗ה יָ֭מוּת בְּעֶ֣צֶם תֻּמּ֑וֹ כֻּ֝לּ֗וֹ שַׁלְאֲנַ֥ן וְשָׁלֵֽיו׃

lines.text: One dies in his full strength, being wholly at ease and quiet.
This [one] dieth in his perfect strength, Wholly at ease and quiet.

21.he: עֲ֭טִינָיו מָלְא֣וּ חָלָ֑ב וּמֹ֖חַ עַצְמוֹתָ֣יו יְשֻׁקֶּֽה׃

lines.text: His pails are full of milk. The marrow of his bones is moistened.
His breasts have been full of milk, And marrow his bones doth moisten.

21.he: וְזֶ֗ה יָ֭מוּת בְּנֶ֣פֶשׁ מָרָ֑ה וְלֹֽא־אָ֝כַ֗ל בַּטּוֹבָֽה׃

lines.text: Another dies in bitterness of soul, and never tastes of good.
And this [one] dieth with a bitter soul, And have not eaten with gladness.

21.he: יַ֭חַד עַל־עָפָ֣ר יִשְׁכָּ֑בוּ וְ֝רִמָּ֗ה תְּכַסֶּ֥ה עֲלֵיהֶֽם׃

lines.text: They lie down alike in the dust. The worm covers them.
Together — on the dust they lie down, And the worm doth cover them over.

21.he: הֵ֣ן יָ֭דַעְתִּי מַחְשְׁבֽוֹתֵיכֶ֑ם וּ֝מְזִמּ֗וֹת עָלַ֥י תַּחְמֹֽסוּ׃

lines.text: “Behold, I know your thoughts, the plans with which you would wrong me.
Lo, I have known your thoughts, And the devices against me ye do wrongfully.

21.he: כִּ֤י תֹֽאמְר֗וּ אַיֵּ֥ה בֵית־נָדִ֑יב וְ֝אַיֵּ֗ה אֹ֤הֶל ׀ מִשְׁכְּנ֬וֹת רְשָׁעִֽים׃

lines.text: For you say, ‘Where is the house of the prince? Where is the tent in which the wicked lived?’
For ye say, 'Where [is] the house of the noble? And where the tent — The tabernacles of the wicked?'

21.he: הֲלֹ֣א שְׁ֭אֶלְתֶּם ע֣וֹבְרֵי דָ֑רֶךְ וְ֝אֹתֹתָ֗ם לֹ֣א תְנַכֵּֽרוּ׃

lines.text: Haven’t you asked wayfaring men? Don’t you know their evidences,
Have ye not asked those passing by the way? And their signs do ye not know?

21.he: כִּ֤י לְי֣וֹם אֵ֭יד יֵחָ֣שֶׂךְ רָ֑ע לְי֖וֹם עֲבָר֣וֹת יוּבָֽלוּ׃

lines.text: that the evil man is reserved to the day of calamity, That they are led out to the day of wrath?
That to a day of calamity is the wicked spared. To a day of wrath they are brought.

21.he: מִֽי־יַגִּ֣יד עַל־פָּנָ֣יו דַּרְכּ֑וֹ וְהֽוּא־עָ֝שָׂ֗ה מִ֣י יְשַׁלֶּם־לֽוֹ׃

lines.text: Who will declare his way to his face? Who will repay him what he has done?
Who doth declare to his face his way? And [for] that which he hath done, Who doth give recompence to him?

21.he: וְ֭הוּא לִקְבָר֣וֹת יוּבָ֑ל וְֽעַל־גָּדִ֥ישׁ יִשְׁקֽוֹד׃

lines.text: Yet he will be borne to the grave. Men will keep watch over the tomb.
And he — to the graves he is brought. And over the heap a watch is kept.

21.he: מָֽתְקוּ־ל֗וֹ רִגְבֵ֫י נָ֥חַל וְ֭אַחֲרָיו כָּל־אָדָ֣ם יִמְשׁ֑וֹךְ וּ֝לְפָנָ֗יו אֵ֣ין מִסְפָּֽר׃

lines.text: The clods of the valley will be sweet to him. All men will draw after him, as there were innumerable before him.
Sweet to him have been the clods of the valley, And after him every man he draweth, And before him there is no numbering.

21.he: וְ֭אֵיךְ תְּנַחֲמ֣וּנִי הָ֑בֶל וּ֝תְשׁ֥וּבֹתֵיכֶ֗ם נִשְׁאַר־מָֽעַל׃

lines.text: So how can you comfort me with nonsense, because in your answers there remains only falsehood?”
And how do ye comfort me [with] vanity, And in your answers hath been left trespass?

22.he: וַ֭יַּעַן אֱלִיפַ֥ז הַֽתֵּמָנִ֗י וַיֹּאמַֽר׃

lines.text: Then Eliphaz the Temanite answered,
And Eliphaz the Temanite answereth and saith: —

22.he: הַלְאֵ֥ל יִסְכָּן־גָּ֑בֶר כִּֽי־יִסְכֹּ֖ן עָלֵ֣ימוֹ מַשְׂכִּֽיל׃

lines.text: “Can a man be profitable to God? Surely he who is wise is profitable to himself.
To God is a man profitable, Because a wise man to himself is profitable?

22.he: הַחֵ֣פֶץ לְ֭שַׁדַּי כִּ֣י תִצְדָּ֑ק וְאִם־בֶּ֝֗צַע כִּֽי־תַתֵּ֥ם דְּרָכֶֽיךָ׃

lines.text: Is it any pleasure to the Almighty that you are righteous? Or does it benefit him that you make your ways perfect?
Is it a delight to the Mighty One That thou art righteous? is it gain, That thou makest perfect thy ways?

22.he: הֲֽ֭מִיִּרְאָ֣תְךָ יֹכִיחֶ֑ךָ יָב֥וֹא עִ֝מְּךָ֗ בַּמִּשְׁפָּֽט׃

lines.text: Is it for your piety that he reproves you, that he enters with you into judgment?
Because of thy reverence Doth He reason [with] thee? He entereth with thee into judgment:

22.he: הֲלֹ֣א רָעָֽתְךָ֣ רַבָּ֑ה וְאֵֽין־קֵ֝֗ץ לַעֲוֺנֹתֶֽיךָ׃

lines.text: Isn’t your wickedness great? Neither is there any end to your iniquities.
Is not thy wickedness abundant? And there is no end to thine iniquities.

22.he: כִּֽי־תַחְבֹּ֣ל אַחֶ֣יךָ חִנָּ֑ם וּבִגְדֵ֖י עֲרוּמִּ֣ים תַּפְשִֽׁיט׃

lines.text: For you have taken pledges from your brother for nothing, and stripped the naked of their clothing.
For thou takest a pledge of thy brother for nought, And the garments of the naked Thou dost strip off.

22.he: לֹא־מַ֭יִם עָיֵ֣ף תַּשְׁקֶ֑ה וּ֝מֵרָעֵ֗ב תִּֽמְנַֽע־לָֽחֶם׃

lines.text: You haven’t given water to the weary to drink, and you have withheld bread from the hungry.
Thou causest not the weary to drink water, And from the hungry thou withholdest bread.

22.he: וְאִ֣ישׁ זְ֭רוֹעַ ל֣וֹ הָאָ֑רֶץ וּנְשׂ֥וּא פָ֝נִ֗ים יֵ֣שֶׁב בָּֽהּ׃

lines.text: But as for the mighty man, he had the earth. The honorable man, he lived in it.
As to the man of arm — he hath the earth, And the accepted of face — he dwelleth in it.

22.he: אַ֭לְמָנוֹת שִׁלַּ֣חְתָּ רֵיקָ֑ם וּזְרֹע֖וֹת יְתֹמִ֣ים יְדֻכָּֽא׃

lines.text: You have sent widows away empty, and the arms of the fatherless have been broken.
Widows thou hast sent away empty, And the arms of the fatherless are bruised.

22.he: עַל־כֵּ֭ן סְבִיבוֹתֶ֣יךָ פַחִ֑ים וִֽ֝יבַהֶלְךָ פַּ֣חַד פִּתְאֹֽם׃

lines.text: Therefore snares are around you. Sudden fear troubles you,
Therefore round about thee [are] snares, And trouble thee doth fear suddenly.

22.he: אוֹ־חֹ֥שֶׁךְ לֹֽא־תִרְאֶ֑ה וְֽשִׁפְעַת־מַ֥יִם תְּכַסֶּֽךָּ׃

lines.text: or darkness, so that you can not see, and floods of waters cover you.
Or darkness — thou dost not see, And abundance of waters doth cover thee.

22.he: הֲֽלֹא־אֱ֭לוֹהַּ גֹּ֣בַהּ שָׁמָ֑יִם וּרְאֵ֤ה רֹ֖אשׁ כּוֹכָבִ֣ים כִּי־רָֽמּוּ׃

lines.text: “Isn’t God in the heights of heaven? See the height of the stars, how high they are!
Is not God high [in] heaven? And see the summit of the stars, That they are high.

22.he: וְֽ֭אָמַרְתָּ מַה־יָּ֣דַֽע אֵ֑ל הַבְעַ֖ד עֲרָפֶ֣ל יִשְׁפּֽוֹט׃

lines.text: You say, ‘What does God know? Can he judge through the thick darkness?
And thou hast said, 'What — hath God known? Through thickness doth He judge?

22.he: עָבִ֣ים סֵֽתֶר־ל֭וֹ וְלֹ֣א יִרְאֶ֑ה וְח֥וּג שָׁ֝מַ֗יִם יִתְהַלָּֽךְ׃

lines.text: Thick clouds are a covering to him, so that he doesn’t see. He walks on the vault of the sky.’
Thick clouds [are] a secret place to Him, And He doth not see;' And the circle of the heavens He walketh habitually,

22.he: הַאֹ֣רַח עוֹלָ֣ם תִּשְׁמֹ֑ר אֲשֶׁ֖ר דָּרְכ֣וּ מְתֵי־אָֽוֶן׃

lines.text: Will you keep the old way, which wicked men have trodden,
The path of the age dost thou observe, That men of iniquity have trodden?

22.he: אֲשֶֽׁר־קֻמְּט֥וּ וְלֹא־עֵ֑ת נָ֝הָ֗ר יוּצַ֥ק יְסוֹדָֽם׃

lines.text: who were snatched away before their time, whose foundation was poured out as a stream,
Who have been cut down unexpectedly, A flood is poured out on their foundation.

22.he: הָאֹמְרִ֣ים לָ֭אֵל ס֣וּר מִמֶּ֑נּוּ וּמַה־יִּפְעַ֖ל שַׁדַּ֣י לָֽמוֹ׃

lines.text: who said to God, ‘Depart from us;’ and, ‘What can the Almighty do for us?’
Those saying to God, 'Turn aside from us,' And what doth the Mighty One to them?

22.he: וְה֤וּא מִלֵּ֣א בָתֵּיהֶ֣ם ט֑וֹב וַעֲצַ֥ת רְ֝שָׁעִ֗ים רָ֣חֲקָה מֶֽנִּי׃

lines.text: Yet he filled their houses with good things, but the counsel of the wicked is far from me.
And he hath filled their houses [with] good: (And the counsel of the wicked Hath been far from me.)

22.he: יִרְא֣וּ צַדִּיקִ֣ים וְיִשְׂמָ֑חוּ וְ֝נָקִ֗י יִלְעַג־לָֽמוֹ׃

lines.text: The righteous see it, and are glad. The innocent ridicule them,
See do the righteous and they rejoice, And the innocent mocketh at them,

22.he: אִם־לֹ֣א נִכְחַ֣ד קִימָ֑נוּ וְ֝יִתְרָ֗ם אָ֣כְלָה אֵֽשׁ׃

lines.text: saying, ‘Surely those who rose up against us are cut off. The fire has consumed their remnant.’
'Surely our substance hath not been cut off, And their excellency hath fire consumed.'

22.he: הַסְכֶּן־נָ֣א עִמּ֑וֹ וּשְׁלם בָּ֝הֶ֗ם תְּֽבוֹאַתְךָ֥ טוֹבָֽה׃

lines.text: “Acquaint yourself with him, now, and be at peace. By it, good will come to you.
Acquaint thyself, I pray thee, with Him, And be at peace, Thereby thine increase [is] good.

22.he: קַח־נָ֣א מִפִּ֣יו תּוֹרָ֑ה וְשִׂ֥ים אֲ֝מָרָ֗יו בִּלְבָבֶֽךָ׃

lines.text: Please receive instruction from his mouth, and lay up his words in your heart.
Receive, I pray thee, from His mouth a law, And set His sayings in thy heart.

22.he: אִם־תָּשׁ֣וּב עַד־שַׁ֭דַּי תִּבָּנֶ֑ה תַּרְחִ֥יק עַ֝וְלָ֗ה מֵאָהֳלֶֽךָ׃

lines.text: If you return to the Almighty, you will be built up, if you put away unrighteousness far from your tents.
If thou dost return unto the Mighty Thou art built up, Thou puttest iniquity far from thy tents.

22.he: וְשִׁית־עַל־עָפָ֥ר בָּ֑צֶר וּבְצ֖וּר נְחָלִ֣ים אוֹפִֽיר׃

lines.text: Lay your treasure in the dust, the gold of Ophir among the stones of the brooks.
So as to set on the dust a defence, And on a rock of the valleys a covering.

22.he: וְהָיָ֣ה שַׁדַּ֣י בְּצָרֶ֑יךָ וְכֶ֖סֶף תּוֹעָפ֣וֹת לָֽךְ׃

lines.text: The Almighty will be your treasure, and precious silver to you.
And the Mighty hath been thy defence, And silver [is] strength to thee.

22.he: כִּי־אָ֭ז עַל־שַׁדַּ֣י תִּתְעַנָּ֑ג וְתִשָּׂ֖א אֶל־אֱל֣וֹהַּ פָּנֶֽיךָ׃

lines.text: For then you will delight yourself in the Almighty, and will lift up your face to God.
For then on the Mighty thou delightest thyself, And dost lift up unto God thy face,

22.he: תַּעְתִּ֣יר אֵ֭לָיו וְיִשְׁמָעֶ֑ךָּ וּנְדָרֶ֥יךָ תְשַׁלֵּֽם׃

lines.text: You will make your prayer to him, and he will hear you. You will pay your vows.
Thou dost make supplication unto Him, And He doth hear thee, And thy vows thou completest.

22.he: וְֽתִגְזַר־א֭וֹמֶר וְיָ֣קָם לָ֑ךְ וְעַל־דְּ֝רָכֶ֗יךָ נָ֣גַֽהּ אֽוֹר׃

lines.text: You will also decree a thing, and it will be established to you. Light will shine on your ways.
And thou decreest a saying, And it is established to thee, And on thy ways hath light shone.

22.he: כִּֽי־הִ֭שְׁפִּילוּ וַתֹּ֣אמֶר גֵּוָ֑ה וְשַׁ֖ח עֵינַ֣יִם יוֹשִֽׁעַ׃

lines.text: When they cast down, you will say, ‘be lifted up.’ He will save the humble person.
For they have made low, And thou sayest, 'Lift up.' And the bowed down of eyes he saveth.

22.he: יְֽמַלֵּ֥ט אִֽי־נָקִ֑י וְ֝נִמְלַ֗ט בְּבֹ֣ר כַּפֶּֽיךָ׃

lines.text: He will even deliver him who is not innocent. Yes, he will be delivered through the cleanness of your hands.”
He delivereth the not innocent, Yea, he hath been delivered By the cleanness of thy hands.
Then Job answered,
And Job answereth and saith: —

23.he: גַּם־הַ֭יּוֹם מְרִ֣י שִׂחִ֑י יָ֝דִ֗י כָּבְדָ֥ה עַל־אַנְחָתִֽי׃

lines.text: “Even today my complaint is rebellious. His hand is heavy in spite of my groaning.
Also — to-day [is] my complaint bitter, My hand hath been heavy because of my sighing.
Oh that I knew where I might find him! That I might come even to his seat!
O that I had known — and I find Him, I come in unto His seat,

23.he: אֶעֶרְכָ֣ה לְפָנָ֣יו מִשְׁפָּ֑ט וּ֝פִ֗י אֲמַלֵּ֥א תוֹכָחֽוֹת׃

lines.text: I would set my cause in order before him, and fill my mouth with arguments.
I arrange before Him the cause, And my mouth fill [with] arguments.

23.he: אֵ֭דְעָה מִלִּ֣ים יַעֲנֵ֑נִי וְ֝אָבִ֗ינָה מַה־יֹּ֥אמַר לִֽי׃

lines.text: I would know the words which he would answer me, and understand what he would tell me.
I know the words He doth answer me, And understand what He saith to me.

23.he: הַבְּרָב־כֹּ֭חַ יָרִ֣יב עִמָּדִ֑י לֹ֥א אַךְ־ה֝֗וּא יָשִׂ֥ם בִּֽי׃

lines.text: Would he contend with me in the greatness of his power? No, but he would listen to me.
In the abundance of power doth He strive with me? No! surely He putteth [it] in me.

23.he: שָׁ֗ם יָ֭שָׁר נוֹכָ֣ח עִמּ֑וֹ וַאֲפַלְּטָ֥ה לָ֝נֶ֗צַח מִשֹּׁפְטִֽי׃

lines.text: There the upright might reason with him, so I should be delivered forever from my judge.
There the upright doth reason with Him, And I escape for ever from my judge.

23.he: הֵ֤ן קֶ֣דֶם אֶהֱלֹ֣ךְ וְאֵינֶ֑נּוּ וְ֝אָח֗וֹר וְֽלֹא־אָבִ֥ין לֽוֹ׃

lines.text: “If I go east, he is not there; if west, I can’t find him;
Lo, forward I go — and He is not, And backward — and I perceive him not.

23.he: שְׂמֹ֣אול בַּעֲשֹׂת֣וֹ וְלֹא־אָ֑חַז יַעְטֹ֥ף יָ֝מִ֗ין וְלֹ֣א אֶרְאֶֽה׃

lines.text: He works to the north, but I can’t see him. He turns south, but I can’t catch a glimpse of him.
[To] the left in His working — and I see not, He is covered [on] the right, and I behold not.

23.he: כִּֽי־יָ֭דַע דֶּ֣רֶךְ עִמָּדִ֑י בְּ֝חָנַ֗נִי כַּזָּהָ֥ב אֵצֵֽא׃

lines.text: But he knows the way that I take. When he has tried me, I will come out like gold.
For He hath known the way with me, He hath tried me — as gold I go forth.

23.he: בַּ֭אֲשֻׁרוֹ אָחֲזָ֣ה רַגְלִ֑י דַּרְכּ֖וֹ שָׁמַ֣רְתִּי וְלֹא־אָֽט׃

lines.text: My foot has held fast to his steps. I have kept his way, and not turned away.
On His step hath my foot laid hold, His way I have kept, and turn not aside,

23.he: מִצְוַ֣ת שְׂ֭פָתָיו וְלֹ֣א אָמִ֑ישׁ מֵ֝חֻקִּ֗י צָפַ֥נְתִּי אִמְרֵי־פִֽיו׃

lines.text: I haven’t gone back from the commandment of his lips. I have treasured up the words of his mouth more than my necessary food.
The command of His lips, and I depart not. Above my allotted portion I have laid up The sayings of His mouth.

23.he: וְה֣וּא בְ֭אֶחָד וּמִ֣י יְשִׁיבֶ֑נּוּ וְנַפְשׁ֖וֹ אִוְּתָ֣ה וַיָּֽעַשׂ׃

lines.text: But he stands alone, and who can oppose him? What his soul desires, even that he does.
And He [is] in one [mind], And who doth turn Him back? And His soul hath desired — and He doth [it].

23.he: כִּ֭י יַשְׁלִ֣ים חֻקִּ֑י וְכָהֵ֖נָּה רַבּ֣וֹת עִמּֽוֹ׃

lines.text: For he performs that which is appointed for me. Many such things are with him.
For He doth complete my portion, And many such things [are] with Him.

23.he: עַל־כֵּ֭ן מִפָּנָ֣יו אֶבָּהֵ֑ל אֶ֝תְבּוֹנֵ֗ן וְאֶפְחַ֥ד מִמֶּֽנּוּ׃

lines.text: Therefore I am terrified at his presence. When I consider, I am afraid of him.
Therefore, from His presence I am troubled, I consider, and am afraid of Him.
For God has made my heart faint. The Almighty has terrified me.
And God hath made my heart soft, And the Mighty hath troubled me.
Because I was not cut off before the darkness, neither did he cover the thick darkness from my face.
For I have not been cut off before darkness, And before me He covered thick darkness.

24.he: מַדּ֗וּעַ מִ֭שַּׁדַּי לֹא־נִצְפְּנ֣וּ עִתִּ֑ים וידעו לֹא־חָ֥זוּ יָמָֽיו׃

lines.text: “Why aren’t times laid up by the Almighty? Why don’t those who know him see his days?
Wherefore from the Mighty One Times have not been hidden, And those knowing Him have not seen His days.

24.he: גְּבֻל֥וֹת יַשִּׂ֑יגוּ עֵ֥דֶר גָּ֝זְל֗וּ וַיִּרְעֽוּ׃

lines.text: There are people who remove the landmarks. They violently take away flocks, and feed them.
The borders they reach, A drove they have taken violently away, Yea, they do evil.

24.he: חֲמ֣וֹר יְתוֹמִ֣ים יִנְהָ֑גוּ יַ֝חְבְּל֗וּ שׁ֣וֹר אַלְמָנָֽה׃

lines.text: They drive away the donkey of the fatherless, and they take the widow’s ox for a pledge.
The ass of the fatherless they lead away, They take in pledge the ox of the widow,

24.he: יַטּ֣וּ אֶבְיוֹנִ֣ים מִדָּ֑רֶךְ יַ֥חַד חֻ֝בְּא֗וּ עֲנִיֵּי־אָֽרֶץ׃

lines.text: They turn the needy out of the way. The poor of the earth all hide themselves.
They turn aside the needy from the way, Together have hid the poor of the earth.

24.he: הֵ֤ן פְּרָאִ֨ים ׀ בַּ֥מִּדְבָּ֗ר יָצְא֣וּ בְּ֭פָעֳלָם מְשַׁחֲרֵ֣י לַטָּ֑רֶף עֲרָבָ֥ה ל֥וֹ לֶ֝֗חֶם לַנְּעָרִֽים׃

lines.text: Behold, as wild donkeys in the desert, they go out to their work, seeking diligently for food. The wilderness yields them bread for their children.
Lo, wild asses in a wilderness, They have gone out about their work, Seeking early for prey, A mixture for himself — food for young ones.

24.he: בַּ֭שָּׂדֶה בְּלִיל֣וֹ יקצירו וְכֶ֖רֶם רָשָׁ֣ע יְלַקֵּֽשׁוּ׃

lines.text: They cut their food in the field. They glean the vineyard of the wicked.
In a field his provender they reap, And the vineyard of the wicked they glean.

24.he: עָר֣וֹם יָ֭לִינוּ מִבְּלִ֣י לְב֑וּשׁ וְאֵ֥ין כְּ֝ס֗וּת בַּקָּרָֽה׃

lines.text: They lie all night naked without clothing, and have no covering in the cold.
The naked they cause to lodge Without clothing. And there is no covering in the cold.

24.he: מִזֶּ֣רֶם הָרִ֣ים יִרְטָ֑בוּ וּֽמִבְּלִ֥י מַ֝חְסֶ֗ה חִבְּקוּ־צֽוּר׃

lines.text: They are wet with the showers of the mountains, and embrace the rock for lack of a shelter.
From the inundation of hills they are wet, And without a refuge — have embraced a rock.

24.he: יִ֭גְזְלוּ מִשֹּׁ֣ד יָת֑וֹם וְֽעַל־עָנִ֥י יַחְבֹּֽלוּ׃

lines.text: There are those who pluck the fatherless from the breast, and take a pledge of the poor,
They take violently away From the breast the orphan, And on the poor they lay a pledge.

24.he: עָר֣וֹם הִ֭לְּכוּ בְּלִ֣י לְב֑וּשׁ וּ֝רְעֵבִ֗ים נָ֣שְׂאוּ עֹֽמֶר׃

lines.text: So that they go around naked without clothing. Being hungry, they carry the sheaves.
Naked, they have gone without clothing, And hungry — have taken away a sheaf.

24.he: בֵּין־שׁוּרֹתָ֥ם יַצְהִ֑ירוּ יְקָבִ֥ים דָּ֝רְכ֗וּ וַיִּצְמָֽאוּ׃

lines.text: They make oil within the walls of these men. They tread wine presses, and suffer thirst.
Between their walls they make oil, Wine-presses they have trodden, and thirst.

24.he: מֵ֘עִ֤יר מְתִ֨ים ׀ יִנְאָ֗קוּ וְנֶֽפֶשׁ־חֲלָלִ֥ים תְּשַׁוֵּ֑עַ וֶ֝אֱל֗וֹהַּ לֹא־יָשִׂ֥ים תִּפְלָֽה׃

lines.text: From out of the populous city, men groan. The soul of the wounded cries out, yet God doesn’t regard the folly.
Because of enmity men do groan, And the soul of pierced ones doth cry, And God doth not give praise.

24.he: הֵ֤מָּה ׀ הָיוּ֮ בְּֽמֹרְדֵ֫י־א֥וֹר לֹֽא־הִכִּ֥ירוּ דְרָכָ֑יו וְלֹ֥א יָ֝שְׁב֗וּ בִּנְתִיבֹתָֽיו׃

lines.text: “These are of those who rebel against the light. They don’t know its ways, nor stay in its paths.
They have been among rebellious ones of light, They have not discerned His ways, Nor abode in His paths.

24.he: לָא֡וֹר יָ֘ק֤וּם רוֹצֵ֗חַ יִֽקְטָל־עָנִ֥י וְאֶבְי֑וֹן וּ֝בַלַּ֗יְלָה יְהִ֣י כַגַּנָּֽב׃

lines.text: The murderer rises with the light. He kills the poor and needy. In the night he is like a thief.
At the light doth the murderer rise, He doth slay the poor and needy, And in the night he is as a thief.

24.he: וְעֵ֤ין נֹאֵ֨ף ׀ שָׁ֤מְרָֽה נֶ֣שֶׁף לֵ֭אמֹר לֹא־תְשׁוּרֵ֣נִי עָ֑יִן וְסֵ֖תֶר פָּנִ֣ים יָשִֽׂים׃

lines.text: The eye also of the adulterer waits for the twilight, saying, ‘No eye will see me.’ He disguises his face.
And the eye of an adulterer Hath observed the twilight, Saying, 'No eye doth behold me.' And he putteth the face in secret.

24.he: חָתַ֥ר בַּחֹ֗שֶׁךְ בָּ֫תִּ֥ים יוֹמָ֥ם חִתְּמוּ־לָ֗מוֹ לֹא־יָ֥דְעוּ אֽוֹר׃

lines.text: In the dark they dig through houses. They shut themselves up in the daytime. They don’t know the light.
He hath dug in the darkness — houses; By day they shut themselves up, They have not known light.

24.he: כִּ֤י יַחְדָּ֨ו ׀ בֹּ֣קֶר לָ֣מוֹ צַלְמָ֑וֶת כִּֽי־יַ֝כִּ֗יר בַּלְה֥וֹת צַלְמָֽוֶת׃

lines.text: For the morning is to all of them like thick darkness, for they know the terrors of the thick darkness.
When together, morning [is] to them death shade, When he discerneth the terrors of death shade.

24.he: קַֽל־ה֤וּא ׀ עַל־פְּנֵי־מַ֗יִם תְּקֻלַּ֣ל חֶלְקָתָ֣ם בָּאָ֑רֶץ לֹֽא־יִ֝פְנֶה דֶּ֣רֶךְ כְּרָמִֽים׃

lines.text: “They are foam on the surface of the waters. Their portion is cursed in the earth. They don’t turn into the way of the vineyards.
Light he [is] on the face of the waters, Vilified is their portion in the earth, He turneth not the way of vineyards.

24.he: צִיָּ֤ה גַם־חֹ֗ם יִגְזְל֥וּ מֵֽימֵי־שֶׁ֗לֶג שְׁא֣וֹל חָטָֽאוּ׃

lines.text: Drought and heat consume the snow waters, so does Sheol those who have sinned.
Drought — also heat — consume snow-waters, Sheol [those who] have sinned.

24.he: יִשְׁכָּ֘חֵ֤הוּ רֶ֨חֶם ׀ מְתָ֘ק֤וֹ רִמָּ֗ה ע֥וֹד לֹֽא־יִזָּכֵ֑ר וַתִּשָּׁבֵ֖ר כָּעֵ֣ץ עַוְלָֽה׃

lines.text: The womb will forget him. The worm will feed sweetly on him. He will be no more remembered. Unrighteousness will be broken as a tree.
Forget him doth the womb, Sweeten [on] him doth the worm, No more is he remembered, And broken as a tree is wickedness.

24.he: רֹעֶ֣ה עֲ֭קָרָה לֹ֣א תֵלֵ֑ד וְ֝אַלְמָנָ֗ה לֹ֣א יְיֵטִֽיב׃

lines.text: He devours the barren who don’t bear. He shows no kindness to the widow.
Treating evil the barren [who] beareth not, And [to] the widow he doth no good,

24.he: וּמָשַׁ֣ךְ אַבִּירִ֣ים בְּכֹח֑וֹ יָ֝ק֗וּם וְֽלֹא־יַאֲמִ֥ין בַּֽחַיִּֽין׃

lines.text: Yet God preserves the mighty by his power. He rises up who has no assurance of life.
And hath drawn the mighty by his power, He riseth, and none believeth in life.

24.he: יִתֶּן־ל֣וֹ לָ֭בֶטַח וְיִשָּׁעֵ֑ן וְ֝עֵינֵ֗יהוּ עַל־דַּרְכֵיהֶֽם׃

lines.text: God gives them security, and they rest in it. His eyes are on their ways.
He giveth to him confidence, and he is supported, And his eyes [are] on their ways.

24.he: ר֤וֹמּוּ מְּעַ֨ט ׀ וְֽאֵינֶ֗נּוּ וְֽהֻמְּכ֗וּ כַּכֹּ֥ל יִקָּפְצ֑וּן וּכְרֹ֖אשׁ שִׁבֹּ֣לֶת יִמָּֽלוּ׃

lines.text: They are exalted; yet a little while, and they are gone. Yes, they are brought low, they are taken out of the way as all others, and are cut off as the tops of the ears of grain.
High they were [for] a little, and they are not, And they have been brought low. As all [others] they are shut up, And as the head of an ear of corn cut off.

24.he: וְאִם־לֹ֣א אֵ֭פוֹ מִ֣י יַכְזִיבֵ֑נִי וְיָשֵׂ֥ם לְ֝אַ֗ל מִלָּתִֽי׃

lines.text: If it isn’t so now, who will prove me a liar, and make my speech worth nothing?”
And if not now, who doth prove me a liar, And doth make of nothing my word?
Then Bildad the Shuhite answered,
And Bildad the Shuhite answereth and saith: —

25.he: הַמְשֵׁ֣ל וָפַ֣חַד עִמּ֑וֹ עֹשֶׂ֥ה שָׁ֝ל֗וֹם בִּמְרוֹמָֽיו׃

lines.text: “Dominion and fear are with him. He makes peace in his high places.
The rule and fear [are] with Him, Making peace in His high places.

25.he: הֲיֵ֣שׁ מִ֭סְפָּר לִגְדוּדָ֑יו וְעַל־מִ֝֗י לֹא־יָק֥וּם אוֹרֵֽהוּ׃

lines.text: Can his armies be counted? On whom does his light not arise?
Is their [any] number to His troops? And on whom ariseth not His light?

25.he: וּמַה־יִּצְדַּ֣ק אֱנ֣וֹשׁ עִם־אֵ֑ל וּמַה־יִּ֝זְכֶּ֗ה יְל֣וּד אִשָּֽׁה׃

lines.text: How then can man be just with God? Or how can he who is born of a woman be clean?
And what? is man righteous with God? And what? is he pure — born of a woman?

25.he: הֵ֣ן עַד־יָ֭רֵחַ וְלֹ֣א יַאֲהִ֑יל וְ֝כוֹכָבִ֗ים לֹא־זַכּ֥וּ בְעֵינָֽיו׃

lines.text: Behold, even the moon has no brightness, and the stars are not pure in his sight;
Lo — unto the moon, and it shineth not, And stars have not been pure in His eyes.
How much less man, who is a worm, the son of man, who is a worm!”
How much less man — a grub, And the son of man — a worm!
Then Job answered,
And Job answereth and saith: —
“How have you helped him who is without power! How have you saved the arm that has no strength!
What — thou hast helped the powerless, Saved an arm not strong!

26.he: מַה־יָּ֭עַצְתָּ לְלֹ֣א חָכְמָ֑ה וְ֝תוּשִׁיָּ֗ה לָרֹ֥ב הוֹדָֽעְתָּ׃

lines.text: How have you counseled him who has no wisdom, and plentifully declared sound knowledge!
What — thou hast given counsel to the unwise, And wise plans in abundance made known.

26.he: אֶת־מִ֭י הִגַּ֣דְתָּ מִלִּ֑ין וְנִשְׁמַת־מִ֝י יָצְאָ֥ה מִמֶּֽךָּ׃

lines.text: To whom have you uttered words? Whose spirit came out of you?
With whom hast thou declared words? And whose breath came forth from thee?
“The departed spirits tremble, those beneath the waters and all that live in them.
The Rephaim are formed, Beneath the waters, also their inhabitants.
