26.he: עָר֣וֹם שְׁא֣וֹל נֶגְדּ֑וֹ וְאֵ֥ין כְּ֝ס֗וּת לָֽאֲבַדּֽוֹן׃

lines.text: Sheol is naked before God, and Abaddon has no covering.
Naked [is] Sheol over-against Him, And there is no covering to destruction.

26.he: נֹטֶ֣ה צָפ֣וֹן עַל־תֹּ֑הוּ תֹּ֥לֶה אֶ֝֗רֶץ עַל־בְּלִי־מָֽה׃

lines.text: He stretches out the north over empty space, and hangs the earth on nothing.
Stretching out the north over desolation, Hanging the earth upon nothing,
He binds up the waters in his thick clouds, and the cloud is not burst under them.
Binding up the waters in His thick clouds, And the cloud is not rent under them.
He encloses the face of his throne, and spreads his cloud on it.
Taking hold of the face of the throne, Spreading over it His cloud.
He has described a boundary on the surface of the waters, and to the confines of light and darkness.
A limit He hath placed on the waters, Unto the boundary of light with darkness.
The pillars of heaven tremble and are astonished at his rebuke.
Pillars of the heavens do tremble, And they wonder because of His rebuke.

26.he: בְּ֭כֹחוֹ רָגַ֣ע הַיָּ֑ם ובתובנתו מָ֣חַץ רָֽהַב׃

lines.text: He stirs up the sea with his power, and by his understanding he strikes through Rahab.
By His power He hath quieted the sea, And by His understanding smitten the proud.

26.he: בְּ֭רוּחוֹ שָׁמַ֣יִם שִׁפְרָ֑ה חֹֽלֲלָ֥ה יָ֝ד֗וֹ נָחָ֥שׁ בָּרִֽיחַ׃

lines.text: By his Spirit the heavens are garnished. His hand has pierced the swift serpent.
By His Spirit the heavens He beautified, Formed hath His hand the fleeing serpent.

26.he: הֶן־אֵ֤לֶּה ׀ קְצ֬וֹת דרכו וּמַה־שֵּׁ֣מֶץ דָּ֭בָר נִשְׁמַע־בּ֑וֹ וְרַ֥עַם גבורתו מִ֣י יִתְבּוֹנָֽן׃

lines.text: Behold, these are but the outskirts of his ways. How small a whisper do we hear of him! But the thunder of his power who can understand?”
Lo, these [are] the borders of His way, And how little a matter is heard of Him, And the thunder of His might Who doth understand?

27.he: וַיֹּ֣סֶף אִ֭יּוֹב שְׂאֵ֥ת מְשָׁל֗וֹ וַיֹּאמַֽר׃

lines.text: Job again took up his parable, and said,
And Job addeth to lift up his simile, and saith: —

27.he: חַי־אֵ֭ל הֵסִ֣יר מִשְׁפָּטִ֑י וְ֝שַׁדַּ֗י הֵמַ֥ר נַפְשִֽׁי׃

lines.text: “As God lives, who has taken away my right, the Almighty, who has made my soul bitter
God liveth! He turned aside my judgment, And the Mighty — He made my soul bitter.

27.he: כִּֽי־כָל־ע֣וֹד נִשְׁמָתִ֣י בִ֑י וְר֖וּחַ אֱל֣וֹהַּ בְּאַפִּֽי׃

lines.text: (for the length of my life is still in me, and the spirit of God is in my nostrils);
For all the while my breath [is] in me, And the spirit of God in my nostrils.

27.he: אִם־תְּדַבֵּ֣רְנָה שְׂפָתַ֣י עַוְלָ֑ה וּ֝לְשׁוֹנִ֗י אִם־יֶהְגֶּ֥ה רְמִיָּֽה׃

lines.text: surely my lips will not speak unrighteousness, neither will my tongue utter deceit.
My lips do not speak perverseness, And my tongue doth not utter deceit.

27.he: חָלִ֣ילָה לִּי֮ אִם־אַצְדִּ֪יק אֶ֫תְכֶ֥ם עַד־אֶגְוָ֑ע לֹא־אָסִ֖יר תֻּמָּתִ֣י מִמֶּֽנִּי׃

lines.text: Far be it from me that I should justify you. Until I die I will not put away my integrity from me.
Pollution to me — if I justify you, Till I expire I turn not aside mine integrity from me.

27.he: בְּצִדְקָתִ֣י הֶ֭חֱזַקְתִּי וְלֹ֣א אַרְפֶּ֑הָ לֹֽא־יֶחֱרַ֥ף לְ֝בָבִ֗י מִיָּמָֽי׃

lines.text: I hold fast to my righteousness, and will not let it go. My heart will not reproach me so long as I live.
On my righteousness I have laid hold, And I do not let it go, My heart doth not reproach me while I live.

27.he: יְהִ֣י כְ֭רָשָׁע אֹ֣יְבִ֑י וּמִתְקוֹמְמִ֥י כְעַוָּֽל׃

lines.text: “Let my enemy be as the wicked. Let him who rises up against me be as the unrighteous.
As the wicked is my enemy, And my withstander as the perverse.

27.he: כִּ֤י מַה־תִּקְוַ֣ת חָ֭נֵף כִּ֣י יִבְצָ֑ע כִּ֤י יֵ֖שֶׁל אֱל֣וֹהַּ נַפְשֽׁוֹ׃

lines.text: For what is the hope of the godless, when he is cut off, when God takes away his life?
For what [is] the hope of the profane, When He doth cut off? When God doth cast off his soul?

27.he: הַֽ֭צַעֲקָתוֹ יִשְׁמַ֥ע ׀ אֵ֑ל כִּֽי־תָב֖וֹא עָלָ֣יו צָרָֽה׃

lines.text: Will God hear his cry when trouble comes on him?
His cry doth God hear, When distress cometh on him?

27.he: אִם־עַל־שַׁדַּ֥י יִתְעַנָּ֑ג יִקְרָ֖א אֱל֣וֹהַּ בְּכָל־עֵֽת׃

lines.text: Will he delight himself in the Almighty, and call on God at all times?
On the Mighty doth he delight himself? Call God at all times?

27.he: אוֹרֶ֣ה אֶתְכֶ֣ם בְּיַד־אֵ֑ל אֲשֶׁ֥ר עִם־שַׁ֝דַּ֗י לֹ֣א אֲכַחֵֽד׃

lines.text: I will teach you about the hand of God. I will not conceal that which is with the Almighty.
I shew you by the hand of God, That which [is] with the Mighty I hide not.

27.he: הֵן־אַתֶּ֣ם כֻּלְּכֶ֣ם חֲזִיתֶ֑ם וְלָמָּה־זֶּ֝֗ה הֶ֣בֶל תֶּהְבָּֽלוּ׃

lines.text: Behold, all of you have seen it yourselves; why then have you become altogether vain?
Lo, ye — all of you — have seen, And why [is] this — ye are altogether vain?

27.he: זֶ֤ה ׀ חֵֽלֶק־אָדָ֖ם רָשָׁ֥ע ׀ עִם־אֵ֑ל וְֽנַחֲלַ֥ת עָ֝רִיצִ֗ים מִשַׁדַּ֥י יִקָּֽחוּ׃

lines.text: “This is the portion of a wicked man with God, the heritage of oppressors, which they receive from the Almighty.
This [is] the portion of wicked man with God, And the inheritance of terrible ones From the Mighty they receive.

27.he: אִם־יִרְבּ֣וּ בָנָ֣יו לְמוֹ־חָ֑רֶב וְ֝צֶאֱצָאָ֗יו לֹ֣א יִשְׂבְּעוּ־לָֽחֶם׃

lines.text: If his children are multiplied, it is for the sword. His offspring will not be satisfied with bread.
If his sons multiply — for them [is] a sword. And his offspring [are] not satisfied [with] bread.

27.he: שרידו בַּמָּ֣וֶת יִקָּבֵ֑רוּ וְ֝אַלְמְנֹתָ֗יו לֹ֣א תִבְכֶּֽינָה׃

lines.text: Those who remain of him will be buried in death. His widows will make no lamentation.
His remnant in death are buried, And his widows do not weep.

27.he: אִם־יִצְבֹּ֣ר כֶּעָפָ֣ר כָּ֑סֶף וְ֝כַחֹ֗מֶר יָכִ֥ין מַלְבּֽוּשׁ׃

lines.text: Though he heap up silver as the dust, and prepare clothing as the clay;
If he heap up as dust silver, And as clay prepare clothing,

27.he: יָ֭כִין וְצַדִּ֣יק יִלְבָּ֑שׁ וְ֝כֶ֗סֶף נָקִ֥י יַחֲלֹֽק׃

lines.text: he may prepare it, but the just will put it on, and the innocent will divide the silver.
He prepareth — and the righteous putteth [it] on, And the silver the innocent doth apportion.

27.he: בָּנָ֣ה כָעָ֣שׁ בֵּית֑וֹ וּ֝כְסֻכָּ֗ה עָשָׂ֥ה נֹצֵֽר׃

lines.text: He builds his house as the moth, as a booth which the watchman makes.
He hath built as a moth his house, And as a booth a watchman hath made.

27.he: עָשִׁ֣יר יִ֭שְׁכַּב וְלֹ֣א יֵאָסֵ֑ף עֵינָ֖יו פָּקַ֣ח וְאֵינֶֽנּוּ׃

lines.text: He lies down rich, but he will not do so again. He opens his eyes, and he is not.
Rich he lieth down, and he is not gathered, His eyes he hath opened, and he is not.

27.he: תַּשִּׂיגֵ֣הוּ כַ֭מַּיִם בַּלָּה֑וֹת לַ֝֗יְלָה גְּנָבַ֥תּוּ סוּפָֽה׃

lines.text: Terrors overtake him like waters. A storm steals him away in the night.
Overtake him as waters do terrors, By night stolen him away hath a whirlwind.

27.he: יִשָּׂאֵ֣הוּ קָדִ֣ים וְיֵלַ֑ךְ וִֽ֝ישָׂעֲרֵ֗הוּ מִמְּקֹמֽוֹ׃

lines.text: The east wind carries him away, and he departs. It sweeps him out of his place.
Take him up doth an east wind, and he goeth, And it frighteneth him from his place,

27.he: וְיַשְׁלֵ֣ךְ עָ֭לָיו וְלֹ֣א יַחְמֹ֑ל מִ֝יָּד֗וֹ בָּר֥וֹחַ יִבְרָֽח׃

lines.text: For it hurls at him, and does not spare, as he flees away from his hand.
And it casteth at him, and doth not spare, From its hand he diligently fleeth.

27.he: יִשְׂפֹּ֣ק עָלֵ֣ימוֹ כַפֵּ֑ימוֹ וְיִשְׁרֹ֥ק עָ֝לָ֗יו מִמְּקֹמֽוֹ׃

lines.text: Men will clap their hands at him, and will hiss him out of his place.
It clappeth at him its hands, And it hisseth at him from his place.

28.he: כִּ֤י יֵ֣שׁ לַכֶּ֣סֶף מוֹצָ֑א וּ֝מָק֗וֹם לַזָּהָ֥ב יָזֹֽקּוּ׃

lines.text: “Surely there is a mine for silver, and a place for gold which they refine.
Surely there is for silver a source, And a place for the gold they refine;

28.he: בַּ֭רְזֶל מֵעָפָ֣ר יֻקָּ֑ח וְ֝אֶ֗בֶן יָצ֥וּק נְחוּשָֽׁה׃

lines.text: Iron is taken out of the earth, and copper is smelted out of the ore.
Iron from the dust is taken, And [from] the firm stone brass.

28.he: קֵ֤ץ ׀ שָׂ֤ם לַחֹ֗שֶׁךְ וּֽלְכָל־תַּ֭כְלִית ה֣וּא חוֹקֵ֑ר אֶ֖בֶן אֹ֣פֶל וְצַלְמָֽוֶת׃

lines.text: Man sets an end to darkness, and searches out, to the furthest bound, the stones of obscurity and of thick darkness.
An end hath he set to darkness, And to all perfection he is searching, A stone of darkness and death-shade.

28.he: פָּ֤רַץ נַ֨חַל ׀ מֵֽעִם־גָּ֗ר הַֽנִּשְׁכָּחִ֥ים מִנִּי־רָ֑גֶל דַּ֖לּוּ מֵאֱנ֣וֹשׁ נָֽעוּ׃

lines.text: He breaks open a shaft away from where people live. They are forgotten by the foot. They hang far from men, they swing back and forth.
A stream hath broken out from a sojourner, Those forgotten of the foot, They were low, from man they wandered.

28.he: אֶ֗רֶץ מִמֶּ֥נָּה יֵֽצֵא־לָ֑חֶם וְ֝תַחְתֶּ֗יהָ נֶהְפַּ֥ךְ כְּמוֹ־אֵֽשׁ׃

lines.text: As for the earth, out of it comes bread; Underneath it is turned up as it were by fire.
The earth! from it cometh forth bread, And its under-part is turned like fire.

28.he: מְקוֹם־סַפִּ֥יר אֲבָנֶ֑יהָ וְעַפְרֹ֖ת זָהָ֣ב לֽוֹ׃

lines.text: Sapphires come from its rocks. It has dust of gold.
A place of the sapphire [are] its stones, And it hath dust of gold.

28.he: נָ֭תִיב לֹֽא־יְדָ֣עוֹ עָ֑יִט וְלֹ֥א שְׁ֝זָפַ֗תּוּ עֵ֣ין אַיָּֽה׃

lines.text: That path no bird of prey knows, neither has the falcon’s eye seen it.
A path — not known it hath a ravenous fowl, Nor scorched it hath an eye of the kite,

28.he: לֹֽא־הִדְרִיכֻ֥הוּ בְנֵי־שָׁ֑חַץ לֹֽא־עָדָ֖ה עָלָ֣יו שָֽׁחַל׃

lines.text: The proud animals have not trodden it, nor has the fierce lion passed by there.
Nor trodden it have the sons of pride, Not passed over it hath the fierce lion.

28.he: בַּֽ֭חַלָּמִישׁ שָׁלַ֣ח יָד֑וֹ הָפַ֖ךְ מִשֹּׁ֣רֶשׁ הָרִֽים׃

lines.text: He puts his hand on the flinty rock, and he overturns the mountains by the roots.
Against the flint he sent forth his hand, He overturned from the root mountains.

28.he: בַּ֭צּוּרוֹת יְאֹרִ֣ים בִּקֵּ֑עַ וְכָל־יְ֝קָ֗ר רָאֲתָ֥ה עֵינֽוֹ׃

lines.text: He cuts out channels among the rocks. His eye sees every precious thing.
Among rocks, brooks he hath cleaved, And every precious thing hath his eye seen.

28.he: מִ֭בְּכִי נְהָר֣וֹת חִבֵּ֑שׁ וְ֝תַעֲלֻמָ֗הּ יֹ֣צִא אֽוֹר׃

lines.text: He binds the streams that they don’t trickle. The thing that is hidden he brings out to light.
From overflowing floods he hath bound, And the hidden thing bringeth out [to] light.

28.he: וְֽ֭הַחָכְמָה מֵאַ֣יִן תִּמָּצֵ֑א וְאֵ֥י זֶ֝ה מְק֣וֹם בִּינָֽה׃

lines.text: “But where will wisdom be found? Where is the place of understanding?
And the wisdom — whence is it found? And where [is] this, the place of understanding?

28.he: לֹא־יָדַ֣ע אֱנ֣וֹשׁ עֶרְכָּ֑הּ וְלֹ֥א תִ֝מָּצֵ֗א בְּאֶ֣רֶץ הַֽחַיִּֽים׃

lines.text: Man doesn’t know its price; Neither is it found in the land of the living.
Man hath not known its arrangement, Nor is it found in the land of the living.

28.he: תְּה֣וֹם אָ֭מַר לֹ֣א בִי־הִ֑יא וְיָ֥ם אָ֝מַ֗ר אֵ֣ין עִמָּדִֽי׃

lines.text: The deep says, ‘It isn’t in me.’ The sea says, ‘It isn’t with me.’
The deep hath said, 'It [is] not in me,' And the sea hath said, 'It is not with me.'

28.he: לֹא־יֻתַּ֣ן סְג֣וֹר תַּחְתֶּ֑יהָ וְלֹ֥א יִ֝שָּׁקֵ֗ל כֶּ֣סֶף מְחִירָֽהּ׃

lines.text: It can’t be gotten for gold, neither will silver be weighed for its price.
Gold is not given for it, Nor is silver weighed — its price.

28.he: לֹֽא־תְ֭סֻלֶּה בְּכֶ֣תֶם אוֹפִ֑יר בְּשֹׁ֖הַם יָקָ֣ר וְסַפִּֽיר׃

lines.text: It can’t be valued with the gold of Ophir, with the precious onyx, or the sapphire.
It is not valued with pure gold of Ophir, With precious onyx and sapphire,

28.he: לֹא־יַעַרְכֶ֣נָּה זָ֭הָב וּזְכוֹכִ֑ית וּתְמ֖וּרָתָ֣הּ כְּלִי־פָֽז׃

lines.text: Gold and glass can’t equal it, neither will it be exchanged for jewels of fine gold.
Not equal it do gold and crystal, Nor [is] its exchange a vessel of fine gold.

28.he: רָאמ֣וֹת וְ֭גָבִישׁ לֹ֣א יִזָּכֵ֑ר וּמֶ֥שֶׁךְ חָ֝כְמָ֗ה מִפְּנִינִֽים׃

lines.text: No mention will be made of coral or of crystal. Yes, the price of wisdom is above rubies.
Corals and pearl are not remembered, The acquisition of wisdom [is] above rubies.

28.he: לֹֽא־יַ֭עַרְכֶנָּה פִּטְדַת־כּ֑וּשׁ בְּכֶ֥תֶם טָ֝ה֗וֹר לֹ֣א תְסֻלֶּֽה׃

lines.text: The topaz of Ethiopia will not equal it, nor will it be valued with pure gold.
Not equal it doth the topaz of Cush, With pure gold it is not valued.

28.he: וְֽ֭הַחָכְמָה מֵאַ֣יִן תָּב֑וֹא וְאֵ֥י זֶ֝֗ה מְק֣וֹם בִּינָֽה׃

lines.text: Where then does wisdom come from? Where is the place of understanding?
And the wisdom — whence doth it come? And where [is] this, the place of understanding?

28.he: וְֽ֭נֶעֶלְמָה מֵעֵינֵ֣י כָל־חָ֑י וּמֵע֖וֹף הַשָּׁמַ֣יִם נִסְתָּֽרָה׃

lines.text: Seeing it is hidden from the eyes of all living, and kept close from the birds of the sky.
It hath been hid from the eyes of all living. And from the fowl of the heavens It hath been hidden.

28.he: אֲבַדּ֣וֹן וָ֭מָוֶת אָ֣מְר֑וּ בְּ֝אָזְנֵ֗ינוּ שָׁמַ֥עְנוּ שִׁמְעָֽהּ׃

lines.text: Destruction and Death say, ‘We have heard a rumor of it with our ears.’
Destruction and death have said: 'With our ears we have heard its fame.'

28.he: אֱ֭לֹהִים הֵבִ֣ין דַּרְכָּ֑הּ וְ֝ה֗וּא יָדַ֥ע אֶת־מְקוֹמָֽהּ׃

lines.text: “God understands its way, and he knows its place.
God hath understood its way, And He hath known its place.

28.he: כִּי־ה֭וּא לִקְצוֹת־הָאָ֣רֶץ יַבִּ֑יט תַּ֖חַת כָּל־הַשָּׁמַ֣יִם יִרְאֶֽה׃

lines.text: For he looks to the ends of the earth, and sees under the whole sky.
For He to the ends of the earth doth look, Under the whole heavens He doth see,

28.he: לַעֲשׂ֣וֹת לָר֣וּחַ מִשְׁקָ֑ל וּ֝מַ֗יִם תִּכֵּ֥ן בְּמִדָּֽה׃

lines.text: He establishes the force of the wind. Yes, he measures out the waters by measure.
To make for the wind a weight, And the waters He meted out in measure.

28.he: בַּעֲשֹׂת֣וֹ לַמָּטָ֣ר חֹ֑ק וְ֝דֶ֗רֶךְ לַחֲזִ֥יז קֹלֽוֹת׃

lines.text: When he made a decree for the rain, and a way for the lightning of the thunder,
In His making for the rain a limit, And a way for the brightness of the voices,

28.he: אָ֣ז רָ֭אָהּ וַֽיְסַפְּרָ֑הּ הֱ֝כִינָ֗הּ וְגַם־חֲקָרָֽהּ׃

lines.text: then he saw it, and declared it. He established it, yes, and searched it out.
Then He hath seen and declareth it, He hath prepared it, and also searched it out,

28.he: וַיֹּ֤אמֶר ׀ לָֽאָדָ֗ם הֵ֤ן יִרְאַ֣ת אֲ֭דֹנָי הִ֣יא חָכְמָ֑ה וְס֖וּר מֵרָ֣ע בִּינָֽה׃

lines.text: To man he said, ‘Behold, the fear of the Lord, that is wisdom. To depart from evil is understanding.’ ”
And He saith to man: — 'Lo, fear of the Lord, that [is] wisdom, And to turn from evil [is] understanding.'

29.he: וַיֹּ֣סֶף אִ֭יּוֹב שְׂאֵ֥ת מְשָׁל֗וֹ וַיֹּאמַֽר׃

lines.text: Job again took up his parable, and said,
And Job addeth to lift up his simile, and saith: —

29.he: מִֽי־יִתְּנֵ֥נִי כְיַרְחֵי־קֶ֑דֶם כִּ֝ימֵ֗י אֱל֣וֹהַּ יִשְׁמְרֵֽנִי׃

lines.text: “Oh that I were as in the months of old, as in the days when God watched over me;
Who doth make me as [in] months past, As [in] the days of God's preserving me?

29.he: בְּהִלּ֣וֹ נֵ֭רוֹ עֲלֵ֣י רֹאשִׁ֑י לְ֝אוֹרוֹ אֵ֣לֶךְ חֹֽשֶׁךְ׃

lines.text: when his lamp shone on my head, and by his light I walked through darkness,
In His causing His lamp to shine on my head, By His light I walk [through] darkness.

29.he: כַּאֲשֶׁ֣ר הָ֭יִיתִי בִּימֵ֣י חָרְפִּ֑י בְּס֥וֹד אֱ֝ל֗וֹהַּ עֲלֵ֣י אָהֳלִֽי׃

lines.text: as I was in my prime, when the friendship of God was in my tent,
As I have been in days of my maturity, And the counsel of God upon my tent.

29.he: בְּע֣וֹד שַׁ֭דַּי עִמָּדִ֑י סְבִ֖יבוֹתַ֣י נְעָרָֽי׃

lines.text: when the Almighty was yet with me, and my children were around me,
When yet the Mighty One [is] with me. Round about me — my young ones,

29.he: בִּרְחֹ֣ץ הֲלִיכַ֣י בְּחֵמָ֑ה וְצ֥וּר יָצ֥וּק עִ֝מָּדִ֗י פַּלְגֵי־שָֽׁמֶן׃

lines.text: when my steps were washed with butter, and the rock poured out streams of oil for me,
When washing my goings with butter, And the firm rock [is] with me rivulets of oil.

29.he: בְּצֵ֣אתִי שַׁ֣עַר עֲלֵי־קָ֑רֶת בָּ֝רְח֗וֹב אָכִ֥ין מוֹשָׁבִֽי׃

lines.text: when I went out to the city gate, when I prepared my seat in the street.
When I go out to the gate by the city, In a broad place I prepare my seat.

29.he: רָא֣וּנִי נְעָרִ֣ים וְנֶחְבָּ֑אוּ וִֽ֝ישִׁישִׁים קָ֣מוּ עָמָֽדוּ׃

lines.text: The young men saw me and hid themselves. The aged rose up and stood.
Seen me have youths, and they, been hidden, And the aged have risen — they stood up.

29.he: שָׂ֭רִים עָצְר֣וּ בְמִלִּ֑ים וְ֝כַ֗ף יָשִׂ֥ימוּ לְפִיהֶֽם׃

lines.text: The princes refrained from talking, and laid their hand on their mouth.
Princes have kept in words, And a hand they place on their mouth.

29.he: קוֹל־נְגִידִ֥ים נֶחְבָּ֑אוּ וּ֝לְשׁוֹנָ֗ם לְחִכָּ֥ם דָּבֵֽקָה׃

lines.text: The voice of the nobles was hushed, and their tongue stuck to the roof of their mouth.
The voice of leaders hath been hidden, And their tongue to the palate hath cleaved.

29.he: כִּ֤י אֹ֣זֶן שָׁ֭מְעָה וַֽתְּאַשְּׁרֵ֑נִי וְעַ֥ין רָ֝אֲתָ֗ה וַתְּעִידֵֽנִי׃

lines.text: For when the ear heard me, then it blessed me; and when the eye saw me, it commended me:
For the ear heard, and declareth me happy, And the eye hath seen, and testifieth [to] me.

29.he: כִּֽי־אֲ֭מַלֵּט עָנִ֣י מְשַׁוֵּ֑עַ וְ֝יָת֗וֹם וְֽלֹא־עֹזֵ֥ר לֽוֹ׃

lines.text: Because I delivered the poor who cried, and the fatherless also, who had no one to help him,
For I deliver the afflicted who is crying, And the fatherless who hath no helper.

29.he: בִּרְכַּ֣ת אֹ֭בֵד עָלַ֣י תָּבֹ֑א וְלֵ֖ב אַלְמָנָ֣ה אַרְנִֽן׃

lines.text: the blessing of him who was ready to perish came on me, and I caused the widow’s heart to sing for joy.
The blessing of the perishing cometh on me, And the heart of the widow I cause to sing.

29.he: צֶ֣דֶק לָ֭בַשְׁתִּי וַיִּלְבָּשֵׁ֑נִי כִּֽמְעִ֥יל וְ֝צָנִ֗יף מִשְׁפָּטִֽי׃

lines.text: I put on righteousness, and it clothed me. My justice was as a robe and a diadem.
Righteousness I have put on, and it clotheth me, As a robe and a diadem my justice.

29.he: עֵינַ֣יִם הָ֭יִיתִי לַֽעִוֵּ֑ר וְרַגְלַ֖יִם לַפִּסֵּ֣חַ אָֽנִי׃

lines.text: I was eyes to the blind, and feet to the lame.
Eyes I have been to the blind, And feet to the lame [am] I.

29.he: אָ֣ב אָ֭נֹכִֽי לָֽאֶבְיוֹנִ֑ים וְרִ֖ב לֹא־יָדַ֣עְתִּי אֶחְקְרֵֽהוּ׃

lines.text: I was a father to the needy. I researched the cause of him who I didn’t know.
A father I [am] to the needy, And the cause I have not known I search out.

29.he: וָֽ֭אֲשַׁבְּרָה מְתַלְּע֣וֹת עַוָּ֑ל וּ֝מִשִּׁנָּ֗יו אַשְׁלִ֥יךְ טָֽרֶף׃

lines.text: I broke the jaws of the unrighteous and plucked the prey out of his teeth.
And I break the jaw-teeth of the perverse, And from his teeth I cast away prey.

29.he: וָ֭אֹמַר עִם־קִנִּ֣י אֶגְוָ֑ע וְ֝כַח֗וֹל אַרְבֶּ֥ה יָמִֽים׃

lines.text: Then I said, ‘I will die in my own house, I will count my days as the sand.
And I say, 'With my nest I expire, And as the sand I multiply days.'

29.he: שָׁרְשִׁ֣י פָת֣וּחַ אֱלֵי־מָ֑יִם וְ֝טַ֗ל יָלִ֥ין בִּקְצִירִֽי׃

lines.text: My root is spread out to the waters. The dew lies all night on my branch.
My root is open unto the waters, And dew doth lodge on my branch.

29.he: כְּ֭בוֹדִי חָדָ֣שׁ עִמָּדִ֑י וְ֝קַשְׁתִּ֗י בְּיָדִ֥י תַחֲלִֽיף׃

lines.text: My glory is fresh in me. My bow is renewed in my hand.’
My honour [is] fresh with me, And my bow in my hand is renewed.

29.he: לִֽי־שָׁמְע֥וּ וְיִחֵ֑לּוּ וְ֝יִדְּמ֗וּ לְמ֣וֹ עֲצָתִֽי׃

lines.text: “Men listened to me, waited, and kept silence for my counsel.
To me they have hearkened, Yea, they wait, and are silent for my counsel.

29.he: אַחֲרֵ֣י דְ֭בָרִי לֹ֣א יִשְׁנ֑וּ וְ֝עָלֵ֗ימוֹ תִּטֹּ֥ף מִלָּתִֽי׃

lines.text: After my words they didn’t speak again. My speech fell on them.
After my word they change not, And on them doth my speech drop,

29.he: וְיִֽחֲל֣וּ כַמָּטָ֣ר לִ֑י וּ֝פִיהֶ֗ם פָּעֲר֥וּ לְמַלְקֽוֹשׁ׃

lines.text: They waited for me as for the rain. Their mouths drank as with the spring rain.
And they wait as [for] rain for me, And their mouth they have opened wide [As] for the latter rain.

29.he: אֶשְׂחַ֣ק אֲ֭לֵהֶם לֹ֣א יַאֲמִ֑ינוּ וְא֥וֹר פָּ֝נַ֗י לֹ֣א יַפִּילֽוּן׃

lines.text: I smiled on them when they had no confidence. They didn’t reject the light of my face.
I laugh unto them — they give no credence, And the light of my face cause not to fall.

29.he: אֶֽבֲחַ֣ר דַּרְכָּם֮ וְאֵשֵׁ֪ב רֹ֥אשׁ וְ֭אֶשְׁכּוֹן כְּמֶ֣לֶךְ בַּגְּד֑וּד כַּאֲשֶׁ֖ר אֲבֵלִ֣ים יְנַחֵֽם׃

lines.text: I chose out their way, and sat as chief. I lived as a king in the army, as one who comforts the mourners.
I choose their way, and sit head, And I dwell as a king in a troop, When mourners he doth comfort.

30.he: וְעַתָּ֤ה ׀ שָֽׂחֲק֣וּ עָלַי֮ צְעִירִ֥ים מִמֶּ֗נִּי לְיָ֫מִ֥ים אֲשֶׁר־מָאַ֥סְתִּי אֲבוֹתָ֑ם לָ֝שִׁ֗ית עִם־כַּלְבֵ֥י צֹאנִֽי׃

lines.text: “But now those who are younger than I have me in derision, whose fathers I considered unworthy to put with my sheep dogs.
And now, laughed at me, Have the younger in days than I, Whose fathers I have loathed to set With the dogs of my flock.

30.he: גַּם־כֹּ֣חַ יְ֭דֵיהֶם לָ֣מָּה לִּ֑י עָ֝לֵ֗ימוֹ אָ֣בַד כָּֽלַח׃

lines.text: Of what use is the strength of their hands to me, men in whom ripe age has perished?
Also — the power of their hands, why [is it] to me? On them hath old age perished.

30.he: בְּחֶ֥סֶר וּבְכָפָ֗ן גַּ֫לְמ֥וּד הַֽעֹרְקִ֥ים צִיָּ֑ה אֶ֝֗מֶשׁ שׁוֹאָ֥ה וּמְשֹׁאָֽה׃

lines.text: They are gaunt from lack and famine. They gnaw the dry ground, in the gloom of waste and desolation.
With want and with famine gloomy, Those fleeing to a dry place, Formerly a desolation and waste,

30.he: הַקֹּטְפִ֣ים מַלּ֣וּחַ עֲלֵי־שִׂ֑יחַ וְשֹׁ֖רֶשׁ רְתָמִ֣ים לַחְמָֽם׃

lines.text: They pluck salt herbs by the bushes. The roots of the broom tree are their food.
Those cropping mallows near a shrub, And broom-roots [is] their food.

30.he: מִן־גֵּ֥ו יְגֹרָ֑שׁוּ יָרִ֥יעוּ עָ֝לֵ֗ימוֹ כַּגַּנָּֽב׃

lines.text: They are driven out from among men. They cry after them as after a thief;
From the midst they are cast out, (They shout against them as a thief),

30.he: בַּעֲר֣וּץ נְחָלִ֣ים לִשְׁכֹּ֑ן חֹרֵ֖י עָפָ֣ר וְכֵפִֽים׃

lines.text: So that they dwell in frightful valleys, and in holes of the earth and of the rocks.
In a frightful place of valleys to dwell, Holes of earth and clefts.

30.he: בֵּין־שִׂיחִ֥ים יִנְהָ֑קוּ תַּ֖חַת חָר֣וּל יְסֻפָּֽחוּ׃

lines.text: They bray among the bushes. They are gathered together under the nettles .
Among shrubs they do groan, Under nettles they are gathered together.

30.he: בְּֽנֵי־נָ֭בָל גַּם־בְּנֵ֣י בְלִי־שֵׁ֑ם נִ֝כְּא֗וּ מִן־הָאָֽרֶץ׃

lines.text: They are children of fools, yes, children of wicked men. They were flogged out of the land.
Sons of folly — even sons without name, They have been smitten from the land.

30.he: וְ֭עַתָּה נְגִינָתָ֣ם הָיִ֑יתִי וָאֱהִ֖י לָהֶ֣ם לְמִלָּֽה׃

lines.text: “Now I have become their song. Yes, I am a byword to them.
And now, their song I have been, And I am to them for a byword.

30.he: תִּֽ֭עֲבוּנִי רָ֣חֲקוּ מֶ֑נִּי וּ֝מִפָּנַ֗י לֹא־חָ֥שְׂכוּ רֹֽק׃

lines.text: They abhor me, they stand aloof from me, and don’t hesitate to spit in my face.
They have abominated me, They have kept far from me, And from before me have not spared to spit.

30.he: כִּֽי־יתרו פִ֭תַּח וַיְעַנֵּ֑נִי וְ֝רֶ֗סֶן מִפָּנַ֥י שִׁלֵּֽחוּ׃

lines.text: For he has untied his cord, and afflicted me; and they have thrown off restraint before me.
Because His cord He loosed and afflicteth me, And the bridle from before me, They have cast away.

30.he: עַל־יָמִין֮ פִּרְחַ֪ח יָ֫ק֥וּמוּ רַגְלַ֥י שִׁלֵּ֑חוּ וַיָּסֹ֥לּוּ עָ֝לַ֗י אָרְח֥וֹת אֵידָֽם׃

lines.text: On my right hand rise the rabble. They thrust aside my feet, They cast up against me their ways of destruction.
On the right hand doth a brood arise, My feet they have cast away, And they raise up against me, Their paths of calamity.

30.he: נָתְס֗וּ נְֽתִיבָ֫תִ֥י לְהַוָּתִ֥י יֹעִ֑ילוּ לֹ֖א עֹזֵ֣ר לָֽמוֹ׃

lines.text: They mar my path. They promote my destruction without anyone’s help.
They have broken down my path, By my calamity they profit, 'He hath no helper.'

30.he: כְּפֶ֣רֶץ רָחָ֣ב יֶאֱתָ֑יוּ תַּ֥חַת שֹׁ֝אָ֗ה הִתְגַּלְגָּֽלוּ׃

lines.text: As through a wide breach they come. They roll themselves in amid the ruin.
As a wide breach they come, Under the desolation have rolled themselves.

30.he: הָהְפַּ֥ךְ עָלַ֗י בַּלָּ֫ה֥וֹת תִּרְדֹּ֣ף כָּ֭רוּחַ נְדִבָתִ֑י וּ֝כְעָ֗ב עָבְרָ֥ה יְשֻׁעָתִֽי׃

lines.text: Terrors have turned on me. They chase my honor as the wind. My welfare has passed away as a cloud.
He hath turned against me terrors, It pursueth as the wind mine abundance, And as a thick cloud, Hath my safety passed away.

30.he: וְעַתָּ֗ה עָ֭לַי תִּשְׁתַּפֵּ֣ךְ נַפְשִׁ֑י יֹ֭אחֲז֣וּנִי יְמֵי־עֹֽנִי׃

lines.text: “Now my soul is poured out within me. Days of affliction have taken hold of me.
And now, in me my soul poureth itself out, Seize me do days of affliction.

30.he: לַ֗יְלָה עֲ֭צָמַי נִקַּ֣ר מֵעָלָ֑י וְ֝עֹרְקַ֗י לֹ֣א יִשְׁכָּבֽוּן׃

lines.text: In the night season my bones are pierced in me, and the pains that gnaw me take no rest.
At night my bone hath been pierced in me, And mine eyelids do not lie down.

30.he: בְּרָב־כֹּ֭חַ יִתְחַפֵּ֣שׂ לְבוּשִׁ֑י כְּפִ֖י כֻתָּנְתִּ֣י יַֽאַזְרֵֽנִי׃

lines.text: My garment is disfigured by great force. It binds me about as the collar of my tunic.
By the abundance of power, Is my clothing changed, As the mouth of my coat it doth gird me.

30.he: הֹרָ֥נִי לַחֹ֑מֶר וָ֝אֶתְמַשֵּׁ֗ל כֶּעָפָ֥ר וָאֵֽפֶר׃

lines.text: He has cast me into the mire. I have become like dust and ashes.
Casting me into mire, And I am become like dust and ashes.

30.he: אֲשַׁוַּ֣ע אֵ֭לֶיךָ וְלֹ֣א תַעֲנֵ֑נִי עָ֝מַ֗דְתִּי וַתִּתְבֹּ֥נֶן בִּֽי׃

lines.text: I cry to you, and you do not answer me. I stand up, and you gaze at me.
I cry unto Thee, And Thou dost not answer me, I have stood, and Thou dost consider me.

30.he: תֵּהָפֵ֣ךְ לְאַכְזָ֣ר לִ֑י בְּעֹ֖צֶם יָדְךָ֣ תִשְׂטְמֵֽנִי׃

lines.text: You have turned to be cruel to me. With the might of your hand you persecute me.
Thou art turned to be fierce to me, With the strength of Thy hand, Thou oppressest me.

30.he: תִּשָּׂאֵ֣נִי אֶל־ר֭וּחַ תַּרְכִּיבֵ֑נִי וּ֝תְמֹגְגֵ֗נִי תשוה׃

lines.text: You lift me up to the wind, and drive me with it. You dissolve me in the storm.
Thou dost lift me up, On the wind Thou dost cause me to ride, And Thou meltest — Thou levellest me.

30.he: כִּֽי־יָ֭דַעְתִּי מָ֣וֶת תְּשִׁיבֵ֑נִי וּבֵ֖ית מוֹעֵ֣ד לְכָל־חָֽי׃

lines.text: For I know that you will bring me to death, To the house appointed for all living.
For I have known To death Thou dost bring me back, And [to] the house appointed for all living.

30.he: אַ֣ךְ לֹא־בְ֭עִי יִשְׁלַח־יָ֑ד אִם־בְּ֝פִיד֗וֹ לָהֶ֥ן שֽׁוּעַ׃

lines.text: “However doesn’t one stretch out a hand in his fall? Or in his calamity therefore cry for help?
Surely not against the heap Doth He send forth the hand, Though in its ruin they have safety.

30.he: אִם־לֹ֣א בָ֭כִיתִי לִקְשֵׁה־י֑וֹם עָֽגְמָ֥ה נַ֝פְשִׁ֗י לָאֶבְיֽוֹן׃

lines.text: Didn’t I weep for him who was in trouble? Wasn’t my soul grieved for the needy?
Did not I weep for him whose day is hard? Grieved hath my soul for the needy.

30.he: כִּ֤י ט֣וֹב קִ֭וִּיתִי וַיָּ֣בֹא רָ֑ע וַֽאֲיַחֲלָ֥ה לְ֝א֗וֹר וַיָּ֥בֹא אֹֽפֶל׃

lines.text: When I looked for good, then evil came. When I waited for light, darkness came.
When good I expected, then cometh evil, And I wait for light, and darkness cometh.

30.he: מֵעַ֖י רֻתְּח֥וּ וְלֹא־דָ֗מּוּ קִדְּמֻ֥נִי יְמֵי־עֹֽנִי׃

lines.text: My heart is troubled, and doesn’t rest. Days of affliction have come on me.
My bowels have boiled, and have not ceased, Gone before me have days of affliction.

30.he: קֹדֵ֣ר הִ֭לַּכְתִּי בְּלֹ֣א חַמָּ֑ה קַ֖מְתִּי בַקָּהָ֣ל אֲשַׁוֵּֽעַ׃

lines.text: I go mourning without the sun. I stand up in the assembly, and cry for help.
Mourning I have gone without the sun, I have risen, in an assembly I cry.

30.he: אָ֭ח הָיִ֣יתִי לְתַנִּ֑ים וְ֝רֵ֗עַ לִבְנ֥וֹת יַעֲנָֽה׃

lines.text: I am a brother to jackals, and a companion to ostriches.
A brother I have been to dragons, And a companion to daughters of the ostrich.

30.he: ע֭וֹרִי שָׁחַ֣ר מֵעָלָ֑י וְעַצְמִי־חָ֝֗רָה מִנִּי־חֹֽרֶב׃

lines.text: My skin grows black and peels from me. My bones are burned with heat.
My skin hath been black upon me, And my bone hath burned from heat,

30.he: וַיְהִ֣י לְ֭אֵבֶל כִּנֹּרִ֑י וְ֝עֻגָבִ֗י לְק֣וֹל בֹּכִֽים׃

lines.text: Therefore my harp has turned to mourning, and my pipe into the voice of those who weep.
And my harp doth become mourning, And my organ the sound of weeping.

31.he: בְּ֭רִית כָּרַ֣תִּי לְעֵינָ֑י וּמָ֥ה אֶ֝תְבּוֹנֵ֗ן עַל־בְּתוּלָֽה׃

lines.text: “I made a covenant with my eyes, how then should I look lustfully at a young woman?
A covenant I made for mine eyes, And what — do I attend to a virgin?

31.he: וּמֶ֤ה ׀ חֵ֣לֶק אֱל֣וֹהַּ מִמָּ֑עַל וְֽנַחֲלַ֥ת שַׁ֝דַּ֗י מִמְּרֹמִֽים׃

lines.text: For what is the portion from God above, and the heritage from the Almighty on high?
And what [is] the portion of God from above? And the inheritance of the Mighty from the heights?

31.he: הֲלֹא־אֵ֥יד לְעַוָּ֑ל וְ֝נֵ֗כֶר לְפֹ֣עֲלֵי אָֽוֶן׃

lines.text: Is it not calamity to the unrighteous, and disaster to the workers of iniquity?
Is not calamity to the perverse? And strangeness to workers of iniquity?

31.he: הֲלֹא־ה֭וּא יִרְאֶ֣ה דְרָכָ֑י וְֽכָל־צְעָדַ֥י יִסְפּֽוֹר׃

lines.text: Doesn’t he see my ways, and count all my steps?
Doth not He see my ways, And all my steps number?

31.he: אִם־הָלַ֥כְתִּי עִם־שָׁ֑וְא וַתַּ֖חַשׁ עַל־מִרְמָ֣ה רַגְלִֽי׃

lines.text: “If I have walked with falsehood, and my foot has hurried to deceit
If I have walked with vanity, And my foot doth hasten to deceit,

31.he: יִשְׁקְלֵ֥נִי בְמֹאזְנֵי־צֶ֑דֶק וְיֵדַ֥ע אֱ֝ל֗וֹהַּ תֻּמָּתִֽי׃

lines.text: (let me be weighed in an even balance, that God may know my integrity);
He doth weigh me in righteous balances, And God doth know my integrity.

31.he: אִ֥ם תִּטֶּ֣ה אַשֻּׁרִי֮ מִנִּ֪י הַ֫דָּ֥רֶךְ וְאַחַ֣ר עֵ֭ינַי הָלַ֣ךְ לִבִּ֑י וּ֝בְכַפַּ֗י דָּ֣בַק מֻאוּֽם׃

lines.text: if my step has turned out of the way, if my heart walked after my eyes, if any defilement has stuck to my hands,
If my step doth turn aside from the way, And after mine eyes hath my heart gone, And to my hands cleaved hath blemish,

31.he: אֶ֭זְרְעָה וְאַחֵ֣ר יֹאכֵ֑ל וְֽצֶאֱצָאַ֥י יְשֹׁרָֽשׁוּ׃

lines.text: then let me sow, and let another eat. Yes, let the produce of my field be rooted out.
Let me sow — and another eat, And my products let be rooted out.

31.he: אִם־נִפְתָּ֣ה לִ֭בִּי עַל־אִשָּׁ֑ה וְעַל־פֶּ֖תַח רֵעִ֣י אָרָֽבְתִּי׃

lines.text: “If my heart has been enticed to a woman, and I have laid wait at my neighbor’s door,
If my heart hath been enticed by woman, And by the opening of my neighbour I laid wait,

31.he: תִּטְחַ֣ן לְאַחֵ֣ר אִשְׁתִּ֑י וְ֝עָלֶ֗יהָ יִכְרְע֥וּן אֲחֵרִֽין׃

lines.text: then let my wife grind for another, and let others sleep with her.
Grind to another let my wife, And over her let others bend.

31.he: כִּי־הוא זִמָּ֑ה והיא עָוֺ֥ן פְּלִילִֽים׃

lines.text: For that would be a heinous crime. Yes, it would be an iniquity to be punished by the judges;
For it [is] a wicked thing, and a judicial iniquity;

31.he: כִּ֤י אֵ֣שׁ הִ֭יא עַד־אֲבַדּ֣וֹן תֹּאכֵ֑ל וּֽבְכָל־תְּב֖וּאָתִ֣י תְשָׁרֵֽשׁ׃

lines.text: for it is a fire that consumes to destruction, and would root out all my increase.
For a fire it [is], to destruction it consumeth, And among all mine increase doth take root,

31.he: אִם־אֶמְאַ֗ס מִשְׁפַּ֣ט עַ֭בְדִּי וַאֲמָתִ֑י בְּ֝רִבָ֗ם עִמָּדִֽי׃

lines.text: “If I have despised the cause of my male servant or of my female servant, when they contended with me,
If I despise the cause of my man-servant, And of my handmaid, In their contending with me,

31.he: וּמָ֣ה אֶֽ֭עֱשֶׂה כִּֽי־יָק֣וּם אֵ֑ל וְכִֽי־יִ֝פְקֹ֗ד מָ֣ה אֲשִׁיבֶֽנּוּ׃

lines.text: what then will I do when God rises up? When he visits, what will I answer him?
Then what do I do when God ariseth? And when He doth inspect, What do I answer Him?

31.he: הֲֽ֝לֹא־בַ֭בֶּטֶן עֹשֵׂ֣נִי עָשָׂ֑הוּ וַ֝יְכֻנֶ֗נּוּ בָּרֶ֥חֶם אֶחָֽד׃

lines.text: Didn’t he who made me in the womb make him? Didn’t one fashion us in the womb?
Did not He that made me in the womb make him? Yea, prepare us in the womb doth One.

31.he: אִם־אֶ֭מְנַע מֵחֵ֣פֶץ דַּלִּ֑ים וְעֵינֵ֖י אַלְמָנָ֣ה אֲכַלֶּֽה׃

lines.text: “If I have withheld the poor from their desire, or have caused the eyes of the widow to fail,
If I withhold from pleasure the poor, And the eyes of the widow do consume,

31.he: וְאֹכַ֣ל פִּתִּ֣י לְבַדִּ֑י וְלֹא־אָכַ֖ל יָת֣וֹם מִמֶּֽנָּה׃

lines.text: or have eaten my morsel alone, and the fatherless has not eaten of it
And I do eat my morsel by myself, And the orphan hath not eat of it,

31.he: כִּ֣י מִ֭נְּעוּרַי גְּדֵלַ֣נִי כְאָ֑ב וּמִבֶּ֖טֶן אִמִּ֣י אַנְחֶֽנָּה׃

lines.text: (no, from my youth he grew up with me as with a father, I have guided her from my mother’s womb);
(But from my youth He grew up with me as [with] a father, And from the belly of my mother I am led.)

31.he: אִם־אֶרְאֶ֣ה א֭וֹבֵד מִבְּלִ֣י לְב֑וּשׁ וְאֵ֥ין כְּ֝ס֗וּת לָאֶבְיֽוֹן׃

lines.text: if I have seen any perish for want of clothing, or that the needy had no covering;
If I see [any] perishing without clothing, And there is no covering to the needy,

31.he: אִם־לֹ֣א בֵרֲכ֣וּנִי חלצו וּמִגֵּ֥ז כְּ֝בָשַׂי יִתְחַמָּֽם׃

lines.text: if his heart hasn’t blessed me, if he hasn’t been warmed with my sheep’s fleece;
If his loins have not blessed me, And from the fleece of my sheep He doth not warm himself,

31.he: אִם־הֲנִיפ֣וֹתִי עַל־יָת֣וֹם יָדִ֑י כִּֽי־אֶרְאֶ֥ה בַ֝שַּׁ֗עַר עֶזְרָתִֽי׃

lines.text: if I have lifted up my hand against the fatherless, because I saw my help in the gate,
If I have waved at the fatherless my hand, When I see in [him] the gate of my court,

31.he: כְּ֭תֵפִי מִשִּׁכְמָ֣ה תִפּ֑וֹל וְ֝אֶזְרֹעִ֗י מִקָּנָ֥ה תִשָּׁבֵֽר׃

lines.text: then let my shoulder fall from the shoulder blade, and my arm be broken from the bone.
My shoulder from its blade let fall, And mine arm from the bone be broken.

31.he: כִּ֤י פַ֣חַד אֵ֭לַי אֵ֣יד אֵ֑ל וּ֝מִשְּׂאֵת֗וֹ לֹ֣א אוּכָֽל׃

lines.text: For calamity from God is a terror to me. Because of his majesty, I can do nothing.
For a dread unto me [is] calamity [from] God, And because of His excellency I am not able.

31.he: אִם־שַׂ֣מְתִּי זָהָ֣ב כִּסְלִ֑י וְ֝לַכֶּ֗תֶם אָמַ֥רְתִּי מִבְטַחִֽי׃

lines.text: “If I have made gold my hope, and have said to the fine gold, ‘You are my confidence;’
If I have made gold my confidence, And to the pure gold have said, 'My trust,'

31.he: אִם־אֶ֭שְׂמַח כִּי־רַ֣ב חֵילִ֑י וְכִֽי־כַ֝בִּ֗יר מָצְאָ֥ה יָדִֽי׃

lines.text: If I have rejoiced because my wealth was great, and because my hand had gotten much;
If I rejoice because great [is] my wealth, And because abundance hath my hand found,

31.he: אִם־אֶרְאֶ֣ה א֖וֹר כִּ֣י יָהֵ֑ל וְ֝יָרֵ֗חַ יָקָ֥ר הֹלֵֽךְ׃

lines.text: if I have seen the sun when it shined, or the moon moving in splendor,
If I see the light when it shineth, And the precious moon walking,

31.he: וַיִּ֣פְתְּ בַּסֵּ֣תֶר לִבִּ֑י וַתִּשַּׁ֖ק יָדִ֣י לְפִֽי׃

lines.text: and my heart has been secretly enticed, and my hand threw a kiss from my mouth,
And my heart is enticed in secret, And my hand doth kiss my mouth,

31.he: גַּם־ה֭וּא עָוֺ֣ן פְּלִילִ֑י כִּֽי־כִחַ֖שְׁתִּי לָאֵ֣ל מִמָּֽעַל׃

lines.text: this also would be an iniquity to be punished by the judges; for I should have denied the God who is above.
It also [is] a judicial iniquity, For I had lied to God above.

31.he: אִם־אֶ֭שְׂמַח בְּפִ֣יד מְשַׂנְאִ֑י וְ֝הִתְעֹרַ֗רְתִּי כִּֽי־מְצָ֥אוֹ רָֽע׃

lines.text: “If I have rejoiced at the destruction of him who hated me, or lifted up myself when evil found him
If I rejoice at the ruin of my hater, And stirred up myself when evil found him,

31.he: וְלֹא־נָתַ֣תִּי לַחֲטֹ֣א חִכִּ֑י לִשְׁאֹ֖ל בְּאָלָ֣ה נַפְשֽׁוֹ׃

lines.text: (yes, I have not allowed my mouth to sin by asking his life with a curse);
Yea, I have not suffered my mouth to sin, To ask with an oath his life.

31.he: אִם־לֹ֣א אָ֭מְרוּ מְתֵ֣י אָהֳלִ֑י מִֽי־יִתֵּ֥ן מִ֝בְּשָׂר֗וֹ לֹ֣א נִשְׂבָּֽע׃

lines.text: if the men of my tent have not said, ‘Who can find one who has not been filled with his meat?’
If not — say ye, O men of my tent, 'O that we had of his flesh, we are not satisfied.'

31.he: בַּ֭חוּץ לֹא־יָלִ֣ין גֵּ֑ר דְּ֝לָתַ֗י לָאֹ֥רַח אֶפְתָּֽח׃

lines.text: (the foreigner has not camped in the street, but I have opened my doors to the traveler);
In the street doth not lodge a stranger, My doors to the traveller I open.

31.he: אִם־כִּסִּ֣יתִי כְאָדָ֣ם פְּשָׁעָ֑י לִטְמ֖וֹן בְּחֻבִּ֣י עֲוֺֽנִי׃

lines.text: if like Adam I have covered my transgressions, by hiding my iniquity in my heart,
If I have covered as Adam my transgressions, To hide in my bosom mine iniquity,

31.he: כִּ֤י אֶֽעֱר֨וֹץ ׀ הָ֘מ֤וֹן רַבָּ֗ה וּבוּז־מִשְׁפָּח֥וֹת יְחִתֵּ֑נִי וָ֝אֶדֹּ֗ם לֹא־אֵ֥צֵא פָֽתַח׃

lines.text: because I feared the great multitude, and the contempt of families terrified me, so that I kept silence, and didn’t go out of the door—
Because I fear a great multitude, And the contempt of families doth affright me, Then I am silent, I go not out of the opening.

31.he: מִ֤י יִתֶּן־לִ֨י ׀ שֹׁ֘מֵ֤עַֽ לִ֗י הֶן־תָּ֭וִי שַׁדַּ֣י יַעֲנֵ֑נִי וְסֵ֥פֶר כָּ֝תַ֗ב אִ֣ישׁ רִיבִֽי׃

lines.text: oh that I had one to hear me! Behold, here is my signature! Let the Almighty answer me! Let the accuser write my indictment!
Who giveth to me a hearing? lo, my mark. The Mighty One doth answer me, And a bill hath mine adversary written.

31.he: אִם־לֹ֣א עַל־שִׁ֭כְמִי אֶשָּׂאֶ֑נּוּ אֶֽעֶנְדֶ֖נּוּ עֲטָר֣וֹת לִֽי׃

lines.text: Surely I would carry it on my shoulder; and I would bind it to me as a crown.
If not — on my shoulder I take it up, I bind it a crown on myself.

31.he: מִסְפַּ֣ר צְ֭עָדַי אַגִּידֶ֑נּוּ כְּמוֹ־נָ֝גִ֗יד אֲקָרֲבֶֽנּוּ׃

lines.text: I would declare to him the number of my steps. as a prince would I go near to him.
The number of my steps I tell Him, As a leader I approach Him.

31.he: אִם־עָ֭לַי אַדְמָתִ֣י תִזְעָ֑ק וְ֝יַ֗חַד תְּלָמֶ֥יהָ יִבְכָּיֽוּן׃

lines.text: If my land cries out against me, and its furrows weep together;
If against me my land doth cry out, And together its furrows weep,

31.he: אִם־כֹּ֭חָהּ אָכַ֣לְתִּי בְלִי־כָ֑סֶף וְנֶ֖פֶשׁ בְּעָלֶ֣יהָ הִפָּֽחְתִּי׃

lines.text: if I have eaten its fruits without money, or have caused its owners to lose their life,
If its strength I consumed without money, And the life of its possessors, I have caused to breathe out,

31.he: תַּ֤חַת חִטָּ֨ה ׀ יֵ֥צֵא ח֗וֹחַ וְתַֽחַת־שְׂעֹרָ֥ה בָאְשָׁ֑ה תַּ֝֗מּוּ דִּבְרֵ֥י אִיּֽוֹב׃

lines.text: let briers grow instead of wheat, and stinkweed instead of barley.” The words of Job are ended.
Instead of wheat let a thorn go forth, And instead of barley a useless weed! The words of Job are finished.

32.he: וַֽיִּשְׁבְּת֡וּ שְׁלֹ֤שֶׁת הָאֲנָשִׁ֣ים הָ֭אֵלֶּה מֵעֲנ֣וֹת אֶת־אִיּ֑וֹב כִּ֤י ה֖וּא צַדִּ֣יק בְּעֵינָֽיו׃

lines.text: So these three men ceased to answer Job, because he was righteous in his own eyes.
And these three men cease from answering Job, for he [is] righteous in his own eyes,

32.he: וַיִּ֤חַר אַ֨ף ׀ אֱלִיה֣וּא בֶן־בַּרַכְאֵ֣ל הַבּוּזִי֮ מִמִּשְׁפַּ֪חַ֫ת רָ֥ם בְּ֭אִיּוֹב חָרָ֣ה אַפּ֑וֹ עַֽל־צַדְּק֥וֹ נַ֝פְשׁ֗וֹ מֵאֱלֹהִֽים׃

lines.text: Then the wrath of Elihu the son of Barachel, the Buzite, of the family of Ram, was kindled against Job. His wrath was kindled because he justified himself rather than God.
and burn doth the anger of Elihu son of Barachel the Buzite, of the family of Ram; against Job hath his anger burned, because of his justifying himself more than God;

32.he: וּבִשְׁלֹ֣שֶׁת רֵעָיו֮ חָרָ֪ה אַ֫פּ֥וֹ עַ֤ל אֲשֶׁ֣ר לֹא־מָצְא֣וּ מַעֲנֶ֑ה וַ֝יַּרְשִׁ֗יעוּ אֶת־אִיּֽוֹב׃

lines.text: Also his wrath was kindled against his three friends, because they had found no answer, and yet had condemned Job.
and against his three friends hath his anger burned, because that they have not found an answer, and condemn Job.

32.he: וֶֽאֱלִיה֗וּ חִכָּ֣ה אֶת־אִ֭יּוֹב בִּדְבָרִ֑ים כִּ֤י זְֽקֵנִים־הֵ֖מָּה מִמֶּ֣נּוּ לְיָמִֽים׃

lines.text: Now Elihu had waited to speak to Job, because they were elder than he.
And Elihu hath waited earnestly beside Job with words, for they are older than he in days.

32.he: וַיַּ֤רְא אֱלִיה֗וּא כִּ֘י אֵ֤ין מַעֲנֶ֗ה בְּ֭פִי שְׁלֹ֥שֶׁת הָאֲנָשִׁ֗ים וַיִּ֥חַר אַפּֽוֹ׃

lines.text: When Elihu saw that there was no answer in the mouth of these three men, his wrath was kindled.
And Elihu seeth that there is no answer in the mouth of the three men, and his anger burneth.

32.he: וַיַּ֤עַן ׀ אֱלִיה֖וּא בֶן־בַּֽרַכְאֵ֥ל הַבּוּזִ֗י וַיֹּ֫אמַ֥ר צָ֘עִ֤יר אֲנִ֣י לְ֭יָמִים וְאַתֶּ֣ם יְשִׁישִׁ֑ים עַל־כֵּ֖ן זָחַ֥לְתִּי וָֽאִירָ֓א ׀ מֵחַוֺּ֖ת דֵּעִ֣י אֶתְכֶֽם׃

lines.text: Elihu the son of Barachel the Buzite answered, “I am young, and you are very old; Therefore I held back, and didn’t dare show you my opinion.
And Elihu son of Barachel the Buzite answereth and saith: — Young I [am] in days, and ye [are] age Therefore I have feared, And am afraid of shewing you my opinion.

32.he: אָ֭מַרְתִּי יָמִ֣ים יְדַבֵּ֑רוּ וְרֹ֥ב שָׁ֝נִ֗ים יֹדִ֥יעוּ חָכְמָֽה׃

lines.text: I said, ‘Days should speak, and multitude of years should teach wisdom.’
I said: Days do speak, And multitude of years teach wisdom.

32.he: אָ֭כֵן רֽוּחַ־הִ֣יא בֶאֱנ֑וֹשׁ וְנִשְׁמַ֖ת שַׁדַּ֣י תְּבִינֵֽם׃

lines.text: But there is a spirit in man, and the Spirit of the Almighty gives them understanding.
Surely a spirit is in man, And the breath of the Mighty One Doth cause them to understand.

32.he: לֹֽא־רַבִּ֥ים יֶחְכָּ֑מוּ וּ֝זְקֵנִ֗ים יָבִ֥ינוּ מִשְׁפָּֽט׃

lines.text: It is not the great who are wise, nor the aged who understand justice.
The multitude are not wise, Nor do the aged understand judgment.

32.he: לָכֵ֣ן אָ֭מַרְתִּי שִׁמְעָה־לִּ֑י אֲחַוֶּ֖ה דֵעִ֣י אַף־אָֽנִי׃

lines.text: Therefore I said, ‘Listen to me; I also will show my opinion.’
Therefore I have said: Hearken to me, I do shew my opinion — even I.

32.he: הֵ֤ן הוֹחַ֨לְתִּי לְֽדִבְרֵיכֶ֗ם אָ֭זִין עַד־תְּב֥וּנֹֽתֵיכֶ֑ם עַֽד־תַּחְקְר֥וּן מִלִּֽין׃

lines.text: “Behold, I waited for your words, and I listened for your reasoning, while you searched out what to say.
Lo, I have waited for your words, I give ear unto your reasons, Till ye search out sayings.

32.he: וְעָֽדֵיכֶ֗ם אֶתְבּ֫וֹנָ֥ן וְהִנֵּ֤ה אֵ֣ין לְאִיּ֣וֹב מוֹכִ֑יחַ עוֹנֶ֖ה אֲמָרָ֣יו מִכֶּֽם׃

lines.text: Yes, I gave you my full attention, but there was no one who convinced Job, or who answered his words, among you.
And unto you I attend, And lo, there is no reasoner for Job, [Or] answerer of his sayings among you.

32.he: פֶּן־תֹּ֣֭אמְרוּ מָצָ֣אנוּ חָכְמָ֑ה אֵ֖ל יִדְּפֶ֣נּוּ לֹא־אִֽישׁ׃

lines.text: Beware lest you say, ‘We have found wisdom. God may refute him, not man;’
Lest ye say, We have found wisdom, God doth thrust him away, not man.

32.he: וְלֹא־עָרַ֣ךְ אֵלַ֣י מִלִּ֑ין וּ֝בְאִמְרֵיכֶ֗ם לֹ֣א אֲשִׁיבֶֽנּוּ׃

lines.text: for he has not directed his words against me; neither will I answer him with your speeches.
And he hath not set in array words for me, And with your sayings I do not answer him.

32.he: חַ֭תּוּ לֹא־עָ֣נוּ ע֑וֹד הֶעְתִּ֖יקוּ מֵהֶ֣ם מִלִּֽים׃

lines.text: “They are amazed. They answer no more. They don’t have a word to say.
(They have broken down, They have not answered again, They removed from themselves words.

32.he: וְ֭הוֹחַלְתִּי כִּי־לֹ֣א יְדַבֵּ֑רוּ כִּ֥י עָ֝מְד֗וּ לֹא־עָ֥נוּ עֽוֹד׃

lines.text: Shall I wait, because they don’t speak, because they stand still, and answer no more?
And I have waited, but they do not speak, For they have stood still, They have not answered any more.)

32.he: אַעֲנֶ֣ה אַף־אֲנִ֣י חֶלְקִ֑י אֲחַוֶּ֖ה דֵעִ֣י אַף־אָֽנִי׃

lines.text: I also will answer my part, and I also will show my opinion.
I answer, even I — my share, I shew my opinion — even I.

32.he: כִּ֭י מָלֵ֣תִי מִלִּ֑ים הֱ֝צִיקַ֗תְנִי ר֣וּחַ בִּטְנִֽי׃

lines.text: For I am full of words. The spirit within me constrains me.
For I have been full of words, Distressed me hath the spirit of my breast,

32.he: הִנֵּֽה־בִטְנִ֗י כְּיַ֥יִן לֹא־יִפָּתֵ֑חַ כְּאֹב֥וֹת חֲ֝דָשִׁ֗ים יִבָּקֵֽעַ׃

lines.text: Behold, my breast is as wine which has no vent; like new wineskins it is ready to burst.
Lo, my breast [is] as wine not opened, Like new bottles it is broken up.

32.he: אֲדַבְּרָ֥ה וְיִֽרְוַֽח־לִ֑י אֶפְתַּ֖ח שְׂפָתַ֣י וְאֶֽעֱנֶֽה׃

lines.text: I will speak, that I may be refreshed. I will open my lips and answer.
I speak, and there is refreshment to me, I open my lips and answer.

32.he: אַל־נָ֭א אֶשָּׂ֣א פְנֵי־אִ֑ישׁ וְאֶל־אָ֝דָ֗ם לֹ֣א אֲכַנֶּֽה׃

lines.text: Please don’t let me respect any man’s person, neither will I give flattering titles to any man.
Let me not, I pray you, accept the face of any, Nor unto man give flattering titles,

32.he: כִּ֤י לֹ֣א יָדַ֣עְתִּי אֲכַנֶּ֑ה כִּ֝מְעַ֗ט יִשָּׂאֵ֥נִי עֹשֵֽׂנִי׃

lines.text: For I don’t know how to give flattering titles, or else my Maker would soon take me away.
For I have not known to give flattering titles, In a little doth my Maker take me away.

33.he: וְֽאוּלָ֗ם שְׁמַֽע־נָ֣א אִיּ֣וֹב מִלָּ֑י וְֽכָל־דְּבָרַ֥י הַאֲזִֽינָה׃

lines.text: “However, Job, please hear my speech, and listen to all my words.
And yet, I pray thee, O Job, Hear my speech and [to] all my words give ear.

33.he: הִנֵּה־נָ֭א פָּתַ֣חְתִּי פִ֑י דִּבְּרָ֖ה לְשׁוֹנִ֣י בְחִכִּֽי׃

lines.text: See now, I have opened my mouth. My tongue has spoken in my mouth.
Lo, I pray thee, I have opened my mouth, My tongue hath spoken in the palate.

33.he: יֹֽשֶׁר־לִבִּ֥י אֲמָרָ֑י וְדַ֥עַת שְׂ֝פָתַ֗י בָּר֥וּר מִלֵּֽלוּ׃

lines.text: My words will utter the uprightness of my heart. That which my lips know they will speak sincerely.
Of the uprightness of my heart [are] my sayings, And knowledge have my lips clearly spoken.

33.he: רֽוּחַ־אֵ֥ל עָשָׂ֑תְנִי וְנִשְׁמַ֖ת שַׁדַּ֣י תְּחַיֵּֽנִי׃

lines.text: The Spirit of God has made me, and the breath of the Almighty gives me life.
The Spirit of God hath made me, And the breath of the Mighty doth quicken me.

33.he: אִם־תּוּכַ֥ל הֲשִׁיבֵ֑נִי עֶרְכָ֥ה לְ֝פָנַ֗י הִתְיַצָּֽבָה׃

lines.text: If you can, answer me. Set your words in order before me, and stand up.
If thou art able — answer me, Set in array before me — station thyself.

33.he: הֵן־אֲנִ֣י כְפִ֣יךָ לָאֵ֑ל מֵ֝חֹ֗מֶר קֹרַ֥צְתִּי גַם־אָֽנִי׃

lines.text: Behold, I am toward God even as you are. I am also formed out of the clay.
Lo, I [am], according to thy word, for God, From the clay I — I also, have been formed.

33.he: הִנֵּ֣ה אֵ֭מָתִי לֹ֣א תְבַעֲתֶ֑ךָּ וְ֝אַכְפִּ֗י עָלֶ֥יךָ לֹא־יִכְבָּֽד׃

lines.text: Behold, my terror will not make you afraid, neither will my pressure be heavy on you.
Lo, my terror doth not frighten thee, And my burden on thee is not heavy.

33.he: אַ֭ךְ אָמַ֣רְתָּ בְאָזְנָ֑י וְק֖וֹל מִלִּ֣ין אֶשְׁמָֽע׃

lines.text: “Surely you have spoken in my hearing, I have heard the voice of your words, saying,
Surely — thou hast said in mine ears, And the sounds of words I hear:

33.he: זַ֥ךְ אֲנִ֗י בְּֽלִ֫י פָ֥שַׁע חַ֥ף אָנֹכִ֑י וְלֹ֖א עָוֺ֣ן לִֽי׃

lines.text: ‘I am clean, without disobedience. I am innocent, neither is there iniquity in me.
'Pure [am] I, without transgression, Innocent [am] I, and I have no iniquity.

33.he: הֵ֣ן תְּ֭נוּאוֹת עָלַ֣י יִמְצָ֑א יַחְשְׁבֵ֖נִי לְאוֹיֵ֣ב לֽוֹ׃

lines.text: Behold, he finds occasions against me. He counts me for his enemy.
Lo, occasions against me He doth find, He doth reckon me for an enemy to Him,

33.he: יָשֵׂ֣ם בַּסַּ֣ד רַגְלָ֑י יִ֝שְׁמֹ֗ר כָּל־אָרְחֹתָֽי׃

lines.text: He puts my feet in the stocks. He marks all my paths.’
He doth put in the stocks my feet, He doth watch all my paths.'

33.he: הֶן־זֹ֣את לֹא־צָדַ֣קְתָּ אֶעֱנֶ֑ךָּ כִּֽי־יִרְבֶּ֥ה אֱ֝ל֗וֹהַ מֵאֱנֽוֹשׁ׃

lines.text: “Behold, I will answer you. In this you are not just, for God is greater than man.
Lo, [in] this thou hast not been righteous, I answer thee, that greater is God than man.

33.he: מַ֭דּוּעַ אֵלָ֣יו רִיב֑וֹתָ כִּ֥י כָל־דְּ֝בָרָ֗יו לֹ֣א־יַעֲנֶֽה׃

lines.text: Why do you strive against him, because he doesn’t give account of any of his matters?
Wherefore against Him hast thou striven, When [for] all His matters He answereth not?

33.he: כִּֽי־בְאַחַ֥ת יְדַבֶּר־אֵ֑ל וּ֝בִשְׁתַּ֗יִם לֹ֣א יְשׁוּרֶֽנָּה׃

lines.text: For God speaks once, yes twice, though man pays no attention.
For once doth God speak, and twice, (He doth not behold it.)

33.he: בַּחֲל֤וֹם ׀ חֶזְי֬וֹן לַ֗יְלָה בִּנְפֹ֣ל תַּ֭רְדֵּמָה עַל־אֲנָשִׁ֑ים בִּ֝תְנוּמ֗וֹת עֲלֵ֣י מִשְׁכָּֽב׃

lines.text: In a dream, in a vision of the night, when deep sleep falls on men, in slumbering on the bed;
In a dream — a vision of night, In the falling of deep sleep on men, In slumberings on a bed.

33.he: אָ֣ז יִ֭גְלֶה אֹ֣זֶן אֲנָשִׁ֑ים וּבְמֹ֖סָרָ֣ם יַחְתֹּֽם׃

lines.text: Then he opens the ears of men, and seals their instruction,
Then He uncovereth the ear of men, And for their instruction sealeth:

33.he: לְ֭הָסִיר אָדָ֣ם מַעֲשֶׂ֑ה וְגֵוָ֖ה מִגֶּ֣בֶר יְכַסֶּֽה׃

lines.text: that he may withdraw man from his purpose, and hide pride from man.
To turn aside man [from] doing, And pride from man He concealeth.

33.he: יַחְשֹׂ֣ךְ נַ֭פְשׁוֹ מִנִּי־שָׁ֑חַת וְ֝חַיָּת֗וֹ מֵעֲבֹ֥ר בַּשָּֽׁלַח׃

lines.text: He keeps back his soul from the pit, and his life from perishing by the sword.
He keepeth back his soul from corruption, And his life from passing away by a dart.

33.he: וְהוּכַ֣ח בְּ֭מַכְאוֹב עַל־מִשְׁכָּב֑וֹ וריב עֲצָמָ֣יו אֵתָֽן׃

lines.text: He is chastened also with pain on his bed, with continual strife in his bones,
And he hath been reproved With pain on his bed, And the strife of his bones [is] enduring.

33.he: וְזִֽהֲמַ֣תּוּ חַיָּת֣וֹ לָ֑חֶם וְ֝נַפְשׁ֗וֹ מַאֲכַ֥ל תַּאֲוָֽה׃

lines.text: so that his life abhors bread, and his soul dainty food.
And his life hath nauseated bread, And his soul desirable food.

33.he: יִ֣כֶל בְּשָׂר֣וֹ מֵרֹ֑אִי ושפי עַ֝צְמוֹתָ֗יו לֹ֣א רֻאּֽוּ׃

lines.text: His flesh is so consumed away that it can’t be seen. His bones that were not seen stick out.
His flesh is consumed from being seen, And high are his bones, they were not seen!

33.he: וַתִּקְרַ֣ב לַשַּׁ֣חַת נַפְשׁ֑וֹ וְ֝חַיָּת֗וֹ לַֽמְמִתִֽים׃

lines.text: Yes, his soul draws near to the pit, and his life to the destroyers.
And draw near to the pit doth his soul, And his life to those causing death.

33.he: אִם־יֵ֤שׁ עָלָ֨יו ׀ מַלְאָ֗ךְ מֵלִ֗יץ אֶחָ֥ד מִנִּי־אָ֑לֶף לְהַגִּ֖יד לְאָדָ֣ם יָשְׁרֽוֹ׃

lines.text: “If there is beside him an angel, an interpreter, one among a thousand, to show to man what is right for him;
If there is by him a messenger, An interpreter — one of a thousand, To declare for man his uprightness:

33.he: וַיְחֻנֶּ֗נּוּ וַיֹּ֗אמֶר פְּ֭דָעֵהוּ מֵרֶ֥דֶת שָׁ֗חַת מָצָ֥אתִי כֹֽפֶר׃

lines.text: then God is gracious to him, and says, ‘Deliver him from going down to the pit, I have found a ransom.’
Then He doth favour him and saith, 'Ransom him from going down to the pit, I have found an atonement.'

33.he: רֻֽטֲפַ֣שׁ בְּשָׂר֣וֹ מִנֹּ֑עַר יָ֝שׁ֗וּב לִימֵ֥י עֲלוּמָֽיו׃

lines.text: His flesh will be fresher than a child’s. He returns to the days of his youth.
Fresher [is] his flesh than a child's, He returneth to the days of his youth.

33.he: יֶעְתַּ֤ר אֶל־אֱל֨וֹהַּ ׀ וַיִּרְצֵ֗הוּ וַיַּ֣רְא פָּ֭נָיו בִּתְרוּעָ֑ה וַיָּ֥שֶׁב לֶ֝אֱנ֗וֹשׁ צִדְקָתֽוֹ׃

lines.text: He prays to God, and he is favorable to him, so that he sees his face with joy. He restores to man his righteousness.
He maketh supplication unto God, And He accepteth him. And he seeth His face with shouting, And He returneth to man His righteousness.

33.he: יָשֹׁ֤ר ׀ עַל־אֲנָשִׁ֗ים וַיֹּ֗אמֶר חָ֭טָאתִי וְיָשָׁ֥ר הֶעֱוֵ֗יתִי וְלֹא־שָׁ֥וָה לִֽי׃

lines.text: He sings before men, and says, ‘I have sinned, and perverted that which was right, and it didn’t profit me.
He looketh on men, and saith, 'I sinned, And uprightness I have perverted, And it hath not been profitable to me.

33.he: פָּדָ֣ה נפשי מֵעֲבֹ֣ר בַּשָּׁ֑חַת וחיתי בָּא֥וֹר תִּרְאֶֽה׃

lines.text: He has redeemed my soul from going into the pit. My life will see the light.’
He hath ransomed my soul From going over into the pit, And my life on the light looketh.'

33.he: הֶן־כָּל־אֵ֭לֶּה יִפְעַל־אֵ֑ל פַּעֲמַ֖יִם שָׁל֣וֹשׁ עִם־גָּֽבֶר׃

lines.text: “Behold, God does all these things, twice, yes three times, with a man,
Lo, all these doth God work, Twice — thrice with man,

33.he: לְהָשִׁ֣יב נַ֭פְשׁוֹ מִנִּי־שָׁ֑חַת לֵ֝א֗וֹר בְּא֣וֹר הַֽחַיִּים׃

lines.text: to bring back his soul from the pit, that he may be enlightened with the light of the living.
To bring back his soul from the pit, To be enlightened with the light of the living.

33.he: הַקְשֵׁ֖ב אִיּ֥וֹב שְֽׁמַֽע־לִ֑י הַ֝חֲרֵ֗שׁ וְאָנֹכִ֥י אֲדַבֵּֽר׃

lines.text: Mark well, Job, and listen to me. Hold your peace, and I will speak.
Attend, O Job, hearken to me, Keep silent, and I — I do speak.

33.he: אִם־יֵשׁ־מִלִּ֥ין הֲשִׁיבֵ֑נִי דַּ֝בֵּ֗ר כִּֽי־חָפַ֥צְתִּי צַדְּקֶֽךָּ׃

lines.text: If you have anything to say, answer me. Speak, for I desire to justify you.
If there are words — answer me, Speak, for I have a desire to justify thee.

33.he: אִם־אַ֭יִן אַתָּ֥ה שְֽׁמַֽע־לִ֑י הַ֝חֲרֵ֗שׁ וַאֲאַלֶּפְךָ֥ חָכְמָֽה׃

lines.text: If not, listen to me. Hold your peace, and I will teach you wisdom.”
If there are not — hearken thou to me, Keep silent, and I teach thee wisdom.

34.he: וַיַּ֥עַן אֱלִיה֗וּא וַיֹּאמַֽר׃

lines.text: Moreover Elihu answered,
And Elihu answereth and saith:

34.he: שִׁמְע֣וּ חֲכָמִ֣ים מִלָּ֑י וְ֝יֹדְעִ֗ים הַאֲזִ֥ינוּ לִֽי׃

lines.text: “Hear my words, you wise men. Give ear to me, you who have knowledge.
Hear, O wise men, my words, And, O knowing ones, give ear to me.

34.he: כִּי־אֹ֭זֶן מִלִּ֣ין תִּבְחָ֑ן וְ֝חֵ֗ךְ יִטְעַ֥ם לֶאֱכֹֽל׃

lines.text: For the ear tries words, as the palate tastes food.
For the ear doth try words, And the palate tasteth to eat.

34.he: מִשְׁפָּ֥ט נִבְחֲרָה־לָּ֑נוּ נֵדְעָ֖ה בֵינֵ֣ינוּ מַה־טּֽוֹב׃

lines.text: Let us choose for us that which is right. Let us know among ourselves what is good.
Judgment let us choose for ourselves, Let us know among ourselves what [is] good.

34.he: כִּֽי־אָ֭מַר אִיּ֣וֹב צָדַ֑קְתִּי וְ֝אֵ֗ל הֵסִ֥יר מִשְׁפָּטִֽי׃

lines.text: For Job has said, ‘I am righteous, God has taken away my right:
For Job hath said, 'I have been righteous, And God hath turned aside my right,

34.he: עַל־מִשְׁפָּטִ֥י אֲכַזֵּ֑ב אָנ֖וּשׁ חִצִּ֣י בְלִי־פָֽשַׁע׃

lines.text: Notwithstanding my right I am considered a liar. My wound is incurable, though I am without disobedience.’
Against my right do I lie? Mortal [is] mine arrow — without transgression.'

34.he: מִי־גֶ֥בֶר כְּאִיּ֑וֹב יִֽשְׁתֶּה־לַּ֥עַג כַּמָּֽיִם׃

lines.text: What man is like Job, who drinks scorn like water,
Who [is] a man like Job? He drinketh scoffing like water,

34.he: וְאָרַ֣ח לְ֭חֶבְרָה עִם־פֹּ֣עֲלֵי אָ֑וֶן וְ֝לָלֶ֗כֶת עִם־אַנְשֵׁי־רֶֽשַׁע׃

lines.text: Who goes in company with the workers of iniquity, and walks with wicked men?
And he hath travelled for company With workers of iniquity, So as to go with men of wickedness.

34.he: כִּֽי־אָ֭מַר לֹ֣א יִסְכָּן־גָּ֑בֶר בִּ֝רְצֹת֗וֹ עִם־אֱלֹהִֽים׃

lines.text: For he has said, ‘It profits a man nothing that he should delight himself with God.’
For he hath said, 'It doth not profit a man, When he delighteth himself with God.'

34.he: לָכֵ֤ן ׀ אַ֥נֲשֵׁ֥י לֵבָ֗ב שִׁמְע֫וּ לִ֥י חָלִ֖לָה לָאֵ֥ל מֵרֶ֗שַׁע וְשַׁדַּ֥י מֵעָֽוֶל׃

lines.text: “Therefore listen to me, you men of understanding: far be it from God, that he should do wickedness, from the Almighty, that he should commit iniquity.
Therefore, O men of heart, hearken to me; Far be it from God to do wickedness, And [from] the Mighty to do perverseness:

34.he: כִּ֤י פֹ֣עַל אָ֭דָם יְשַׁלֶּם־ל֑וֹ וּֽכְאֹ֥רַח אִ֝֗ישׁ יַמְצִאֶֽנּוּ׃

lines.text: For the work of a man he will render to him, and cause every man to find according to his ways.
For the work of man he repayeth to him, And according to the path of each He doth cause him to find.

34.he: אַף־אָמְנָ֗ם אֵ֥ל לֹֽא־יַרְשִׁ֑יעַ וְ֝שַׁדַּ֗י לֹֽא־יְעַוֵּ֥ת מִשְׁפָּֽט׃

lines.text: Yes surely, God will not do wickedly, neither will the Almighty pervert justice.
Yea, truly, God doth not do wickedly, And the Mighty doth not pervert judgment.

34.he: מִֽי־פָקַ֣ד עָלָ֣יו אָ֑רְצָה וּמִ֥י שָׂ֝֗ם תֵּבֵ֥ל כֻּלָּֽהּ׃

lines.text: Who put him in charge of the earth? Or who has appointed him over the whole world?
Who hath inspected for Himself the earth? And who hath placed all the habitable world?

34.he: אִם־יָשִׂ֣ים אֵלָ֣יו לִבּ֑וֹ רוּח֥וֹ וְ֝נִשְׁמָת֗וֹ אֵלָ֥יו יֶאֱסֹֽף׃

lines.text: If he set his heart on himself, if he gathered to himself his spirit and his breath,
If He doth set on him His heart, His spirit and his breath unto Him He gathereth.

34.he: יִגְוַ֣ע כָּל־בָּשָׂ֣ר יָ֑חַד וְ֝אָדָ֗ם עַל־עָפָ֥ר יָשֽׁוּב׃

lines.text: all flesh would perish together, and man would turn again to dust.
Expire doth all flesh together, And man to dust returneth.

34.he: וְאִם־בִּ֥ינָה שִׁמְעָה־זֹּ֑את הַ֝אֲזִ֗ינָה לְק֣וֹל מִלָּֽי׃

lines.text: “If now you have understanding, hear this. Listen to the voice of my words.
And if [there is] understanding, hear this, Give ear to the voice of my words.

34.he: הַאַ֬ף שׂוֹנֵ֣א מִשְׁפָּ֣ט יַחֲב֑וֹשׁ וְאִם־צַדִּ֖יק כַּבִּ֣יר תַּרְשִֽׁיעַ׃

lines.text: Should even one who hates justice govern? Will you condemn him who is righteous and mighty?—
Yea, doth one hating justice govern? Or the Most Just dost thou condemn?

34.he: הַאֲמֹ֣ר לְמֶ֣לֶךְ בְּלִיָּ֑עַל רָ֝שָׁ֗ע אֶל־נְדִיבִֽים׃

lines.text: Who says to a king, ‘Vile!’ or to nobles, ‘Wicked!’?
Who hath said to a king — 'Worthless,' Unto princes — 'Wicked?'

34.he: אֲשֶׁ֤ר לֹֽא־נָשָׂ֨א ׀ פְּנֵ֥י שָׂרִ֗ים וְלֹ֣א נִכַּר־שׁ֭וֹעַ לִפְנֵי־דָ֑ל כִּֽי־מַעֲשֵׂ֖ה יָדָ֣יו כֻּלָּֽם׃

lines.text: He doesn’t respect the persons of princes, nor respect the rich more than the poor; for they all are the work of his hands.
That hath not accepted the person of princes, Nor hath known the rich before the poor, For a work of His hands [are] all of them.

34.he: רֶ֤גַע ׀ יָמֻתוּ֮ וַחֲצ֪וֹת לָ֥יְלָה יְגֹעֲשׁ֣וּ עָ֣ם וְיַעֲבֹ֑רוּ וְיָסִ֥ירוּ אַ֝בִּ֗יר לֹ֣א בְיָֽד׃

lines.text: In a moment they die, even at midnight. The people are shaken and pass away. The mighty are taken away without a hand.
[In] a moment they die, and at midnight Shake do people, and they pass away, And they remove the mighty without hand.

34.he: כִּי־עֵ֭ינָיו עַל־דַּרְכֵי־אִ֑ישׁ וְֽכָל־צְעָדָ֥יו יִרְאֶֽה׃

lines.text: “For his eyes are on the ways of a man. He sees all his goings.
For His eyes [are] on the ways of each, And all his steps He doth see.

34.he: אֵֽין־חֹ֭שֶׁךְ וְאֵ֣ין צַלְמָ֑וֶת לְהִסָּ֥תֶר שָׁ֝֗ם פֹּ֣עֲלֵי אָֽוֶן׃

lines.text: There is no darkness, nor thick gloom, where the workers of iniquity may hide themselves.
There is no darkness nor death-shade, For workers of iniquity to be hidden there;

34.he: כִּ֤י לֹ֣א עַל־אִ֭ישׁ יָשִׂ֣ים ע֑וֹד לַהֲלֹ֥ךְ אֶל־אֵ֝֗ל בַּמִּשְׁפָּֽט׃

lines.text: For he doesn’t need to consider a man further, that he should go before God in judgment.
For He doth not suffer man any more, To go unto God in judgment,

34.he: יָרֹ֣עַ כַּבִּירִ֣ים לֹא־חֵ֑קֶר וַיַּעֲמֵ֖ד אֲחֵרִ֣ים תַּחְתָּֽם׃

lines.text: He breaks mighty men in pieces in ways past finding out, and sets others in their place.
He breaketh the mighty — no searching! And He appointeth others in their stead.

34.he: לָכֵ֗ן יַ֭כִּיר מַעְבָּֽדֵיהֶ֑ם וְהָ֥פַךְ לַ֝֗יְלָה וְיִדַּכָּֽאוּ׃

lines.text: Therefore he takes knowledge of their works. He overturns them in the night, so that they are destroyed.
Therefore He knoweth their works, And He hath overturned by night, And they are bruised.

34.he: תַּֽחַת־רְשָׁעִ֥ים סְפָקָ֗ם בִּמְק֥וֹם רֹאִֽים׃

lines.text: He strikes them as wicked men in the open sight of others;
As wicked He hath stricken them, In the place of beholders.

34.he: אֲשֶׁ֣ר עַל־כֵּ֭ן סָ֣רוּ מֵֽאַחֲרָ֑יו וְכָל־דְּ֝רָכָ֗יו לֹ֣א הִשְׂכִּֽילוּ׃

lines.text: because they turned away from following him, and wouldn’t pay attention to any of his ways,
Because that against right They have turned aside from after Him, And none of His ways have considered wisely,

34.he: לְהָבִ֣יא עָ֭לָיו צַֽעֲקַת־דָּ֑ל וְצַעֲקַ֖ת עֲנִיִּ֣ים יִשְׁמָֽע׃

lines.text: so that they caused the cry of the poor to come to him. He heard the cry of the afflicted.
To cause to come in unto Him The cry of the poor, And the cry of the afflicted He heareth.

34.he: וְה֤וּא יַשְׁקִ֨ט ׀ וּמִ֥י יַרְשִׁ֗עַ וְיַסְתֵּ֣ר פָּ֭נִים וּמִ֣י יְשׁוּרֶ֑נּוּ וְעַל־גּ֖וֹי וְעַל־אָדָ֣ם יָֽחַד׃

lines.text: When he gives quietness, who then can condemn? When he hides his face, who then can see him? He is over a nation or a man alike,
And He giveth rest, and who maketh wrong? And hideth the face, and who beholdeth it? And in reference to a nation and to a man, [It is] the same.

34.he: מִ֭מְּלֹךְ אָדָ֥ם חָנֵ֗ף מִמֹּ֥קְשֵׁי עָֽם׃

lines.text: that the godless man may not reign, that there be no one to ensnare the people.
From the reigning of a profane man, From the snares of a people;

34.he: כִּֽי־אֶל־אֵ֭ל הֶאָמַ֥ר נָשָׂ֗אתִי לֹ֣א אֶחְבֹּֽל׃

lines.text: “For has any said to God, ‘I am guilty, but I will not offend any more.
For unto God hath any said: 'I have taken away, I do not corruptly,

34.he: בִּלְעֲדֵ֣י אֶ֭חֱזֶה אַתָּ֣ה הֹרֵ֑נִי אִֽם־עָ֥וֶל פָּ֝עַ֗לְתִּי לֹ֣א אֹסִֽיף׃

lines.text: Teach me that which I don’t see. If I have done iniquity, I will do it no more’?
Besides [that which] I see, shew Thou me, If iniquity I have done — I do not add?'

34.he: הַֽמֵעִמְּךָ֬ יְשַׁלְמֶ֨נָּה כִּֽי־מָאַ֗סְתָּ כִּי־אַתָּ֣ה תִבְחַ֣ר וְלֹא־אָ֑נִי וּֽמַה־יָדַ֥עְתָּ דַבֵּֽר׃

lines.text: Shall his recompense be as you desire, that you refuse it? For you must choose, and not I. Therefore speak what you know.
By thee doth He recompense, That thou hast refused — That thou dost choose, and not I? And what thou hast known, speak.

34.he: אַנְשֵׁ֣י לֵ֭בָב יֹ֣אמְרוּ לִ֑י וְגֶ֥בֶר חָ֝כָ֗ם שֹׁמֵ֥עַֽ לִֽי׃

lines.text: Men of understanding will tell me, yes, every wise man who hears me:
Let men of heart say to me, And a wise man is hearkening to me.

34.he: אִ֭יּוֹב לֹא־בְדַ֣עַת יְדַבֵּ֑ר וּ֝דְבָרָ֗יו לֹ֣א בְהַשְׂכֵּֽיל׃

lines.text: ‘Job speaks without knowledge. His words are without wisdom.’
Job — not with knowledge doth he speak, And his words [are] not with wisdom.

34.he: אָבִ֗י יִבָּחֵ֣ן אִיּ֣וֹב עַד־נֶ֑צַח עַל־תְּ֝שֻׁבֹ֗ת בְּאַנְשֵׁי־אָֽוֶן׃

lines.text: I wish that Job were tried to the end, because of his answering like wicked men.
My Father! let Job be tried — unto victory, Because of answers for men of iniquity,

34.he: כִּ֥י יֹ֘סִ֤יף עַֽל־חַטָּאת֣וֹ פֶ֭שַׁע בֵּינֵ֣ינוּ יִסְפּ֑וֹק וְיֶ֖רֶב אֲמָרָ֣יו לָאֵֽל׃

lines.text: For he adds rebellion to his sin. He claps his hands among us, and multiplies his words against God.”
For he doth add to his sin, Transgression among us he vomiteth, And multiplieth his sayings to God.
Moreover Elihu answered,
And Elihu answereth and saith: —

35.he: הֲ֭זֹאת חָשַׁ֣בְתָּ לְמִשְׁפָּ֑ט אָ֝מַ֗רְתָּ צִדְקִ֥י מֵאֵֽל׃

lines.text: “Do you think this to be your right, or do you say, ‘My righteousness is more than God’s,’
This hast thou reckoned for judgment: Thou hast said — 'My righteousness [is] more than God's?'
that you ask, ‘What advantage will it be to you? What profit will I have, more than if I had sinned?’
For thou sayest, 'What doth it profit Thee! What do I profit from my sin?'
I will answer you, and your companions with you.
I return thee words, and thy friends with thee,

35.he: הַבֵּ֣ט שָׁמַ֣יִם וּרְאֵ֑ה וְשׁ֥וּר שְׁ֝חָקִ֗ים גָּבְה֥וּ מִמֶּֽךָּ׃

lines.text: Look to the skies, and see. See the skies, which are higher than you.
Behold attentively the heavens — and see, And behold the clouds, They have been higher than thou.
If you have sinned, what effect do you have against him? If your transgressions are multiplied, what do you do to him?
If thou hast sinned, what dost thou against Him? And thy transgressions have been multiplied, What dost thou to Him?
If you are righteous, what do you give him? Or what does he receive from your hand?
If thou hast been righteous, What dost thou give to Him? Or what from thy hand doth He receive?
Your wickedness may hurt a man as you are, and your righteousness may profit a son of man.
For a man like thyself [is] thy wickedness, And for a son of man thy righteousness.

35.he: מֵ֭רֹב עֲשׁוּקִ֣ים יַזְעִ֑יקוּ יְשַׁוְּע֖וּ מִזְּר֣וֹעַ רַבִּֽים׃

lines.text: “By reason of the multitude of oppressions they cry out. They cry for help by reason of the arm of the mighty.
Because of the multitude of oppressions They cause to cry out, They cry because of the arm of the mighty.

35.he: וְֽלֹא־אָמַ֗ר אַ֭יֵּה אֱל֣וֹהַּ עֹשָׂ֑י נֹתֵ֖ן זְמִר֣וֹת בַּלָּֽיְלָה׃

lines.text: But no one says, ‘Where is God my Maker, who gives songs in the night,
And none said, 'Where [is] God my maker? Giving songs in the night,

35.he: מַ֭לְּפֵנוּ מִבַּהֲמ֣וֹת אָ֑רֶץ וּמֵע֖וֹף הַשָּׁמַ֣יִם יְחַכְּמֵֽנוּ׃

lines.text: who teaches us more than the animals of the earth, and makes us wiser than the birds of the sky?’
Teaching us more than the beasts of the earth, Yea, than the fowl of the heavens He maketh us wiser.'

35.he: שָׁ֣ם יִ֭צְעֲקוּ וְלֹ֣א יַעֲנֶ֑ה מִ֝פְּנֵ֗י גְּא֣וֹן רָעִֽים׃

lines.text: There they cry, but no one answers, because of the pride of evil men.
There they cry, and He doth not answer, Because of the pride of evil doers.

35.he: אַךְ־שָׁ֭וְא לֹא־יִשְׁמַ֥ע ׀ אֵ֑ל וְ֝שַׁדַּ֗י לֹ֣א יְשׁוּרֶֽנָּה׃

lines.text: Surely God will not hear an empty cry, neither will the Almighty regard it.
Surely vanity God doth not hear, And the Mighty doth not behold it.

35.he: אַ֣ף כִּֽי־תֹ֭אמַר לֹ֣א תְשׁוּרֶ֑נּוּ דִּ֥ין לְ֝פָנָ֗יו וּתְח֥וֹלֵֽל לֽוֹ׃

lines.text: How much less when you say you don’t see him. The cause is before him, and you wait for him!
Yea, though thou sayest thou dost not behold Him, Judgment [is] before Him, and stay for Him.

35.he: וְעַתָּ֗ה כִּי־אַ֭יִן פָּקַ֣ד אַפּ֑וֹ וְלֹֽא־יָדַ֖ע בַּפַּ֣שׁ מְאֹֽד׃

lines.text: But now, because he has not visited in his anger, neither does he greatly regard arrogance.
And, now, because there is not, He hath appointed His anger, And He hath not known in great extremity.

35.he: וְ֭אִיּוֹב הֶ֣בֶל יִפְצֶה־פִּ֑יהוּ בִּבְלִי־דַ֝֗עַת מִלִּ֥ין יַכְבִּֽר׃

lines.text: Therefore Job opens his mouth with empty talk, and he multiplies words without knowledge.”
And Job [with] vanity doth open his mouth, Without knowledge words he multiplieth.

36.he: וַיֹּ֥סֶף אֱלִיה֗וּא וַיֹּאמַֽר׃

lines.text: Elihu also continued, and said,
And Elihu addeth and saith: —

36.he: כַּתַּר־לִ֣י זְ֭עֵיר וַאֲחַוֶּ֑ךָּ כִּ֤י ע֖וֹד לֶאֱל֣וֹהַּ מִלִּֽים׃

lines.text: “Bear with me a little, and I will show you; for I still have something to say on God’s behalf.
Honour me a little, and I shew thee, That yet for God [are] words.

36.he: אֶשָּׂ֣א דֵ֭עִי לְמֵרָח֑וֹק וּ֝לְפֹעֲלִ֗י אֶֽתֵּֽן־צֶֽדֶק׃

lines.text: I will get my knowledge from afar, and will ascribe righteousness to my Maker.
I lift up my knowledge from afar, And to my Maker I ascribe righteousness.

36.he: כִּֽי־אָ֭מְנָם לֹא־שֶׁ֣קֶר מִלָּ֑י תְּמִ֖ים דֵּע֣וֹת עִמָּֽךְ׃

lines.text: For truly my words are not false. One who is perfect in knowledge is with you.
For, truly, my words [are] not false, The perfect in knowledge [is] with thee.

36.he: הֶן־אֵ֣ל כַּ֭בִּיר וְלֹ֣א יִמְאָ֑ס כַּ֝בִּ֗יר כֹּ֣חַֽ לֵֽב׃

lines.text: “Behold, God is mighty, and doesn’t despise anyone. He is mighty in strength of understanding.
Lo, God [is] mighty, and despiseth not, Mighty [in] power [and] heart.

36.he: לֹא־יְחַיֶּ֥ה רָשָׁ֑ע וּמִשְׁפַּ֖ט עֲנִיִּ֣ים יִתֵּֽן׃

lines.text: He doesn’t preserve the life of the wicked, but gives justice to the afflicted.
He reviveth not the wicked, And the judgment of the poor appointeth;

36.he: לֹֽא־יִגְרַ֥ע מִצַּדִּ֗יק עֵ֫ינָ֥יו וְאֶת־מְלָכִ֥ים לַכִּסֵּ֑א וַיֹּשִׁיבֵ֥ם לָ֝נֶ֗צַח וַיִּגְבָּֽהוּ׃

lines.text: He doesn’t withdraw his eyes from the righteous, but with kings on the throne, he sets them forever, and they are exalted.
He withdraweth not from the righteous His eyes, And [from] kings on the throne, And causeth them to sit for ever, and they are high,

36.he: וְאִם־אֲסוּרִ֥ים בַּזִּקִּ֑ים יִ֝לָּכְד֗וּן בְּחַבְלֵי־עֹֽנִי׃

lines.text: If they are bound in fetters, and are taken in the cords of afflictions,
And if prisoners in fetters They are captured with cords of affliction,

36.he: וַיַּגֵּ֣ד לָהֶ֣ם פָּעֳלָ֑ם וּ֝פִשְׁעֵיהֶ֗ם כִּ֣י יִתְגַּבָּֽרוּ׃

lines.text: then he shows them their work, and their transgressions, that they have behaved themselves proudly.
Then He declareth to them their work, And their transgressions, Because they have become mighty,

36.he: וַיִּ֣גֶל אָ֭זְנָם לַמּוּסָ֑ר וַ֝יֹּ֗אמֶר כִּֽי־יְשֻׁב֥וּן מֵאָֽוֶן׃

lines.text: He also opens their ears to instruction, and commands that they return from iniquity.
And He uncovereth their ear for instruction, And saith that they turn back from iniquity.

36.he: אִֽם־יִשְׁמְע֗וּ וְֽיַעֲ֫בֹ֥דוּ יְכַלּ֣וּ יְמֵיהֶ֣ם בַּטּ֑וֹב וּ֝שְׁנֵיהֶ֗ם בַּנְּעִימִֽים׃

lines.text: If they listen and serve him, they will spend their days in prosperity, and their years in pleasures.
If they do hear and serve, They complete their days in good, And their years in pleasantness.

36.he: וְאִם־לֹ֣א יִ֭שְׁמְעוּ בְּשֶׁ֣לַח יַעֲבֹ֑רוּ וְ֝יִגְוְע֗וּ כִּבְלִי־דָֽעַת׃

lines.text: But if they don’t listen, they will perish by the sword; they will die without knowledge.
And if they do not hearken, By the dart they pass away, And expire without knowledge.

36.he: וְֽחַנְפֵי־לֵ֭ב יָשִׂ֣ימוּ אָ֑ף לֹ֥א יְ֝שַׁוְּע֗וּ כִּ֣י אֲסָרָֽם׃

lines.text: “But those who are godless in heart lay up anger. They don’t cry for help when he binds them.
And the profane in heart set the face, They cry not when He hath bound them.

36.he: תָּמֹ֣ת בַּנֹּ֣עַר נַפְשָׁ֑ם וְ֝חַיָּתָ֗ם בַּקְּדֵשִֽׁים׃

lines.text: They die in youth. Their life perishes among the unclean.
Their soul dieth in youth, And their life among the defiled.

36.he: יְחַלֵּ֣ץ עָנִ֣י בְעָנְי֑וֹ וְיִ֖גֶל בַּלַּ֣חַץ אָזְנָֽם׃

lines.text: He delivers the afflicted by their affliction, and opens their ear in oppression.
He draweth out the afflicted in his affliction, And uncovereth in oppression their ear.

36.he: וְאַ֤ף הֲסִיתְךָ֨ ׀ מִפִּי־צָ֗ר רַ֭חַב לֹא־מוּצָ֣ק תַּחְתֶּ֑יהָ וְנַ֥חַת שֻׁ֝לְחָנְךָ֗ מָ֣לֵא דָֽשֶׁן׃

lines.text: Yes, he would have allured you out of distress, into a wide place, where there is no restriction. That which is set on your table would be full of fatness.
And also He moved thee from a strait place, [To] a broad place — no straitness under it, And the sitting beyond of thy table Hath been full of fatness.

36.he: וְדִין־רָשָׁ֥ע מָלֵ֑אתָ דִּ֖ין וּמִשְׁפָּ֣ט יִתְמֹֽכוּ׃

lines.text: “But you are full of the judgment of the wicked. Judgment and justice take hold of you.
And the judgment of the wicked thou hast fulfilled, Judgment and justice are upheld — because of fury,

36.he: כִּֽי־חֵ֭מָה פֶּן־יְסִֽיתְךָ֣ בְסָ֑פֶק וְרָב־כֹּ֝֗פֶר אַל־יַטֶּֽךָּ׃

lines.text: Don’t let riches entice you to wrath, neither let the great size of a bribe turn you aside.
Lest He move thee with a stroke, And the abundance of an atonement turn thee not aside.

36.he: הֲיַעֲרֹ֣ךְ שׁ֭וּעֲךָ לֹ֣א בְצָ֑ר וְ֝כֹ֗ל מַאֲמַצֵּי־כֹֽחַ׃

lines.text: Would your wealth sustain you in distress, or all the might of your strength?
Doth He value thy riches? He hath gold, and all the forces of power.

36.he: אַל־תִּשְׁאַ֥ף הַלָּ֑יְלָה לַעֲל֖וֹת עַמִּ֣ים תַּחְתָּֽם׃

lines.text: Don’t desire the night, when people are cut off in their place.
Desire not the night, For the going up of peoples in their stead.

36.he: הִ֭שָּׁמֶר אַל־תֵּ֣פֶן אֶל־אָ֑וֶן כִּֽי־עַל־זֶ֝֗ה בָּחַ֥רְתָּ מֵעֹֽנִי׃

lines.text: Take heed, don’t regard iniquity; for you have chosen this rather than affliction.
Take heed — do not turn unto iniquity, For on this thou hast fixed Rather than [on] affliction.

36.he: הֶן־אֵ֭ל יַשְׂגִּ֣יב בְּכֹח֑וֹ מִ֖י כָמֹ֣הוּ מוֹרֶֽה׃

lines.text: Behold, God is exalted in his power. Who is a teacher like him?
Lo, God doth sit on high by His power, Who [is] like Him — a teacher?

36.he: מִֽי־פָקַ֣ד עָלָ֣יו דַּרְכּ֑וֹ וּמִֽי־אָ֝מַ֗ר פָּעַ֥לְתָּ עַוְלָֽה׃

lines.text: Who has prescribed his way for him? Or who can say, ‘You have committed unrighteousness?’
Who hath appointed unto Him his way? And who said, 'Thou hast done iniquity?'

36.he: זְ֭כֹר כִּֽי־תַשְׂגִּ֣יא פָעֳל֑וֹ אֲשֶׁ֖ר שֹׁרְר֣וּ אֲנָשִֽׁים׃

lines.text: “Remember that you magnify his work, about which men have sung.
Remember that thou magnify His work That men have beheld.

36.he: כָּל־אָדָ֥ם חָֽזוּ־ב֑וֹ אֱ֝נ֗וֹשׁ יַבִּ֥יט מֵרָחֽוֹק׃

lines.text: All men have looked on it. Man sees it afar off.
All men have looked on it, Man looketh attentively from afar.

36.he: הֶן־אֵ֣ל שַׂ֭גִּיא וְלֹ֣א נֵדָ֑ע מִסְפַּ֖ר שָׁנָ֣יו וְלֹא־חֵֽקֶר׃

lines.text: Behold, God is great, and we don’t know him. The number of his years is unsearchable.
Lo, God [is] high, And we know not the number of His years, Yea, there [is] no searching.

36.he: כִּ֭י יְגָרַ֣ע נִטְפֵי־מָ֑יִם יָזֹ֖קּוּ מָטָ֣ר לְאֵדֽוֹ׃

lines.text: For he draws up the drops of water, which distill in rain from his vapor,
When He doth diminish droppings of the waters, They refine rain according to its vapour,

36.he: אֲשֶֽׁר־יִזְּל֥וּ שְׁחָקִ֑ים יִ֝רְעֲפ֗וּ עֲלֵ֤י ׀ אָדָ֬ם רָֽב׃

lines.text: which the skies pour down and which drop on man abundantly.
Which clouds do drop, They distil on man abundantly.

36.he: אַ֣ף אִם־יָ֭בִין מִפְרְשֵׂי־עָ֑ב תְּ֝שֻׁא֗וֹת סֻכָּתֽוֹ׃

lines.text: Yes, can any understand the spreading of the clouds, and the thunderings of his pavilion?
Yea, doth [any] understand The spreadings out of a cloud? The noises of His tabernacle?

36.he: הֵן־פָּרַ֣שׂ עָלָ֣יו אוֹר֑וֹ וְשָׁרְשֵׁ֖י הַיָּ֣ם כִּסָּֽה׃

lines.text: Behold, he spreads his light around him. He covers the bottom of the sea.
Lo, He hath spread over it His light, And the roots of the sea He hath covered,

36.he: כִּי־בָ֭ם יָדִ֣ין עַמִּ֑ים יִֽתֶּן־אֹ֥כֶל לְמַכְבִּֽיר׃

lines.text: For by these he judges the people. He gives food in abundance.
For by them He doth judge peoples, He giveth food in abundance.

36.he: עַל־כַּפַּ֥יִם כִּסָּה־א֑וֹר וַיְצַ֖ו עָלֶ֣יהָ בְמַפְגִּֽיעַ׃

lines.text: He covers his hands with the lightning, and commands it to strike the mark.
By two palms He hath covered the light, And layeth a charge over it in meeting,

36.he: יַגִּ֣יד עָלָ֣יו רֵע֑וֹ מִ֝קְנֶ֗ה אַ֣ף עַל־עוֹלֶֽה׃

lines.text: Its noise tells about him, and the livestock also concerning the storm that comes up.
He sheweth by it [to] his friend substance, Anger against perversity.

37.he: אַף־לְ֭זֹאת יֶחֱרַ֣ד לִבִּ֑י וְ֝יִתַּ֗ר מִמְּקוֹמֽוֹ׃

lines.text: “Yes, at this my heart trembles, and is moved out of its place.
Also, at this my heart trembleth, And it moveth from its place.

37.he: שִׁמְע֤וּ שָׁמ֣וֹעַ בְּרֹ֣גֶז קֹל֑וֹ וְ֝הֶ֗גֶה מִפִּ֥יו יֵצֵֽא׃

lines.text: Hear, oh, hear the noise of his voice, the sound that goes out of his mouth.
Hearken diligently to the trembling of His voice, Yea, the sound from His mouth goeth forth.

37.he: תַּֽחַת־כָּל־הַשָּׁמַ֥יִם יִשְׁרֵ֑הוּ וְ֝אוֹר֗וֹ עַל־כַּנְפ֥וֹת הָאָֽרֶץ׃

lines.text: He sends it out under the whole sky, and his lightning to the ends of the earth.
Under the whole heavens He directeth it, And its light [is] over the skirts of the earth.

37.he: אַחֲרָ֤יו ׀ יִשְׁאַג־ק֗וֹל יַ֭רְעֵם בְּק֣וֹל גְּאוֹנ֑וֹ וְלֹ֥א יְ֝עַקְּבֵ֗ם כִּֽי־יִשָּׁמַ֥ע קוֹלֽוֹ׃

lines.text: After it a voice roars. He thunders with the voice of his majesty. He doesn’t hold back anything when his voice is heard.
After it roar doth a voice — He thundereth with the voice of His excellency, And He doth not hold them back, When His voice is heard.

37.he: יַרְעֵ֤ם אֵ֣ל בְּ֭קוֹלוֹ נִפְלָא֑וֹת עֹשֶׂ֥ה גְ֝דֹל֗וֹת וְלֹ֣א נֵדָֽע׃

lines.text: God thunders marvelously with his voice. He does great things, which we can’t comprehend.
God thundereth with His voice wonderfully, Doing great things and we know not.

37.he: כִּ֤י לַשֶּׁ֨לַג ׀ יֹאמַ֗ר הֱוֵ֫א אָ֥רֶץ וְגֶ֥שֶׁם מָטָ֑ר וְ֝גֶ֗שֶׁם מִטְר֥וֹת עֻזּֽוֹ׃

lines.text: For he says to the snow, ‘Fall on the earth,’ likewise to the shower of rain, and to the showers of his mighty rain.
For to snow He saith, 'Be [on] the earth.' And the small rain and great rain of His power.

37.he: בְּיַד־כָּל־אָדָ֥ם יַחְתּ֑וֹם לָ֝דַ֗עַת כָּל־אַנְשֵׁ֥י מַעֲשֵֽׂהוּ׃

lines.text: He seals up the hand of every man, that all men whom he has made may know it.
Into the hand of every man he sealeth, For the knowledge by all men of His work.

37.he: וַתָּבֹ֣א חַיָּ֣ה בְמוֹ־אָ֑רֶב וּבִמְע֖וֹנֹתֶ֣יהָ תִשְׁכֹּֽן׃

lines.text: Then the animals take cover, and remain in their dens.
And enter doth the beast into covert, And in its habitations it doth continue.

37.he: מִן־הַ֭חֶדֶר תָּב֣וֹא סוּפָ֑ה וּֽמִמְּזָרִ֥ים קָרָֽה׃

lines.text: Out of its room comes the storm, and cold out of the north.
From the inner chamber cometh a hurricane, And from scatterings winds — cold,

37.he: מִנִּשְׁמַת־אֵ֥ל יִתֶּן־קָ֑רַח וְרֹ֖חַב מַ֣יִם בְּמוּצָֽק׃

lines.text: By the breath of God, ice is given, and the width of the waters is frozen.
From the breath of God is frost given, And the breadth of waters is straitened,

37.he: אַף־בְּ֭רִי יַטְרִ֣יחַ עָ֑ב יָ֝פִ֗יץ עֲנַ֣ן אוֹרֽוֹ׃

lines.text: Yes, he loads the thick cloud with moisture. He spreads abroad the cloud of his lightning.
Yea, by filling He doth press out a cloud, Scatter a cloud doth His light.

37.he: וְה֤וּא מְסִבּ֨וֹת ׀ מִתְהַפֵּ֣ךְ בתחבולתו לְפָעֳלָ֑ם כֹּ֖ל אֲשֶׁ֥ר יְצַוֵּ֓ם ׀ עַל־פְּנֵ֖י תֵבֵ֣ל אָֽרְצָה׃

lines.text: It is turned around by his guidance, that they may do whatever he commands them on the surface of the habitable world,
And it is turning itself round by His counsels, For their doing all He commandeth them, On the face of the habitable earth.

37.he: אִם־לְשֵׁ֥בֶט אִם־לְאַרְצ֑וֹ אִם־לְ֝חֶ֗סֶד יַמְצִאֵֽהוּ׃

lines.text: Whether it is for correction, or for his land, or for loving kindness, that he causes it to come.
Whether for a rod, or for His land, Or for kindness — He doth cause it to come.

37.he: הַאֲזִ֣ינָה זֹּ֣את אִיּ֑וֹב עֲ֝מֹ֗ד וְהִתְבּוֹנֵ֤ן ׀ נִפְלְא֬וֹת אֵֽל׃

lines.text: “Listen to this, Job. Stand still, and consider the wondrous works of God.
Hear this, O Job, Stand and consider the wonders of God.

37.he: הֲ֭תֵדַע בְּשׂוּם־אֱל֣וֹהַּ עֲלֵיהֶ֑ם וְ֝הוֹפִ֗יעַ א֣וֹר עֲנָנֽוֹ׃

lines.text: Do you know how God controls them, and causes the lightning of his cloud to shine?
Dost thou know when God doth place them, And caused to shine the light of His cloud?

37.he: הֲ֭תֵדַע עַל־מִפְלְשֵׂי־עָ֑ב מִ֝פְלְא֗וֹת תְּמִ֣ים דֵּעִֽים׃

lines.text: Do you know the workings of the clouds, the wondrous works of him who is perfect in knowledge?
Dost thou know the balancings of a cloud? The wonders of the Perfect in knowledge?

37.he: אֲשֶׁר־בְּגָדֶ֥יךָ חַמִּ֑ים בְּהַשְׁקִ֥ט אֶ֝֗רֶץ מִדָּרֽוֹם׃

lines.text: You whose clothing is warm, when the earth is still by reason of the south wind?
How thy garments [are] warm, In the quieting of the earth from the south?

37.he: תַּרְקִ֣יעַ עִ֭מּוֹ לִשְׁחָקִ֑ים חֲ֝זָקִ֗ים כִּרְאִ֥י מוּצָֽק׃

lines.text: Can you, with him, spread out the sky, which is strong as a cast metal mirror?
Thou hast made an expanse with Him For the clouds — strong as a hard mirror!

37.he: ה֭וֹדִיעֵנוּ מַה־נֹּ֣אמַר ל֑וֹ לֹ֥א־נַ֝עֲרֹ֗ךְ מִפְּנֵי־חֹֽשֶׁךְ׃

lines.text: Teach us what we will tell him, for we can’t make our case by reason of darkness.
Let us know what we say to Him, We set not in array because of darkness.

37.he: הַֽיְסֻפַּר־ל֭וֹ כִּ֣י אֲדַבֵּ֑ר אִֽם־אָ֥מַר אִ֝֗ישׁ כִּ֣י יְבֻלָּֽע׃

lines.text: Will it be told him that I would speak? Or should a man wish that he were swallowed up?
Is it declared to Him that I speak? If a man hath spoken, surely he is swallowed up.

37.he: וְעַתָּ֤ה ׀ לֹ֘א רָ֤אוּ א֗וֹר בָּהִ֣יר ה֭וּא בַּשְּׁחָקִ֑ים וְר֥וּחַ עָ֝בְרָ֗ה וַֽתְּטַהֲרֵֽם׃
